Head to Falador Park and talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien. (Devious Minds.)
Congratulations, quest complete!

Head to the Paterdomus Temple, north-east of Varrock and the Digsite; the same temple encountered during Priest in Peril. Talk to the monk just outside, who will request your help. On his recent travels to Morytania, he learned of a weapon from the lands to the far east that he believes will be valuable in the Saradominist fight against darkness. In order to help him build such a weapon, he wants you to take a two-handed mithril sword to Doric, a dwarf whose whetstone he considers unmatchable.
left
A mithril 2h sword and a bow string

Head to Doric's house just north of Falador, and use a mithril 2h sword on the whetstone inside to make a slender blade, then attach a bow string (the bow string spool works) to it to make the bow-sword.

When you've made the bow-sword, make your way back to the monk. You can use the balloon transport system to fly from Taverley back to the Earth Altar by using a set of willow logs, if you have already unlocked the Varrock destination.
The bow-sword and a [[large pouch

Give the bow-sword to the Monk and he will be grateful for it; although he needs one more favour. He wants you to secretly deliver a special gift to Entrana for a special ceremony. He will give you an orb to smuggle; to do this, the Monk suggests using the Abyss to access the Law Altar on the island. He also wants you to protect the delicate orb by storing it inside an essence pouch. Only a large pouch or colossal pouch may be used. The large pouch will be destroyed during the quest, whereas the colossal pouch will survive. Your pouch must not be degraded — if it must be repaired, contact the dark mage either by the Astral Contact spell or directly in the Abyss.

Large pouches can be obtained as rewards from the Rewards Guardian at Guardians of the Rift or as drops from abyssal leeches, guardians and walkers found within the Abyss or the Abyssal Area. You must obtain the smaller pouches first. You do not need to have the Runecraft level (50) in order for it to be dropped, but it is required to use it.
Use the orb on your large or colossal pouch to create an illuminated large pouch.

As usual, no other weapons or armour are allowed on Entrana. The Abyss is intended to be the only way to enter Entrana with the orb. However, players with a Greater Teleport Focus on their boat can circumvent this by casting Teleport to Boat on a ship docked at Entrana. If using the Abyss, it is accessible through a teleport from the Mage of Zamorak, who is located in the Wilderness at the point where the River Lum goes underground, just north of Edgeville. Enter the Abyss to reach the Law Altar, and through it, Entrana.

Note for Ultimate Ironman players: The orb and the large pouch containing the orb will be lost if the player dies after putting the orb in the pouch, including to deathpile or deathbank. If obtaining a large pouch from Abyss, make sure to deathpile or deathbank gear and items after obtaining the pouch but before putting the orb in it (the orb is always lost on death, players can get a new orb after dying from the Monk at Paterdomus). Do not put the orb in the pouch before you deathbank or deathpile and are fully ready to go to Entrana. Note the pouch used for this quest will be lost regardless as part of successful completion.
The large pouch (Devious Minds)

On Entrana, head to the church at the heart of the island and use your pouch on the altar. A cutscene ensues, wherein the monks are walking towards the altar to begin the ceremony, one of them holding a mysterious relic, when suddenly an Assassin wielding the bow-sword teleports in, swiftly kills the monks and steals the relic. After teleporting away, the orb on the altar explodes.

After the cutscene, talk to the High Priest. It turns out that the orb you delivered was in fact a teleport beacon, which allowed the assassin to sneak into the holy island, unhindered. After questioning the player, he will conclude that no worshipper of Saradomin would ever do this; he wants you to return to the Paterdomus Temple to look for any trace of the 'monk'.

On arriving back at the Paterdomus Temple, the monk you helped is gone, replaced by a Dead Monk. Searching the body reveals that he has been killed by powerful magic, and is not the same person you spoke to earlier.

Go back to Entrana and speak with the High Priest again (you can travel via Port Sarim this time if you wish). He will reveal that the relic was once part of a powerful artefact, and asks you to report it to Sir Tiffy Cashien. Find Sir Tiffy sitting on a bench in Falador Park. Unsurprised, he reveals that the Temple Knights already had intel on the relic being stolen. After the player asks if there is anything they can do to help, Sir Tiffy says they will be in touch.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Go to the Exam Centre.
Ask an examiner about an exam. (Can I take an exam?)
Go to the Varrock museum and talk to Curator Haig Halen. He will give you a Sealed letter. (Have you any interesting news?)
(Optional) Steal a cup of tea from the tea stall if you don't have one already. (This is a Varrock easy diary requirement)
Go back to the Exam Centre and talk to an examiner. The chat options do not matter; you will fail the exam regardless.
North of the exam centre at the hilltop with the blue urn, search the second [[Bush (The Dig Site)
Take the panning tray.
Use the cup of tea on the nearby panning guide.
Pan the water at the panning points until you find a Special cup (browse through dialogue if stopped – referred to as "Shiny Cup" in dialogue). If you need an opal continue panning until you get one.
Steal from the workman near the panning points until you get an animal skull and specimen brush.
Run north to the female student with blonde hair and pigtails on the north-west end of the dig and give her the "teddy" by talking to her twice.
Run east to the student with a beard and a reddish-orange shirt and give him the Special cup by talking to him twice.
Run south to the student in a green shirt and give him the Animal skull by talking to him twice.

Return to an examiner. (Yes, I certainly am. → The study of the earth, its contents and history. → All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam. → Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.) – You should receive 'Level 1 Certificate'
Talk to all 3 students again.

Return to an examiner to take the second exam. (I am ready for the next exam. → Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers. → Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn. → Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.) – You should receive 'Level 2 Certificate'
Talk to all 3 students – the female student will demand an opal (can be obtained by panning). Talk to her two times.

Return to an examiner for the final exam. (I am ready for the last exam... → Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars. → Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes. → Handle bones very carefully and keep them amay from other samples.) – You should receive 'Level 3 Certificate'

Save all of your certificates to hand in to Curator Haig Halen at the Varrock Museum in exchange for a fruit blast, a required item for Recipe for Disaster subquest Another Cook's Quest or a chocolate cake.
Back at the Exam Centre, go in the western room and search the cupboards on the north and south walls to get a rock pick and a specimen jar, respectively.
If you haven't already, steal a specimen brush from the Digsite workman.
Use the trowel on the soil in either level 3 digsite until you obtain an ancient talisman. Note: This step can take several minutes depending upon luck.
Talk to Terry Balando in the exam centre.
Use the invitation on any Digsite workman except the one by the western winch.
Use a rope on the western winch, then climb down.
Pick up one of the arcenia root in the room, search the bricks to the east, then climb back up.
Walk north-east to the northern winch, use the rope on the winch, and climb down.
Talk to Doug Deeping about the rocks. (How could I move a large pile of rocks?) Climb up the rope.
Walk to the tent to the south (marked with the orange vial), unlock the [[chest (Chemical powder)
Use the trowel on the closed barrel to the west of the tent.
Use a vial on the barrel to get an unidentified liquid. If dropped, it will deal 25 non-fatal damage, and destroy the vial requiring you to re-open the barrel and collect more.
Grind the charcoal with your pestle and mortar.
If you don't have charcoal, search the tray a few steps north.
Return to the exam centre and use the chemical powder and the unidentified liquid on Terry Balando (Note: make sure you right-click the liquid otherwise you'll empty it).
Mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together to create mixed chemicals, then add ground charcoal and finally arcenia root to produce chemical compound.
Climb down the western winch.
Use the compound on the bricks (not the rocks).
Use your tinderbox on the bricks.
Enter the large chamber, take the [[Stone tablet (The Dig Site)
Use the tablet on Terry Balando.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Go to the Exam Centre, south of the Digsite. Talk to an Examiner and ask her about taking an exam, and she will give you an unstamped letter to take to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum, located in the east of the city. Talk to him and he will use his seal on the letter, authorising you to take part in the exam. If you don't have a cup of tea, you can obtain one now from the Varrock tea stall.
Speak to an Examiner again who will test you. Answer anything, the answers do not matter as they are all wrong. When you fail, the examiner suggests you ask the other students for help.

A cup of tea
There are three students in the Digsite who can help you with the exam answers, but they each have a lost item they want retrieved first. To save time, gather these items before visting the students.

Head north of the Exam centre until you come upon two wooden walkways. Follow the eastern walkway to the top of the small hill and search the easternmost bush by the large blue urn to find the missing teddy bear.
left

Enter the tent at the end of the walkway and pick up the panning tray from the table. Use the cup of tea on the nearby panning guide and he will thank you and allow you to pan in the river to the east. Using the panning points, pan in the river until you get the special cup. You may also receive an uncut opal, keep it for later in the quest.
left
"Steal-from" nearby Digsite workmen until You steal an animal skull appears. If you obtain a specimen brush whilst stealing from the workmen, keep it as you'll need it later in the quest.

Once you have all three lost items, return them to each student (you will need to talk to each person twice).
The first student who lost the animal skull has blonde hair and is wearing a green shirt, north of the tent.
Further north-east is the second student who lost his special cup, wearing an orange shirt, with short black hair and darker skin.
The female student who lost their teddy bear is further north-west, wearing all purple with blonde hair.
An [[uncut opal
Note: If the correct answer is not present in the selection given, you must have missed talking to a student. Check the quest log to find out which one, speak to them, and then try again.
After helping out all three students, return to the Exam Centre and speak to an Examiner. Speak to her to retake the exam. To pass it, use the answers that the students gave you:
Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is? - The study of the earth, its contents and history.
Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite? - All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite? - Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
If done correctly, players will receive a Level 1 certificate and a trowel.
To pass the level 2 test, speak to the three students again to get the answers and return to the Examiner. The questions and answers are:
Can you tell me how we transport samples? - Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.
What is the proper way to handle finds? - Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.
Can you tell me the proper use for a rock pick? - Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.
Upon passing, players receive a Level 2 certificate.

To pass the level 3 test, you need to speak to the three students again to obtain the answers. However, the female student will ask for an uncut opal or opal this time. If you still need one, pan in the river until you obtain it. Talk to her twice, she will first request the opal, then give it to her in the second conversation. Return to the examiner and take the last test:
Can you tell me how we prepare samples? - Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.
What is the proper way to use a specimen brush? - Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.
Can you describe the technique for handling bones? - Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.

Upon passing, players receive a Level 3 certificate and permission to dig in all levels. You may choose to keep the certificate to later exchange with the Museum Curator for a chocolate cake or fruit blast, which may be used for other quests like Desert Treasure I and Recipe for Disaster.
A trowel, a specimen brush, and a specimen jar.

Grab a specimen jar from the cupboard on the south wall inside the Exam Centre. If there is no search option, speak to Terry Balando about the tools first. Head back to the Digsite and pickpocket a Digsite workman (25 Thieving) until you get a specimen brush if you didn't get one earlier.

Head to a dig site marked by a level 3 sign, either the south-westernmost dig site or the northernmost dig site (see map above). Use your trowel on the soil until you find an ancient talisman. This often takes many tries and can easily take several minutes to find. You find a strange talisman will appear in a dialogue box when found.

Bring the talisman to Terry Balando in the Exam Centre, who identifies it as a talisman of Zaros, a pagan god little is known of. As a reward he will allow you to use the private dig shafts, giving you an invitation letter to show a Digsite workman as proof.

There are two winches in the Digsite (see map above). Use your Invitation letter on a Digsite workman (not the 'Dig site workman' which lacks a pickpocket option) that's working near a winch, and then use a rope on the west winch to gain access to the sublevels of the Digsite.

Climb down the rope by operating the winch (10 Agility). Grab an arcenia root just north of the rope, then head south-east where there are bricks blocking the way. "Search" the bricks, and the player will muse about asking someone to help move them.

Return to the surface and head towards the north-east winch. Use another rope and go down, there you will find Doug Deeping. Speak to him and ask him how you can move a large pile of rocks. He will give you a chest key.

There is a book on chemicals found in the bookshelves of the Exam Centre detailing the creation of an explosive compound that you will need to use to clear the bricks, but you do not need to read it to progress in the quest.

Use the chest key on the chest in the tent where you got your panning tray to get chemical powder. Use your trowel on the centre barrel just west of the tent to open it, then use a vial on it to fill it with an unidentified liquid. Do not drop it or you will take 25 non-fatal damage and must re-retrieve the ingredients.
If you didn't bring charcoal, you may search the specimen tray north of the tent with a specimen jar in your inventory until you find some.
Use the chemical powder on Terry Balando in the Exam Centre to learn that it's ammonium nitrate, then use (do not empty/drop) the unidentified liquid on him to learn that it's nitroglycerin.
Use the ammonium nitrate on the nitroglycerin to make mixed chemicals (6 Herblore).
Grind your charcoal with a pestle and mortar to get ground charcoal.
Use the ground charcoal on the mixed chemicals (8 Herblore).
Use the arcenia root on the mixed chemicals to create a chemical compound (10 Herblore).
Warning: If you drop the chemical compound now, you will take 65 non-fatal damage.

Once you have the chemical compound, go down the western winch to use the chemical compound on the bricks (not the rocks), and then use a tinderbox on the bricks. Your character will run away as the bricks explode, clearing the path. Pick up the stone tablet in the room, avoiding the level 22 Skeletons if below 45 Combat Level.

Bring the tablet to Terry Balando, who remarks that the tablet shows that the followers of Saradomin must have tried to cover up the evidence of the Zaros altar when building Varrock. He gives you two gold bars as a reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Obtain 2 iron ores, 4 copper ores, and 6 clay un-noted from either of the following methods:
Buy from the Grand Exchange for: Iron ore + Copper ore + Clay coins
Head to the Dwarven Mine on the south side of the Ice mountain (east from the quest start) with a pickaxe (Doric will give you a bronze pickaxe at the start of the quest):
2 iron ores and 4 copper ores can be mined at a spot just south-east of the ladder down into the mine.
6 clay can be mined south of the iron and copper, near the Agility shortcut.
Players with very low combat levels should be wary of the aggressive [[Scorpion
Talk to Doric with the un-noted items in your inventory. (I wanted to use your anvils. → Yes, I will get you the materials.)
Congratulations, quest complete!
Doric can be found in a small building on the crossroads north of Falador, east of the Taverley gate, and south of the Goblin Village.
Ask Doric if you could use his whetstone or anvil. Doric will tell you he needs some materials in order to manufacture some pickaxes. He will hand you a bronze pickaxe. He wants you to get him:
6 clay
4 copper ores
2 iron ores
(These cannot be noted)
These materials must be turned in all at once (12 inventory slots).
(Skip this part if you already have all of the required materials)
Where you obtain the ores does not matter, and can for example be obtained from other players or by mining the ores yourself (15 Mining is required for iron ore).

The Dwarven Mine is located near Doric's house, so you can head there. To get there, go east from Doric's house and then north to find a path onto Ice Mountain. On the mountain, walk south and look for a ladder surrounded by buildings and dwarves. Climb down the ladder to enter the Dwarven Mine. The iron, copper, and tin rocks are located due south of the entrance. Clay rocks are located a little further south.

Dwarves located outside the Dwarven Mine, east of Doric's house, sometimes drop iron ore. This may help Ironmen trying to complete this quest before level 15 Mining. Members can buy the copper ores and iron ores at the store in Blast Furnace. Ironmen can also complete the quest before reaching level 15 Mining by pickpocketing H.A.M members as they have an uncommon chance to give Iron ore. Also you can kill for example Sand or Rock Crabs which drop both copper and iron.
Alternatively, instead of mining in the Dwarven Mine, you can use the Rimmington mine south of Falador, which contains all the required ores right next to each other.
When you have all the ores needed, return to Doric to finish the quest. He will appreciate your help, reward you, and allow you to use his anvils whenever you'd like.
Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. (Can I have a quest?)
Talk to Oziach in Edgeville. (Can you sell me a rune platebody? → The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me. → I thought you were going to give me a quest. → A dragon, that sounds like fun.)

Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. Make sure you get the maze key by asking about Melzar's map piece, and also ask about Thalzar and Lozar's map pieces as well as where to find the right ship. (I talked to Oziach... → How can I find the route to Crandor? → Where is Melzar's map piece? → Where is Thalzar's map piece? → Where is Lozar's map piece? → Where can I find the right ship? → How can I protect myself from the dragon's breath? → Okay, I'll get going!)

If you don't already have an anti-dragon shield, speak to Duke Horacio on the of the Lumbridge Castle. (I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath. → Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island! → Yes → So, are you going to give me the shield or not?)
Map pieces can be obtained in any order.
Talk to Oracle on Ice Mountain. Make sure you have talked to the Guildmaster about where the Thalzar's map piece is. (I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.)
Enter the Dwarven mine and use silk, lobster pot, unfired bowl, (make sure to right click) wizard's mind bomb on the [[Magic_door_(Thalzar's_room)

Enter the magic door, open the chest, and search the chest to receive a map piece. Press space or ensure that you finish the dialogue. (Re-entry doesn't require the re-use of the items if you make a mistake.)
Once you've gotten the Maze key from the Guildmaster head to Rimmington.
Enter Melzar's Maze.
Kill the small zombie rat with a long tail to get the key and enter the north-western door and climb up the ladder.
Kill the [[Ghost (Melzar's Maze)
Kill the [[Skeleton (Melzar's Maze)
Kill the [[Zombie (Melzar's Maze)
Kill Melzar the Mad to get the key and enter the purple (magenta) door.
Kill the [[Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)
Open and search the chest to receive a map piece.
Go to the jail in Port Sarim.

Either kill Wormbrain with ranged/magic/halberd and telegrab the map piece or pay him 10,000 coins for it. Make sure you have talked to the Guildmaster about where the Lozar's map piece is. (I believe you've got a piece of map that I need. → I suppose I could pay you for the map piece... → Alright then, 10,000 it is.)
After obtaining all 3, combine them by using them on each other.
Grab 3 wood planks, 90 steel nails, a hammer, and 2,000 coins out of the bank.
Talk to Klarense in the southern docks of Port Sarim by the Void Outpost boat and pay him 2,000 coins. (I'd like to buy her. → Yep, sounds good.)
Go on board, climb down the ladder and repair the hole 3 times.
Talk to Ned in Draynor Village with the map in your inventory. (You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?)
Prepare for the fight. Make sure you have your Antifire potion and Anti-dragon shield with you.
Return to the [[Lady Lumbridge
Climb on top of the volcano and enter the hole. (After the cutscene climb back out of the hole for a Karamja medium task.)
(Optional) Before teleporting out, head south from Elvarg's cave and open the wall to unlock another Karamja medium task.

Head south and kill Elvarg. Depending on your level, you may flinch Elvarg in the south-east corner of her cave for a long, but safe fight. You will automatically collect her head as proof of your victory.
Talk to Oziach in Edgeville.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Head to the Champions' Guild immediately south of the southern gates of Varrock and ask the Guildmaster for a quest. He will tell you to visit Oziach, the maker of rune platebodies, who sets the tasks that champions must complete to earn the right to wear one.
Oziach can be found in the north-west corner of Edgeville, near the Wilderness ditch and the Edgeville Monastery. Speak to him, and he will set the player the task of killing the dragon of Crandor.

Return to the Guildmaster, who will recount the tale of Elvarg, the dragon that laid waste to the whole of Crandor, leaving a trio of wizards as the sole survivors. To reach Crandor, the player will need a ship capable of getting through dangerous reefs, a map to show the way, and protection against the dragon's breath.
Important: Ask him all the follow up questions below; each one unlocks a stage of the quest. You will need to return later if you do not.
Ask him how you can find the route to Crandor, and he will tell you that only one map exists - it was split into three pieces, each held by a wizard.
Ask him where to find each map piece, and he will give you information about each piece, as well as give you a Maze key (requires free inventory space).
Ask him where you can find the right ship, and he will suggest looking in Port Sarim.
Ask him how to protect against the dragon's breath, and he will mention that Duke Horacio has a special shield which is enchanted against dragon's breath.

Non-ironmen may purchase the Anti-dragon shield on the Grand Exchange for Anti-dragon shield coins. Alternatively, you can obtain one for free from Duke Horacio on the of Lumbridge Castle. The drop trick can be used to obtain several shields, which may be useful if you die during the dragon fight and need to return, as Elvarg shoots dragonfire immediately upon entering her arena.
The three map pieces may be collected in any order. After collecting all three, use any piece on another, and all three pieces will combine to form Crandor map.
Items required: The Maze key, food, and combat equipment. (The most difficult enemy is the lesser demon; you can safespot it with Magic/Ranged and with melee as well.)

Head to Melzar's Maze for the first map piece, located north-west of Rimmington, south of the Crafting Guild, and west of Port Sarim, with your Maze key and combat equipment. Food is recommended for lower level players.
File:Melzar's Maze map.png
File:Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze) safespot.png
File:Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze) safespot.gif
Enter the maze, where you will be required to identify monsters which look slightly different to their counterparts:
Kill the one long-tailed small zombie rat to get a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)#Red
Enter the north-western red door (room with the spooky picture) and go up the ladder.
Kill the capeless, hooded [[Ghost (Melzar's Maze)
ghost]] wearing a tube top to get a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)#Orange
Enter the second most northern door (room with the ladder in the centre) and go up the ladder.
Kill the [[Skeleton (Melzar's Maze)
skeleton]] with a small, round shield to get a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)#Yellow
Enter the south-western door (room with the spooky picture) and go down the ladder at the end of the room, then go down two more ladders.
Kill the [[Zombie (Melzar's Maze)
zombies]] until you get a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)#Blue
Enter the blue door. Exiting through the normal door will send you back to the beginning! Melzar the Mad (level 43) will spawn.
Kill Melzar the Mad to get a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)#Magenta

magenta key]]. It is possible to safespot or flinch him by dragging him over to the southern side of the room (where you entered), and then running to the square inbetween the crate and the barrel, so that he gets stuck on the crate.
Enter the magenta door. In this room, there is a [[Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)
lesser demon]] (level 82) that you must kill to get a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)#Green
Use the green key on the green door then both open and search the chest to get a map part.
Go up the ladder to exit the maze.
An unfired bowl, a wizard's mind bomb, a lobster pot, and silk

Bring an unfired bowl, Wizard's mind bomb, silk and lobster pot to the Oracle, located on top of the northern end of Ice Mountain, south-west of the shabby tent. The mountain is directly west of the Edgeville Monastery entrance. Tell her you seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor, and she will explain through riddle that the map piece is behind a door below, and that you require the items you have brought to open it.
Note: If you didn't ask the Guildmaster about Thalzar's map piece, you won't have the option to ask the Oracle about the map.
Descend the mountain and head slightly south, to enter the Dwarven Mine (using the ladder, under the canopy where all the dwarves are standing).

Head to the square room at the north-east corner where you will find the magic door (see the attached map.) Use your silk, wizard's mind bomb (Be careful to not drink it!), unfired bowl and lobster pot on the door to open it. Open the chest and search for the second map piece.
Note: Using an incorrect item on the door will not affect the process. If you forgot an item, you may leave and return to the door - your progress will not be lost.

For the third and final piece, the Guildmaster mentioned that one of the goblins from Goblin Village probably has the map piece, after Lozar was slain by goblins. It is possible to skip visiting Goblin Village - General Bentnoze would have told you that Wormbrain the thief was caught.

Head to Port Sarim jail, which is in the south of the port. Wormbrain is in the third cell from the entrance - you can either talk to him and pay 10000 coins in exchange for the map piece, or attack him using Ranged or Magic if you want to use Telekinetic grab to obtain it. Once his health reaches zero (he has 5 Hitpoints), he will say Ow! and drop the map part for you to telegrab.
Note: If you didn't ask the Guildmaster about Lozar's map piece, you will not be able to attack Wormbrain.
Now that you have all three pieces, combine them to make the Crandor map.

Take your nails, planks, hammer, and 2000 coins, and head to Port Sarim. If you do not yet have a hammer, you can buy one from a Trader Crewmember on the dock to the south (Members only). Nine planks can be made at the sawmill in free-to-play, but only once. The Sawmill operator will only talk to you after you have purchased the ship.

Look for Klarense, a sailor, who is located on the second-most southern dock. Talk to him and he will ask if you are interested in buying his ship, the Lady Lumbridge. Reply that you'd like to buy her, and he will sell you the ship for 2000 coins.

The boat is not yet seaworthy, and you will need to fix it first. Board the ship and climb down the ladder. Patch the hole in the ship's hull by clicking it three times, and the ship will be seaworthy again.

You now need to find a captain to sail it. Go to Draynor Village and talk to Ned, located in the house just north-east of the Wise Old Man's home. Ask him if he will take you to Crandor, and he'll agree to sail you to Crandor if you have already repaired the ship and hand him the Crandor map.
Anti-dragon shield, combat equipment and food

Without the use of dragonfire protection, Elvarg's dragonfire can deal up to 70 damage at range. Equipping an anti-dragon shield is highly recommended to mitigate this at a minimum; Protect from Magic will also reduce some of the damage. Members may also drink an antifire potion or super antifire potion in combination with the other two methods.
See the below table for the maximum damage Elvarg will deal based on your combination of dragonfire protection used.
Note that every dragonfire attack from Elvarg will also drain 10% of your remaining Prayer, rounded down.
As well as dragonfire protection, consider taking prayer potions or restore potions with you for when Elvarg drains your prayer, if you plan to use it during the battle.
Lower levelled players may find it useful to use rings of recoil to deal additional damage, as Elvarg's fast hits make it particularly useful in dealing back damage.

The rest of your inventory should be filled with food - lobsters (12 HP) should be enough for most players with a combat level of around 40 and appropriate gear, but swordfish (14 HP) or higher would be useful.
You may also consider taking a teleportation method with you, either to escape death or to leave the island after killing her.
Note: While it will allow you to set up a cannon in the area, it will not attack Elvarg.
Before fighting Elvarg, you'll need to choose a combat style: melee, ranged or magic.
Melee

This is the preferred style, as Elvarg will not solely use her dragonfire attack but also melee attacks when standing next to her, and the latter are less powerful. You may also consider using flinching (see the tips section below for more information).
Equip good-quality armour; preferably adamant armour or better.

Like all dragons, Elvarg is weak to stab attacks; see the page about Attack types. As such, consider wielding a stab weapon: a sword or dagger instead of a scimitar. Adamant or better is recommended. For free-to-play players, a rune sword is recommended as it possesses the highest stab bonus in F2P, with its aggressive style the optimum for most players. A rune longsword, rune scimitar, battleaxe or mace are less effective but may still do decent enough damage.
Elvarg is not immune to poison, so adding weapon poison would turn the battle even more in your favour; thus a poisoned dagger would be effective.
Ranged

Elvarg is also weak against ranged attacks, but as you should be using an Anti-dragon shield, you must use a one-handed weapon such as a crossbow. This may be trickier for Free-to-play players who only have access to the weakest types and bronze bolts. For Members this is more viable, and they should use the best crossbow with the best bolts they can use (preferably poisoned).
Make sure you have Auto Retaliate on and select the Rapid firing style.
Magic

While Elvarg, like many other dragons, has somewhat strong defences against magic, she has a 30% elemental weakness to water spells. This means that water spells have their accuracy and damage increased by 30% against her. As such, mages should use the strongest water spell they have available.
Head back to and board your ship to meet up with Ned and Cabin boy Jenkins. Speak with Ned to depart and a cutscene will begin...

After crashing on the southern side of the island, make your way to the top of the volcano (the dungeon marker on your minimap), avoiding aggressive skeletons, moss giants, hobgoblins, and lesser demons. Enter the hole and a short cutscene plays, followed by abruptly finding yourself surrounded by skeletons (level 25). Down the corridor you'll find large skeletons (level 45), and you'll see Elvarg in the main chamber behind stalagmites and stalactites.
Note: If you are a Member, you can climb back up the rope to complete a medium task in the Karamja Diary, then climb back down.

Note: Before fighting Elvarg, there is a wall to the south you can open. Once opened, it will allow you to travel back to Crandor from the Karamja Volcano, by climbing down the rocks on the eastern side of the volcano, then heading north. If you die during the fight, you would otherwise need the materials to repair the boat again (90 steel nails, 3 planks and a hammer). Once you have unlocked this shortcut, trying to repair the ship will result in the message , and you will be unable to use it to return to Crandor. After the quest has been completed, you will be able to return to Crandor via the Karamja Volcano regardless of whether you opened it during the quest or not.
Now, go back to the main chamber, climb over the low stalagmites, and fight Elvarg (see section below for tips).

full.h: Tips for the fight & potential strategies

steps.t: Make sure that you have your dragonfire protection active before you enter the arena, as Elvarg, unlike other green dragons, can use dragonfire attacks at a distance.
You may consider standing under Elvarg while eating, as it takes her a moment to move and hit you again.
If you happen to teleport away during battle, she will take some time before fully healing, and may still be missing health if you can return quickly.
Aside from teleporting, you can exit the arena whenever you'd like, however re-entering the arena will result in guaranteed dragon fire attack.

Members who are unable to kill Elvarg in one trip may choose to escape through the shortcut to Karamja and go through the cave entrance to Mor Ul Rek to get extra food from their bank. If you return quickly, Elvarg will not have enough time to heal. Be sure to keep enough food to survive being hit by monsters on the way.

Elvarg can be flinched using melee attacks. Flinching is a combat tactic that entails attacking an opponent while it is out of combat and going to a safespot before the monster can retaliate. This can and will still go wrong every now and then, so it is still recommended to bring food and have a decent combat level.

To flinch her, stand in the south-eastern corner of her cave, in the game square directly next to the north-west corner of the little lava pool. You'll also need to get Elvarg to stand directly left of the skeleton on the ground to the north-west. (See the image for the place to stand.) If you pull this off, she will be unable to hit you; this is a safespot. From there, begin to attack her, and immediately click on the north-west corner (don't click on a rat) of the little lava pool to walk back to the safespot. Wait for Elvarg's health bar to disappear, and repeat the process.
Once Elvarg is defeated and you have triumphed, you will automatically collect Elvarg's head if you have a free inventory slot (not required to complete the quest).

You will need to return to Edgeville; either teleport out, or go through the shortcut and past the deadly red spiders, to the south-east of the dungeon where the skeletons are, and climb up the hanging rope to arrive on top of the Karamja volcano.
Talk to Oziach and the player will inform him that they have slain the dragon. Impressed, Oziach will agree to sell you rune platebodies.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild (spirit tree to Feldip Hills) to start the quest. (How can I gain access to the Guild? → Yes.)
Talk to Dallas Jones at the Karamja pub at Musa Point. The fastest way there is amulet of glory to karamja, alternativley to take the boat from Port Sarim.(Yes I know it well.)
Go to Elvarg's Lair under Crandor and talk to Dallas Jones (shortcut via the volcano on Karamja).
Right-click use your pickaxe on the Northern wall in the room you defeated Elvarg, then enter the tunnel. (Marked on minimap red wall line)
Investigate the Ancient Mural to the north. A level 100 [[Spawn (Dragon Slayer II)
Investigate the mural again.
Talk to Dallas Jones.
Head to Fossil Island in the basement of the House on the Hill and talk to Dallas Jones. (Ask about the island.)

Find the missing 24 map pieces and use them on the map in the middle of the room. Note: You can hand your pieces to Dallas to save inventory space - Hand in 8 map pieces within the house before heading outside to save time.
Search the open chest north of the map for 5 pieces.
Go upstairs, search the open stone chest on the north wall for 3 pieces.
Go outside, search the Fungi just north of the staircase for 4 pieces.
Search the Hook briar south of the house for 7 pieces.
Run to the east, search the mushtree for 5 pieces.
Talk to Dallas Jones and solve the map puzzle. (Let's talk about the investigation. → Let's do it!)
Pieces can be clicked to rotate them, and also dragged to swap them.
Talk to Dallas Jones again.
Talk to Jardric at the museum camp.

Bring 8 oak planks, 10 swamp paste, 12 nails (more may be needed as you may bend them), a hammer, and a saw to the west side of the island (on the coast just south-west of the "Mushroom Meadow" Magic Mushtree) and build a rowboat.
Talk to Dallas Jones and board the boat. (I'm ready.)
Head north-west from the boat to the ruined courtyard, and climb up the western stairs.
Climb down the [[trapdoor (Lithkren)
Talk to Dallas Jones.
Search the skeleton to the east and read Aivas' diary.
Talk to Dallas Jones again.
Find [[Bob (cat)
Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem. (Ask the Sphinx for help with Bob's memories.)
The sphinx will enchant you. You can now talk to cats without the catspeak amulet!

Bring your seal of passage and make sure you have 1 free inventory space! Note: You can still use the bank run by 'Bird's-Eye' Jack without the seal; however, it is needed to speak to the Oneiromancer.
Head to Lunar Isle and talk to the Oneiromancer. (Bob's memories. → .Yes.)
Crush the astral rune with a hammer, then grind the astral rune shards with a pestle and mortar.
Make a dream potion by filling the dream vial with water (sink west of bank in town) and adding your goutweed and ground astral rune.
Gear up for a fight, light the Ceremonial Brazier (located in the largest building on the island), and use your Dream potion on the flame.
You may leave to prepare by using the giant history book at the entrance, then rejoin the fight at any time by talking to Bob again.
Talk to [[Bob (cat)
Re-enter the dream by talking to Bob outside the brazier, and then head through the barrier and kill Robert the Strong.
He can't be fought with ranged or magic, bring melee gear and a crush weapon.

He can hit heavy damage through Protect from Missiles but it reduces damage taken. Using chivalry or piety is recommended to speed up the fight, as the most challenging part about this fight is lasting long enough through the damage taken.
When he shouts See if you can hide from this!, run behind one of the pillars to avoid his special attack. If it hits you, it can deal up to 60 damage and will knock off your prayers.
Super combat potion, an inventory full of food and a prayer potion are highly recommended. Do not underestimate this fight!
Note: If you leave the dream, you do NOT have to remake the dream potion! Talk to Bob to re-enter the dream.
Talk to [[Bob (cat)
You now need to collect the four parts of the key to open the door on Lithkren.
Head to the south-eastern coast of the Kharazi Jungle and down the staircase into the maze. Turn off Auto Retaliate.
Navigate to the centre of the maze and take the key piece.
Avoid spikes and traps with thieving and agility.
Use protection prayers to protect from the golems' attacks.
Red: Melee
Green: Ranged
Blue: Magic
Once you have taken the Dragon key piece, the plinth can be used to transport you out.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library. (Ask about Tristan.)
Search the second bookcase from the north on the west side of the central row (see [[:File:Varrock census records location.png
Talk to Reldo again. (Ask about Tristan.)
Go to Port Phasmatys and speak to [[Sarah (Port Phasmatys)
Bring a dragonstone, 2 molten glass, a glassblowing pipe, and a chisel to Ava in Draynor Manor. (I need your help with a key piece.)
Use your glassblowing pipe on your dragonstone and use the inert locator orb on Ava to get a locator orb.
Head to Mort Myre Swamp and use the locator to find the buried key piece. Bring food as the locator hurts you every time you use it.
The location is random inside the swamp. Each time you use the locator it will tell you which direction to go.
Start at BKR and feel your locator device.
If you get north-east, it will always be the lone purple spot that you need to cross the bridge to get to.

If you get south-west, south, or south-east, go to the centre of the subdivided area and scan again. For example, if you got west, go to the centre of the blue subdivision and scan there again. If you get west again, you've narrowed it down to a single dig spot.
Dig up the dragon key piece.

Ask Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka about the dragonkin fortress. (Ask about the dragonkin fortress.) or (Ask about the dragonkin fortress.) if you don't own a Seal of Passage or (Ask about the dragonkin fortress.) if you haven't started the Fremennik Exiles quest, whichever refers to the fortress.
Prepare for a fight with Vorkath. See Vorkath/Strategies for recommended setups.
Super antifires and Anti-venom+ potions are highly recommended.
Set your quick prayers to protect from Magic and your best ranged attack prayer to allow easy re-enabling prayers.
Elite Void Knight equipment together with a crossbow and [[Ruby bolts (e)
Turn off run to make evading the fire barrage special attack easier. Use Ctrl+click on tiles to run to that tile whenever necessary.
Talk to Torfinn on the dock to the north to go to Ungael. (Yes please.)
Kill Vorkath.
Before the fight, put on Protect from Magic and drink your Anti-venom+, Super antifire, and Ranging potions.
Make sure to re-pot during the fight, Super antifire and anti-venom has a short duration (both 3 minutes).
Vorkath has several different regular attacks, including a melee attack. The two important ones are:
Orange fireball shot into the air - Move at least two squares away from your current location.
Pink fireball shot at you - Your prayers will be knocked off, turn them back on (using quick prayers).
After every six regular attacks, Vorkath will use one of his special attacks:

He will spit acid all over the crater and start firing fireballs very rapidly at your current location. Find a straight line clear of acid spots and walk back and forth along it to avoid the fireballs. See [[Vorkath/Strategies#Acid Pool Quickfire Barrage

He will hit you with Dragonfire barrage, freezing you in an ice block. He will then summon a Zombified spawn that slowly walks to you, if it reaches you it will deal 30 damage. Kill it before it gets you, using Crumble Undead will guarantee a one-hit kill. You will stay frozen and Vorkath will stop attacking you until you kill the spawn or it reaches you. A possible strategy is to bring a slayer staff and setting the auto-cast to Crumble Undead, to reduce the need to click as accurately right away.
After you kill him, climb over the [[ice chunks (Vorkath)
Walk along the path to the north-west of the island and enter the cave.
There are venomous spiders inside, don't forget your Anti-venom+.
Pull the [[lever (Ungael laboratory)

Travel to Lunar Isle. Changing spellbooks to the lunar set may help, as will carrying runes to teleport back to the bank.

Travel north-east from the bank and go down the mine—then, crawl through the passageway to reach the fallen man (located just south-east of where you entered the cave. The cave entrance will appear as a red line in the wall on your minimap). You can talk to him and inspect him to open a status screen.
He will need you to increase three stat bars, in this order: health, spirit, and armament.

To feed him, you will need to give him at least three different kinds of food in sequence, for a total of 20 pieces of food (beverages other than wine and Guthix Rest will not work). It is recommended to bring seven pieces of two types and six pieces of a third type. The type of food brought does not offer any advantages. Using sacks or baskets of farm produce is useful to save space, but you must take the food out before using it, or it will only count as one.
Use one food that you have seven of on Cyrisus to feed him, followed by the one that you have six of, then the third type. There will be four lots of dialogue to complete while feeding him.
Continue feeding him in the same order until the chatbox says he doesn't need any more. If you feed him a type you used recently, he will reject it; just try another type.
Note: It is possible to use only one type of food by logging out after using each piece.

Increasing his spirit is done by talking to him, but just try to choose the most positive things. This part is long, but no dire consequences if you get it wrong. Make sure he's standing up and both his health and spirit are at least at 70 and 72% respectively before you leave the cave.

For armour, go to the bank on Lunar Isle and talk to the most right banker 'Birds-Eye' Jack. Tell him you want to access Cyrisus' bank account—from there, select a helmet, top, legs, boots, and weapon. It is guess and check whether or not you got it right. The easiest way to check is using the level 67 Lunar spell, Astral Contact, to ask Cyrisus whether you chose right. It may take several tries, but eventually, he will tell you your choice is just right—take that set to him in the cave.

Note: The most common set (for players with combat level determined by melee skills) is a dragon med helm, Ahrim's robetop and robe skirt, ranger boots and an abyssal whip. Cyrisus ends up dressed like a melee fighter.

For archers (players with ranged being the dominant combat skill), the combination is a splitbark helm, Karil's leathertop, Torag's platelegs, adamant boots and a magic shortbow. Cyrisus will look like an archer.

For mages (players with magic being the dominant combat skill), the combination is a Robin Hood hat, dragon chainbody, black d'hide chaps, infinity boots and an ancient staff. Cyrisus will look like a mage.

Now, you have to reach 100% in all of his remaining stats. Once Cyrisus has reached 100% in all stats, he'll tell you that he's afraid of Combat. Afterwards, you'll agree to accompany him to the Oneiromancer—exit the mine, and go southward.
Items required: Goutweed, a hammer, a pestle and mortar and an astral rune.

Head south to the Oneiromancer on the south-east part of the island near the Astral Altar. Talk to her, and Cyrisus will appear. The Oneiromancer will suggest going into Dreamland together to solve Cyrisus' fear of combat.

Note: If you're using Magic for the upcoming fight and were on the Lunar Spellbook, don't forget to switch back to Standard Spellbook/Ancient Spellbook (your choice; Standard Spellbook is closer, done by praying to the Astral Altar).
The Oneiromancer will give you a dream vial. Fill this with water. The nearest water source is the house west of the bank.

You need to obtain some goutweed, either by growing a gout tuber, or by stealing it from the troll kitchens from Eadgar's Ruse quest. (If you go back to the troll kitchen, it is recommended to grab two goutweed in total if you plan on doing Dragon Slayer II.)
Use the goutweed with the vial.
Use a hammer with an astral rune, and then, use a pestle and mortar on the result—add this to the potion to get a dream potion.
Items required: Dream potion, a tinderbox, armour, a weapon, and good food, Seal of Passage.

Using the lectern at the north of the arena is the only way to leave the following fight. Use of all teleports, including the ring of life and escape crystals, will not work. Players should prepare to use the right-click leave option during the fight. If you die you will always lose your Seal of Passage and will have to speak with Brundt to get a replacement.
Warning: As the area is an instance, any items dropped on the ground will be lost upon death or leaving the instance.
In the upcoming fight, four bosses must be defeated in a row, without the use of prayers.

It is highly recommended to use magic for the fight. All four bosses have very low magic defence, and magic will hit consistently even if you wear melee gear to reduce incoming damage. An excellent strategy is to use a trident of the seas, but Iban Blast, Warped sceptre or Blood Rush are also very good options. Strong melee armour, a shield with high ranged defence, and plenty of high-healing food are recommended. A halberd can also be brought to safespot the second and third bosses if desired. Players may want to drink a dose of divine battlemage potion or super defence potion prior to entering. For Ironmen who lack access to high-healing food, it is possible to switch to a PvP World before starting the fight so as to be able to use blighted food, as it will be extremely unlikely that the player will meet a PKer upon switching, provided they do so within the Dream Hall.
Note: Remember to bring the Seal of Passage.

Go to the Dream Hall, the large building on the west side of Lunar Isle, where Cyrisus will be waiting for you. Light the brazier with a tinderbox and talk to Cyrisus to enter the dream world. During the fight, a bar showing Cyrisus' Courage will be shown and he will occasionally attack or use Vengeance Other on you.
You will then have to fight, in order, four monsters representing Cyrisus' fear:

The Inadequacy (level 343). This is by far the hardest part of the fight, so don't worry if you use most of your food on it. The Inadequacy will use powerful and accurate melee and ranged attacks, but will only use ranged if the player is outside of melee range. It will also summon Doubts, which should be ignored in favour of defeating the boss as quickly as possible. Magic will hit dependably even with a negative magic attack bonus. Use available special attacks, like from a dragon dagger to deal damage quickly. Make sure to keep your health above 30 and the boss will eventually go down.

The Everlasting (level 223). Hits high, but can be easily safespotted by standing directly west of the lectern on the north side of the arena. Note that due to its size the player cannot walk through the Everlasting, so be careful not to get trapped between it and the side of the arena. After it is killed, the next boss may spawn in a position that allows it to attack a player in the safespot. To avoid this, run out during the Everlasting's death animation so the next boss spawns further away, or lure it away before killing it and return to the safespot on the other side of lectern. Finally, this boss can be kited (especially with a stamina potion).
The Untouchable (level 274). Similar to the Everlasting but with much lower health, and can also be safespotted with Magic or a halberd. This boss can also be kited.
The Illusive (level 108). Not much of a threat, though it will burrow into the ground and reappear somewhere else after two successful hits from the player, forcing the player to chase it around.
After defeating the Illusive, Cyrisus will finally conquer his fear and stomp it to death.

He asks you to speak to Sanfew, who is working on a purification ritual.

Sanfew can be found to the south, upstairs in the big octagonal Herblore shop marked with a herb. Tell him that you were sent to help, and Sanfew will request raw rat meat, raw bear meat, raw beef and raw chicken, to be dipped in the Cauldron of Thunder for the ritual.

The Cauldron of Thunder is located in Taverley Dungeon. Head south of Taverley and down the ladder. Enchant the meat by using each piece on the Cauldron of Thunder inside the room, and you will notice they will turn blue.

Once you have enchanted all four meats, return to Sanfew, who will take them and thank the player for bringing the druids one step closer to reclaiming their stone circle. He then asks the player to speak again to Kaqemeex. Return to Kaqemeex, who will teach the player the basics of the Herblore skill.

Food, armour and climbing boots
Note: Failing the obstacles, though uncommon, deals 1-5 damage, depending on your current HP.
Make your way to Trollheim using any of the routes below.

The fastest and safest method to get to Trollheim is to teleport near the entrance of the God Wars Dungeon with one of Ghommal's hilts, rewarded from completing Combat Achievements. The hilt's 'Trollheim' option will place the player near the boulder/little crack, at which point they may run south to meet up with the thrower troll portion of the Burthorpe route.

If using a games necklace or a combat bracelet teleport to Burthorpe Games Room or the Warriors' Guild, respectively, and follow the mountain path out of the north-western corner of Burthorpe. Go south at the fork in the path to Tenzing's house. If you don't already have climbing boots, buy some here from Tenzing for 12 coins. Wear the climbing boots, and climb over the stile in his back yard, following the path north. At the next junction, climb over the rocks, follow the path, and go west at the next fork climbing over rocks as required. Head north to the Secret Entrance that will place you on the lower level of the Troll Stronghold.
If using a Slayer ring or a Dramen staff, you must have climbing boots already as you won't be able to reach Tenzing from this path.

For the Slayer ring path, teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or use the Fairy ring with (code ajr) to teleport outside the Dungeon entrance. Head north-east to a narrow passage and climb over some rocks (climbing boots required). Head north to the Secret Entrance that will place you on the lower level of the Troll Stronghold.

Note: If you didn't rescue Eadgar during the Troll Stronghold quest, you will need to do so before the following steps, or he will not appear in the cave. You may check the quest log to see whether it says "I've rescued Godric and Mad Eadgar". To rescue him, head to the Stronghold's prison on the bottom level, and pickpocket Berry the sleeping guard to get the key to his cell. If you are unable to pickpocket him, you may have already freed Eadgar (he will still appear in the cell even after being freed). Unlock the gate to free him.

From the Secret Entrance, head north along the corridor, past the jail cells and sleeping guards and take the stone staircase in the north-east corner. Head south and you'll see four Troll Cooks here – one of them will be called Burntmeat. Speak to him, and he will offer to tell you about goutweed in exchange for a human to cook in his stew.
Tip: Consider doing the first section of the Troll Romance quest while in the area (the three trolls are just to the north-west of the kitchen).

Take the stairs next to Burntmeat and you will be on the upper level of the Stronghold. From here, follow the corridor north until you see the exit on the wall to the east, exit the Stronghold and run south-east to reach the base of Trollheim on the west side.

At the summit of Trollheim, enter the unmarked cave entrance on the southern side. Speak to Eadgar and the player will inform him of your quest and Burntmeat's request for a human stew. Eadgar has a plan to trick him, but first he needs a parrot.

Head to the Ardougne Zoo, and talk to Parroty Pete near the northern wolf enclosure. Ask him when they added the parrot aviary, and then ask what they like to eat. He will tell you their favourite food is pineapple chunks, and that someone recently replaced their drinking water with vodka as a prank.

Use (don't eat) your pineapple chunks on the vodka to make alco-chunks, then use them on the aviary hatch on the west side of the parrot cage. You'll obtain a drunk parrot, with the player telling Parroty Pete that you will take it to the vet.
Do not drop the parrot or it will fly away. Once you have visited Eadgar with the parrot, you will be able to retrieve it from him if lost.
While in Ardougne, it's also a good idea to pick up your logs, tinderbox, grain, raw chicken, pestle and mortar, and unfinished ranarr potion from the bank.

Take the parrot to Eadgar. You need to make it look like a human, taste like a human, smell like a human, and talk like a human. (You must do these steps in order; however, you may hand in the items after hiding the parrot.)
Go back to Eadgar using your route of choice, to talk about the rest of his plan before proceeding to the next step.
If you pick a Thistle now, you can dry it on a fire on the way back to Eadgar. Scroll down to the truth serum section to learn how to acquire a troll thistle.

Talk like a human - Go back to the Troll Stronghold, and head north through the corridor, then climb down the stone staircase, and unlock the prison door (no key required), finally climb down the second stone staircase to arrive at the prison cells. Go a bit further west and hide your parrot under the rack just north of the cells. Alternatively, use the fairy rings (code ajr) or a slayer ring to teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and follow the north-east passage to the climbable rocks, then open the secret door to the north and you will be directly south of the jail cells. Then, head north until you get to the stone staircase, and then, head west and hide the parrot under the rack north of the cells.
You will come back for the parrot later. Make sure that you check your Quest Log and talk to Eadgar before teleporting away.
Look/Taste like a human - Teleport out of Trollheim and get your 10 grain, 2 logs, tinderbox, 5 raw chicken, pestle and mortar, and unfinished ranarr potion.
Note for Ultimate Ironmen: You can make multiple trips with the items if you do not have the inventory space available to bring them in one trip.

Smell like a human - Go to Taverley. You will see Tegid washing robes in the lake. Talk to him, and ask for a dirty robe. Then, threaten him with talking to Sanfew or chopping down trees to get one. After this, if needed, pick 10 grain just south of Tegid to bring to Eadgar. Take all items to Eadgar and he will make the human substitute for you.
Consider doing the middle sections of the Troll Romance quest now to save time running back and forth.
Note: If you boosted your Herblore to start the quest, a level of 31 is needed to make the troll truth potion.

After you've done all of this, Eadgar will tell you that you need to make a troll truth potion so that Burntmeat won't lie to you about Goutweed. Look near the grass patches around Eadgar's hill until you find a tiny thistle growing in one of them and pick it for a Troll thistle. It may take you a while, but keep searching. If unable to find it, one may find it helpful to world hop and check the grass directly north or directly west of the cave. The Thistle's name is yellow when displayed at the top-left of the game window.

Once you've found the troll thistle, make a fire with your extra log and cook it to get a dried thistle. If you forgot to bring an extra log and/or tinderbox, there is a fire in the cave between the arena and Trollheim. Then, grind it with a pestle and mortar to make ground thistle. Finally, boost your Herblore level (if necessary) and add the ground thistle to your unfinished ranarr potion to make a troll potion. (If your character doesn't want to, check your quest journal to re-sync your progress).

Talk to Eadgar again. He will take the potion off of you and tell you that the parrot has had enough by now, so you can get it back from the troll jail. At this point it's recommended that you bank and grab some food for the next part of the quest. Go back to the prison cells in the Troll Stronghold, either through the back door to the jail via Fairy rings, code ajr or with the Slayer ring teleport (bring climbing boots). If you chose not to bank, head back to the stronghold then north through the corridor, then climb down the stone staircase, and unlock the prison door. Finally, climb down the second stone staircase to arrive at the prison cells, search the rack to retrieve the parrot, and then return to Eadgar.

After you give the parrot to Eadgar, he will give you the Fake man. Go back to the cooks in the stronghold by going south of the entrance and then down the stairs, and give the dummy to Burntmeat. He'll give you a piece of burnt meat as a reward (which you can discard as it serves no purpose in the quest). He'll also tell you that the Goutweed is kept in the storeroom and that you can find the key by searching the Kitchen Drawers.
Consider doing the first section of the Troll Romance quest if not already previously started.

Open and then search the stone drawers in the south-eastern corner of the room to find the storeroom key, then go down the stairs just to the north. Down the hallway is a room with patrolling guards. If one of them sees you, it will throw a rock at you, dealing 0-6 damage, and you will be sent back to the entrance. Protection prayers do not block this damage.

The troll guards walk in cycles of 4, repeating. The easiest way to get a Goutweed is to click the crate with the Goutweed with run on as the two guards closest to the door are about to pass each other. Two of the 4 cycles should succeed using this method, and there is a 4 tile window where you can do this. If you get caught the cycle does not change like with Sorceress's Garden so you can keep trying. If done correctly this should result in a Goutweed every 2 runs. If you prefer you can just click the crate and try to brute force it, players may expect to obtain somewhere in the vicinity of one Goutweed per 5-10 runs using this method. Since you will be running a lot and being thrown out a lot, it is recommended to bring energy-restoring items.

If you wish to utilise the intended mechanics, the best way is to use the two most eastern guards as an indicator of when to move to the second safespot. To do this turn on your run and wait until one of the two guards rounds the northern corner of the boxes that they rotate around. As soon as this happens run to the second safespot. Note that the darker coloured troll patrolling the small section of boxes must also be avoided. Once in the second safespot simply run to the one of the safespots adjacent to the crate when the guard that comes north and closest to you turns west, and then click on the Goutweed crate.

The next way to do this is to use the safespots, which are dead ends surrounded by three crates. Time your movement and run to the first safespot, then wait for your chance to run to the second. You can use the position of the troll guards as an indication of when to move, as the placements of the guards will repeat after one or two cycles. Wait at the second safespot until you get the chance to run to the Goutweed crate and search it. Be careful not to simply click search Goutweed Crate as this will get you stuck on the sleeping troll instead of going up to the crate. Make sure you click on the spot adjacent to the crate, and then click search Goutweed crate. You'll be kicked out after you get one piece of Goutweed. Also, if you plan to do Dream Mentor or Dragon Slayer II at any point, it is recommended to get two extra Goutweed as it is a required item in those quests (Note: You can grab multiple Goutweed if you are quick enough to skip the dialogue and click on the crate).
Give the Goutweed to Sanfew back in Taverley by clicking on the "ask other question" option NOT the "talk about sanfew serum". This will complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Talk to Charlie the zoo keeper at Ardougne Zoo. He is at the south-west part of the zoo, just south of the scorpion cage. He'll tell you about a delivery of a northern ferret who managed to escape his cage while unloading. He will ask you to contact a huntsman called Nickolaus who agreed to capture another ferret, but he hasn't heard from him for some time. He will ask you to look for him. Finally, ask "Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?", and upon Charlie's answer, the quest begins. Charlie will tell you to start around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold.

Head to Eagles' Peak, which is west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. If you have access to the fairy ring network, code AKQ gets you there relatively fast. You can also use a necklace of passage and choose the second option "The outpost" and head north-west. At the base of the mountain on the north-west side, you should find a tent, but Nickolaus is no where to be found. Inspect the books on the ground, and you will receive a bird book. Try to read the book, and a metal feather will fall out of the book.

Follow the path up to the peak, which starts on the south side of the mountain, or use the Agility shortcut right beside the tent. At the top is a door (disguised as a rocky outcrop) with an inscription of a feather on the north side.

Use the metal feather from the book to open the door. Then, go inside. A few steps into the cave, there is a feathered journal on the north side which contains some interesting info, but it is not critical to the quest. The passages split to three tunnels to other areas and another metal door (used later) and to a ledge over a large open area. Go the southern route where you see the giant feathers laying on the ground. Nickolaus is across the ledge, and you must click to shout to him. A cutscene will start when you shout to Nickolaus, who is trapped across a chasm by a giant eagle that will not let him out of the cave. Continue through the dialogue and ask if there is any way you can help.
10 eagle feathers, swamp tar, a yellow dye, and 50 coins.

Nickolaus tells you to make a disguise for him. Talk to him about eagles—mention that he is trapped and offer to help. Gather 10 eagle feathers (piles of giant feathers can be found near the area after you speak to Nickolaus and throughout the cave).

Teleport to Varrock and go to the Fancy Dress Shop in the south-east corner (inside of the gated area). Ask specifically about a couple of bird costumes, and Asyff will make you two giant eagle costumes using the 10 giant feathers, swamp tar, a yellow dye, and 50 coins. Each costume consists of an eagle cape and a fake beak.
With the two sets of disguises, return to the Eagles' Peak dungeon and shout to Nickolaus again. He wants you to bring the clothes to him.

Go to the south-west extremity of the dungeon, and then take the east path. You will find a large stone door with an eagle marking, which leads to Nickolaus. You cannot open the door in this state. Three feathers (bronze, silver, and gold) are required to be able to open the door.

West of the eagle door is a tunnel. The tunnel leads to a room with a stone pedestal on which sits a bronze feather. Attempt to take the feather, and the obvious net trap will lift it upwards. Now, operate all four winches in each of the corners, causing the net trap to break. The pedestal will fall down, and it is possible to take the bronze feather. Leave and follow the directions to the silver feather cave.
Note: You cannot operate the winches before the net trap has activated.

A bit further north, a second tunnel leads into another dungeon room, this time with an empty pedestal. You will need to have 27 Hunter to successfully inspect the empty pedestal. Inspect the pedestal, and a partial trail will appear. Follow the trail, and inspect the heap of rocks in the direction the trail points to. If you are correct, the trail from the pedestal is shown to the heap of rocks. Investigate rocks near where the trail ends—if correct, another trail will appear. Repeat until the trail leads to a tunnel in the wall. Click the tunnel in the wall, and a level-13 kebbit will attack. Kill it, or use the right-click "threaten" option, and it will drop the silver feather. If you lose or destroy the feather, you will not have to kill or threaten the kebbit again; simply search the tunnel to reclaim it.
(Note: If the puzzle gets messed up, there is a reset lever outside of the chamber.)

The third tunnel entrance is in the north-east corner of the main dungeon. You need to retrieve the gold feather from the pedestal at the end of a long corridor due west from the entrance, but the way is blocked by metal eagles and wing-shaped stone gates. The birds can be moved by putting bird seeds in the bird feeder close to the point where you need the eagle to go to. The eagle wings can be moved by pulling a lever. There are four levers and five metal eagles.

To start, take-from the birdseed holder to get odd bird seed near the entrance to place in bird feeders. You'll need six to finish the puzzle. Follow the visual guide below which lists the sequence or the steps outlined below the visual guide.

You need to clear access to the north-west lever, by operating the south-west and centre levers. The north-west lever unlocks the eastern part of the area and gives access to the east lever. Although operating this lever clears a critical eagle wing blocking the corridor to the golden feather, there are still blocking objects from the actions to get to the east lever. Use the table above to remove any remaining objects blocking the corridor.

After collecting all three feathers (bronze, silver, and gold), use each feather on the eagle door to open it. Walk to Nickolaus and wear the full eagle disguise to "walk past" the eagle guarding Nickolaus. Not wearing a disguise will cause the eagle to hit you for a small amount of damage.
After a short conversation, Nickolaus requests you to meet him back at the camp.
A bit further east are three huge eagles (polar, jungle, and desert). After the quest, they can be used as a transport system to the other Hunter areas from the South Woodland Hunter Area.

Go back out of the Eagles' Peak dungeon and go down the rock climb. On the ground where the tent you were at before is, talk to Nickolaus and he'll teach you how to catch ferrets. You do not need a box trap for this part of the quest. If you click on the cutscene where you retrieve the box trap, you will not catch the ferret. If you accidentally release the ferret, you are able to catch a new one with the box trap Nickolaus has given you.
Go back to Ardougne Zoo with the ferret you caught. Talk to Charlie who gives the quest reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

In the northern chamber is an inactive water wheel, with two water controls to the west and east of it. Turn the east water control and then the west one to change them both to green (this must be done in order, turn the west one back if you turned it first). After this, pull the lever next to the water wheel. The water wheel should now be spinning.

Next you will need to repair the bellows, found in the eastern chamber. If you did not bring leather and a needle, they may be found in a crate in the north-western part of the central room, and a stacked crate in the western room respectively.
Fix the bellows with a spool of thread and leather (20 Crafting), then pull the lever next to it. The bellows should begin pumping air.

Head into the western cavern and attempt to mine an elemental rock (20 Mining). The rock springs to life, yells, and attacks you. Kill the earth elemental, and pick up the elemental ore that it drops. The elementals walking around do not count; it must be an elemental awoken by an attempt to mine them.
Tip: Kill two more if you want to save time for Elemental Workshop II, or three more if you also want a Mind shield after completing that quest.
Tip: You may choose to kill one of each elemental in the workshop to complete an easy Kandarin Diary task. You must kill a regular earth elemental for this, not the ones that are mined first.

Finally, head back to the central chamber. Search the boxes north-east of the hatch to obtain a stone bowl. Fill it with lava from the lava trough in the southern chamber, then use it on the furnace to the east in the same chamber. The inside of the furnace should now glow orange.

Proceed to use the elemental ore, along with four coal, on the furnace to obtain an elemental metal (20 Smithing). If this does not work, ensure that you used the elemental ore on the furnace rather than the coal, and that both the water wheel and bellows were successfully activated in the previous steps.

With the slashed book in your inventory, use the elemental metal on the workbench in the centre to make an elemental shield (20 Smithing). If you are unable to craft the shield, destroy the slashed book and obtain a new one from the bookcase.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Tip: You may choose to create more shields after the quest, returning with the battered key, slashed book and 4 coal to smelt with the elemental ore. The shield may also be sold on the Grand Exchange for Elemental shield coins gold, costing Coal*4 coins to create.

To begin, you need to go to the Exam Centre south of the Digsite. In the south eastern corner of the building, there are two chests. Search the bookcase two tiles down (the one attached both to the wall and another bookcase) to find a beaten book with a scroll in it as a bookmark.
