Go to Ali the Hag north-west of the kebab seller. Talk to her twice to give her the snake basket and Ugthanki dung to receive the hag's poison in exchange.
Use the hag's poison on the table with a beer in the bar.
Talk to Ali the Operator.
Prepare for battle and talk to the Menaphite Leader (just outside the tent).
Kill the Tough Guy (level 75) (safespot behind bush). He drops a willow blackjack.
Talk to a villager. (Ok I'll get to it.)
Talk to the Bandit Leader wandering around the northern magic carpet station.
Kill the bandit champion (level 70) (safespot behind chair in house to the east). He drops an adamant scimitar (if you have a willow blackjack in your inventory).
Talk to a villager.
Talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in village centre.
Return to Ali Morrisane (with whom you started the quest). (No, I'm really too busy.)
Congratulations, quest complete!
My Arm's Big Adventure

Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid, located just south-west of the Emir's Arena teleport. He will claim to be the greatest salesman in the world, and when the player questions this, he will complain about his lack of staff. Agree to help him, and he will ask you to find Ali in Pollnivneach, his nephew who had agreed to join his stall as an assistant.

If you haven't already, buy the Kharidian headpiece and fake beard from Ali Morrisane. You may choose to combine them into a desert disguise now to save inventory space, as this will be required later in the quest. You may also consider purchasing waterskins and desert clothing to protect from the desert heat.
Go to the little village of Pollnivneach, which is south-east of Shantay Pass. 200 coins will get you there on the magic carpet, which completes an easy Desert Diary task.
Note: If you see the huge wall, you must go east to enter the village.

Head to the bar in the south-eastern corner of the village. Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman if you don't already have some, and then talk to Drunken Ali, who will ask for beer in return for information. Use each beer on him, completing each dialogue before continuing. He will tell you that Ali Morrisane's nephew is in trouble with the gangs, but you won't get any information out of them while they are feuding.
Head west of the bar to a purple and yellow tent, and talk to any Menaphite Thug (not Ali the Operator). They will mention that the feud started after the Bandits stole a camel from them.
Talk to any bandit in the north part of the town, who will blame the feud on the Menaphites stealing a camel from them.

Talk to Ali the Camel Man at the building north-west of the bar, south of the kebab store, and ask to buy two camels. Offer him 500 coins to receive two camel receipts. Return to any Menaphite thug in the southern part of town, and then any Bandit in the northern part of town, to give each receipt. Both gangs will be outraged at the offering.
Talk to Ali the Operator by the purple tent south-west of Pollnivneach, and ask him if you can join his gang. He will ask the player to pickpocket 3 villagers to prove themselves.
1st villager – Simply head out and pickpocket any villager. You will always fail unless you have spoken with Ali the Operator.

2nd villager – Go and talk to a Street urchin in or around the bar, and pay him 10 coins to distract a villager, then quickly pickpocket the villager with the flashing arrow above his head. Make sure that the Street urchin is nearby one of the villagers, otherwise he will tell you that there is none around to distract. You must approach the villager from behind. If it fails, you will not lose your payment: talk to the urchin to try again.

3rd villager – Talk to Ali the Operator again and ask for advice: he will give you a blackjack. Equip it, then lure a villager (into a secluded area in an empty building), knock them out with the blackjack, and finally pick their pocket (all options are right click).

Return to Ali the Operator, who now wants you to steal the mayor's wife's jewels from the safe in their villa. He will give you keys to the front door. Combine the fake beard with the Kharidian headpiece to make a desert disguise, then equip it and your gloves. If you did not buy these from Ali Morrisane, you can get them from the Market seller at the general store icon on the map. The villa is north-east of the bar; on the huge cactus just outside, click Hide behind.
When the dialogue appears and tells you that it is safe to go in since nobody is home, use your key on the door and go in.

On the , search the landscape picture hanging beside the bed to discover the safe. The numbers on the safe progress from 1-9 (clockwise), and you must click 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, on the dial to unlock it and take the jewels. This solution is the Fibonacci sequence, and you would have found a clue by searching the bed for a note which gives the first 5 numbers of the sequence.
Note: If you do not have at least one inventory space open, you will have to enter this sequence again.
Give the jewels to Ali the Operator. For your final task, he wants you to root out a traitor within the gang.
Talk to a Menaphite Thug gang member about it, who will suggest that the traitor must be Traitorous Ali. Return to Ali the Operator who will ask the player to quietly kill him.

Talk to Ali the Barman to find out that the beer on the table belongs to the traitor. Go talk to Ali the Hag up the hill to the west of the town, who will agree to make a poison for you if you can get her a snake.
Now, go around the back of the pub, and put some coins in the snake charmer's money pot. He will give you a snake charm and a snake basket.

Use (not Play) the snake charm on a desert snake, which can be found north of Ali the Operator's tent. You may fail to charm the snake causing it to attack you, simply kill it and then try again on another snake.
Note: You may have a snake charm already in your bank if you have completed Ratcatchers. You may receive another now if you have lost it.

Once you've brought the snake back to Ali the Hag, she will tell you the second item she needs is fresh camel dung. Go to Ali the Kebab seller, located just north-west of the well in the centre of town, and ask for his red hot sauce. Take this to the camel shop, and use it on the food trough. A pile of dung will appear after a few seconds; if it's green, repeat until you get brown dung. Use a bucket on it to obtain the desired Ugthanki dung.
Tip: Consider gathering 3 more pieces of dung for My Arm's Big Adventure, and 1 for Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf (where there is a 1/25 chance to need one).
Take the dung to Ali the Hag and she'll give you some poison to kill Traitorous Ali.
Go to the pub, use the poison on the table with the beer, and then go back to Ali the Operator.
The Feud - pouring hot sauce.png|Pouring the red hot sauce on the trough.
The Feud - poisonining drink.png|Pouring the hag's poison onto Traitorous Ali's drink.

Prepared for a fight, talk to Ali the Operator, who wants you to meet the Menaphite Leader. Speak to him outside the tent to discover that the Menaphites have world domination plans. After the player declines his offer to join them, the leader will summon a level 75 Tough Guy to attack you. You can safespot him behind the table inside the Menaphite Tent.

After defeating him, talk to a villager; they are angry with you for upsetting the balance of power and will tell you that you need to deal with the Bandit Leader too. He's just north-west of the village by the Rug Merchant.

Talk to the bandit leader, who will refuse to leave unless you can defeat their strongest warrior in battle, summoning a level 70 bandit champion. There is a safespot in the house directly east; run to the north side of the table and manoeuvre him until he is directly behind the table and beside the chair, then run to the other side of the chair. Upon defeat, he will drop an adamant scimitar if the player has a willow blackjack in their inventory.
Talk to the villagers, who will still be unimpressed by your actions so far and tell you to talk to the Mayor if you are looking for a reward.

Talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in the centre of the village. He will be a little more grateful about the results of your deeds, and explain that he smuggled Ali Morrisane's nephew out of the town after he angered the gangs.
Finally, return to Ali Morrisane, who reveals that the entire quest was an elaborate scheme to get the player involved in Pollnivneach 'tourism'.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Ensure that you have 2 empty inventory slots.
Talk to Lady Servil just outside of the north-east corner of the [[Tree Gnome Village (location)
Go to the house in the most north-eastern corner of the area and search the chest for Khazard armour.
Equip the armour and head south into the prison (do not unequip the armour inside!).
Head inside the south-east room where the jails are located.
Talk to the [[Head Guard (Fight Arena)

Go to outside, and head to the bar, located in the west and buy a Khali brew for five coins from Khazard barman (I'd like a Khali brew please.) (if you didn't talk to the right guard, the option is not there).
Go back to the jail and talk to the guard to get the keys.
Prepare for a fight. Ranged, mage, or a halberd are recommended to safespot, or the Protect from Melee prayer.
Use the keys on [[Sammy Servil

Note: During any cutscene dialogue, between opponents, you may click away and resupply with no need for the Khazard armour to re-enter the prison. All enemies may be safespotted using various skeletons around the arena.
Kill the Khazard Ogre (level 63) (if the fight doesn't start, talk to Justin).
You will be locked up again. Talk to your cellmate, Hengrad, to begin the next fight.
Kill the Khazard scorpion (level 44).

Kill Bouncer (level 137). Warning: Once you begin the fight with General Khazard you are unable to reenter the arena. Dying in the arena after this point will most likely make the grave inaccessible, thus making them only retrievable from [[Death (NPC)
Kill General Khazard (level 142) or run away through the door in the south-east corner of the arena (or just run north until he's not aggressive).
Return to Lady Servil.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Head just south-west of the Ardougne Monastery and talk to Lady Servil by the north-east corner of the Tree Gnome Village maze. She will explain that her family has been kidnapped by General Khazard and his group of mercenaries and forced to fight in their arena. The player will agree to help rescue them.

Head east to a group of buildings located south of the Ardougne Monastery. In the most north-eastern house, search the chest to obtain Khazard armour. Equip both pieces and head south to the prison, which forms the south and east boundaries of the arena.
Note: Multiple sets of armour may be obtained using the drop trick.
The guards will only let you into the prison wearing the Khazard armour. Once inside, do not remove it, or the guards will not speak to you. You can wear anything in any of the other slots.
5 coins
Sammy Servil (the boy in the purple shirt) is located in the northernmost cell of the east wing of the prison. Ask him where the cell keys are, and he will explain the Head Guard has them.

Head to the south-eastern corner of the jail and talk to the Head Guard by the staircase. He will mention his cravings for Khali brew and let it slip that last time he had too many, he fell asleep on the job.

Head to the bar found west of the western entrance to the jail, and purchase Khali brew from the Khazard barman for five coins. If there is no option to, you must finish the dialogue with the head guard.
Return to the head guard and give him the brew, and he will quickly get drunk, handing the player the keys when asked.
Ensure you have your combat equipment and prepare for three enemies you must fight in a row (all safespottable).
Use the keys on Sammy's prison door to free him and a cutscene will begin, in which Sammy enters the main arena in search of his father Justin, who is being attacked by a Khazard ogre.
Note: The dwarven multicannon cannot be set up in the arena.
Note: Throughout the fights, you may teleport out if you run into trouble. Speaking to the Khazard Guard by the door of the prison will take you back into the arena.
You must kill the level 63 Khazard Ogre attacking Sammy's father. There is a very easy safespot
behind a nearby skeleton, whereby you may use Magic, Ranged or a halberd for an easy fight. All of the following enemies use melee, so you can alternately use Protect from Melee.
Note: If a fight sequence does not initiate, speak to Justin in order to continue, but note that if the ogre has already spawned, a second one will appear if you talk to Justin.
After defeating the ogre, General Khazard will appear and order his guards to lock you away after suggesting that if you fight in his arena, he might let the Servils go.
Talk to your cellmate Hengrad, and after a brief conversation the guard will bring you back to the arena.
The second fight is with a level 44 non poisonous Khazard scorpion. Note that it will reach you quickly, so you should immediately run to the same safespot or activate Protect from Melee.

After defeating the scorpion, Khazard will release Bouncer the level 137 hellhound. You will need high healing food if not using the safespot or Protect from Melee at a low level, but otherwise the strategy is the same.

After killing the hellhound, a level 142 General Khazard will vow to make you pay for killing his puppy, and then attack you. This fight is optional, and the quest progresses the same if you leave now via the door (use its Quick-escape option to avoid needing to confirm you wish to leave). The same strategies as before are effective against the general.
Return to Lady Servil and she will tell you that her son and husband are safe and recovering at home.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Servius at the of the Sunrise Palace to start the quest. (Yes.)
After the cutscene, make your way to the Twilight Temple. Search the chest at the Tower of Ascension for the emissary robes if needed.
Equip the emissary robes and enter the temple.
After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs and choose the passcode "Final Dawn".
Enter the basement, and head east toward the backroom while avoiding the Emissary Enforcer.
Enter the backroom and watch the cutscene.
Search the large bed (south room) for a [[Key (The Final Dawn)
Open the drawer in either the south or north room for the canvas piece.
Use the canvas piece on the [[Painting (Twilight Temple)
Inspect the painting and enter a hidden passage.
Picklock the blue chest for an emissary scroll. To open the chest, simply move the tumblers by clicking on slots above them.

The fastest way to brute force the lock is to simply click confirm, see if any show up as green on the right, and if not, move everything up by one. This will take no more than eight tries for the final combination.
Fight the Emissary Enforcer (180 HP AoE melee):
You cannot teleport, pray, or change gear. If you die here, your gravestone will appear at the Twilight Temple entrance.
Step back during normal attacks, and step sideways when he shouts Traitor! or Thief!
Pick up and read the emissary scroll.
Return to Queen Zyanyi at the top floor of the Sunrise Palace.
Go behind the safe house south of the western bank in Civitas illa Fortis.
Talk to Captain Vibia.
Inspect the southernmost window on the east side of the safe house.
Enter the window and use your chosen bones/meat on the dog.
Pet the dog for the door's passcode, "GUS".
Grab the sack of potatoes; empty the sack.
Take the knife nearby.
Head up to the middle floor and pick up the coin purse.
Empty the purse, then head up to the top floor.
Use the knife on the diseased off-green potted plant for a [[Branch (The Final Dawn)
Use the empty coin purse on the pot of sand to fill it up.
Use the branch and sandy coin purse on each other to create the makeshift blackjack.
Show the sack and blackjack to Captain Vibia to initiate a cutscene.
Search Janus for a key which initiates another cutscene.
Agree to go with Queen Zyanyi to Cam Torum. (Yes, let's go.)
Speak to Attala in the Cam Torum market.
Enter Teumo's house east of the bank.
Head upstairs and pick up the beer.
Return downstairs and use the beer on Galna.
Enter Teumo's basement. Search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one of each of the following beverages: steamforge brew, dwarven stout, beer, and wizard's mind bomb.
Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (indicated with "steam")
Place the stout directly east of this barrel (indicated with "black liquid")
Place the beer on the northern barrel (indicated with "smells like a standard Gielinorian pub")
Place the mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (indicated with "bubbling")
Drink the beer on the barrel south of the staircase (indicated with "empty"), then place the beer glass on it.
Inspect the fireplace and pull a hidden lever.
Climb through the hole in the wall in the south-eastern room to initiate a cutscene.
Return to Servius and Attala in the basement and talk to them.
Head to the bank and prepare for a fight against two level 160 cultists.
Head north to Neypotzli to have Eyatlalli give you a keystone fragment.
Head through the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns, using the keystone to pinpoint the exact tile to resonate with the key.
Head to the Ancient Prison and use it in the room to the south-east in the section.
Touch the glowing symbol to initiate a cutscene.
Kill Lucius and Chimalli.
Alternate Protect from Magic/Ranged. Step into golden circles to avoid Lucius' special, and avoid Chimalli's fire arrows by stepping away from where they will land.
Once one of them are defeated, the other will start to pierce prayer and perform special attacks more frequently.
It is recommended to kill Lucius first, since Chimalli's special attack is much easier to avoid, especially if using melee.
Talk to Attala.
Head to Tal Teklan. Servius is north-east of the Quetzal Transport System landing site, east of the altar.
The Crypt of Tonali is a fair distance to the south-east, just west of Kastori.
Enter the Crypt of Tonali to initiate a cutscene.
Kill six waves of cultists; allies can be healed by using food on them. If all Tonali warriors and archers helping you die, the waves reset.
Complete all six waves successfully to initiate a cutscene. The fight will not start until after all the dialogue.
Kill Ennius Tullus (380 HP). He uses melee attacks (pray Protect from Melee), and can only be attacked with melee, using three special attacks:
Sunfire Blast: Circles will begin glowing around the area, indicating safespots for his upcoming attack.
Sunfire Strike: A row or column of sunfire through him. If the player is diagonally across, he will likewise launch one across himself.
Sunfire Smite: Disables the player's overhead prayers.
Upon reaching 0 health, he will enter the enrage phase, healing 120 health, attacking faster, and Sunfire Strike is enhanced to cover three rows/columns at a time.
After the cutscene, descend into the Tonali Cavern.
Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the northern end of the cavern.
Inspect the Strange Platform, as this unlocks an entrance from the surface directly east of Tal Teklan.
Proceed north slightly, and descend east into the sun puzzle room.
Search all the urns for Kuhu essence.
The altars are numbered 1 to 8, with the first being the north-east altar and the next number in sequence going clockwise.
Inspect the sun statue for your puzzle; the wording will determine where you and Prince Itzla need to be positioned (The third number/word is not used):
Oma 2
Naui 4
Kuli 5
Chaki 6
Koma 7
Ueai 8
Makti 10
For example, if the statue states "Naui Koma-Makti", Itzla needs to be placed by the fourth altar, while you need to go to the seventh altar.
Inspect the sun statue for the next engraving.
After successfully imbuing an altar three times, the puzzle is complete.
Descend west into the moon puzzle room.
Use pressure plates to move Prince Itzla and suppress a set of flames.
Search the old tools and obtain a knife blade.
Pull the tree roots around the room for some ancient roots.
Use the knife blade on the roots for some root kindling.
Count the total amount of lit braziers from stepping on both pressure plates

Count the lit braziers while Itzla is standing on one pressure plate, tell him to move, count the lit braziers. Add the two numbers up, and that's how many kindlings you need to add to the statue. The total number will not change until you add the correct amount of kindlings.
Deposit the equivalent amount of root kindling in the moon statue.
Doing so correctly three times will complete the puzzle.
Leave the puzzle through the portal.
Follow Prince Itzla to unlock the northern doors.
Return to the surface and resupply for the final fight if needed; ranged style is recommended.
Return to the entrance to Mokhaiotl via Lift Platform (Crypt of Tonali) then traveling north. Enter the door to initiate a cutscene.
Defeat Augur Metzli. She has 600 Hitpoints, and uses special attacks every three attacks, after which she sometimes switches from ranged to magic and vice versa.
Dodge flame walls via a gap or gold symbol to teleport to a safe area.
She also uses the same special attacks used by Lucius and Ennius earlier. She may do them multiple times in a row.

Upon reaching 10% of her health, she will enter the enrage phase. She will target the quadrant that the player and Itzla are on. A white portal will additionally spawn to move to the next quadrant, avoiding damage from the attack.
After defeating Metzli, make your way to the next entrance at the northern end by using the stairs or jumping across the pillar (requires 75 Agility).

Enter the final chamber to initiate a cutscene. Note that clicking elsewhere during the dialogue will reset the player back outside the room. Should this happen, you will have to watch the cutscene again.
After the cutscene, search the skeleton next to the entrance for a [[Stone tablet (The Final Dawn)#Mokhaiotl
Inspect the Sun Statue and Moon Statue.
Interact with the final chamber to return to the Crypt of Tonali.
Finish the final conversation with Prince Itzla.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Speak to Servius, Teokan of Ralos at the of the Sunrise Palace. He will tell you that Queen Zyanyi Arkan seeks an audience with you; accept to start the quest.

A cutscene will begin in which you will be brought to the top of the palace, with the Queen asking you about your involvement with Prince Itzla Arkan, even though it meant disobeying direct orders from her. You admit that you helped him regardless of the consequences, but you offer to atone for your mistake. Servius convinces her to do so, and she decides to let the incident slide by proving yourself. She asks you to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and see what they're up to. Make sure to bring your emissary robes.

Head back to the Twilight Temple (quetzal to Salvager Overlook then running south to the temple will be fastest), and head inside whilst wearing your Twilight Emissary robes, and another cutscene will play as Metzli reveals to the cultists that they have Prince Itzla captive. Itzla is defiant in front of the crowd before he is taken away, seemingly underground. After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs; you will be stopped by a Emissary Ascended asking you for the passcode, which is "Final Dawn".
Note: While in the basement you will be unable to unequip your robes. Logging out may return you to the ground floor, and logging out or teleporting out can remove any quest items collected there.

Once in the basement, go north and then east into an offshoot. You will need to make your way past the Emissary Enforcer, who will throw you out if he sees you or you are too close behind him. Once you sneak past him, head into the next room, where you will try to get information on Itzla's whereabouts. When Metzli and Furia walk out of a room, the latter is concerned about the former's reckless actions before they leave.

Search the bed from the room they came out of for a key, and then search the drawer with the key to obtain a canvas piece. There are two drawers; one in the north and another in the south, and the location of the canvas is different for every player. Use the piece on the painting, then attempt to pick the lock on the chest inside.

To open the chest, simply move the tumblers by clicking on slots above them. The fastest way to brute force the lock is to simply click confirm, see if any show up as green on the right, and if not, move everything up by one. This will take no more than eight tries for the final combination. When picking the chest, if a number is blue, that means it is used in the combination but on a different tumbler. Once you picklock the chest, you will obtain an emissary scroll and attempt to leave, only for the enforcer to walk in and spot you. He will take the scroll from you before attempting to kill you for your betrayal.

The enforcer has 180 hitpoints and uses a 3x3 AoE melee attack centred on himself. Periodically, he will yell a random quote (such as Thief! or Traitor!) and lunge forward, dealing moderate damage if caught in it and also having a chance to apply a bleed. In other words, all of his attacks are avoidable as long as players react to them in time by running away or side-stepping him. The player is unable to change their equipment during the fight, so it is highly recommended to have equipped the necessary gear beforehand. Additionally, players cannot use prayers or teleport out, though escape is possible via right-clicking "Quick-escape" on the exit door. Should players die during this fight, their gravestone will be placed at the entrance to the Twilight Temple.
After the enforcer dies, pick up the emissary scroll, read it, and then return to the Sunrise Palace.
One of the following: bones, raw meat, cooked meat

Make your way to the top floor of the Sunrise Palace, and inform Queen Zyanyi of the scroll's contents, which reveal that Forebearer Janus intends to move into a newly acquired property across from a bank as a safe house for the cult. Servius immediately recognises this bank as the south-western bank of Civitas illa Fortis, since there are no houses around the eastern bank. Zyanyi will have Captain Vibia help you capture Janus, asking you to meet up with her at the safe house, where she will ask you to set up the trap.

Head over to the safe house, Captain Vibia will be located on the road just south of the building. After talking to her, interact with the south-eastern window and force it open, then climb through the window. A dog inside will become agitated and attack; use either a pile of bones, or a raw/cooked meat of any sort to calm it down; raw beast meat or raw mystery meat will not work. Pet the dog to see its nametag, which is "GUS". This is the code needed to unlock the door to the rest of the house, and you will bring Vibia in after the coast is clear.

You will now need to make preparations to capture Janus whenever he arrives. First, grab the knife in the kitchen, then the sack of potatoes just outside the kitchen. Empty the sack, then head upstairs and grab the coin purse lying there. Open the purse, then head up to the top floor and use the knife on the potted fan plant with a lighter shade of green for a branch. Additionally, use the now-empty coin purse on the pot of sand for a sandy coin purse, then lastly use the branch on it to create a makeshift blackjack.

With the sack and blackjack, return to Captain Vibia, and a cutscene will ensue where Janus enters the house and discovers you and Vibia before you knock him out with the blackjack and Vibia restrains him with the sack. Search him for a key, then enter the basement for another cutscene. Zyanyi and her entourage will arrive to confront Janus, who is defiant towards her and states that he is not afraid of death. Zyanyi asks you and the others to leave while she makes him talk. The screen fades to black while various sounds of an unarmed man being assaulted can be heard.

Shortly after, the group returns, and Janus is found dead on the floor, with Zyanyi having tortured and interrogated him. Zyanyi reveals that the cult really intends to perform the Gathering, a ritual in which a dead Teokan is laid to rest and a successor chosen. While you question this, Zyanyi states that they intend to perform this ritual at the Crypt of Tonali in the Tlati Rainforest, where a set of doors must be opened with the blood of two Teokan, and beyond said doors is where the cult believes the path to Mokhaiotl lies.

However, without Servius, the cult hopes to use Prince Itzla's blood instead, and has sought help from the Dwarves of Cam Torum, as they were the ones who had built the doors. You will be offered to depart with them (acting as a "teleport" to the city). Accept this offer to initiate another cutscene.

On the way to Cam Torum, Highlord Katlo and Attala will arrive to greet the group. Zyanyi will explain the reason for their visit and asks to lead an investigation, but Katlo refuses, believing a human investigation within his city would cause friction between the dwarven citizens and the human presence. However, Attala will vouch for you given your previous assistance during the events of Perilous Moons, and Highlord Katlo will grant the group permission to search for the cultists. Attala will ask you to meet her in the market, while Queen Zyanyi heads to Tal Teklan to prepare the defences at the Crypt of Tonali. Servius will accompany you, knowing that he is not safe anywhere and may have some knowledge to contribute towards the investigation.

Head further inside, and Attala will question Servius' presence, though you stop their arguing. Attala explains that only four individuals are authorised to grant human access to Cam Torum: Highlord Katlo, herself, Highseer Vandra, and her advisor Teumo. Attala believes that Teumo is the likeliest suspect, as she has enough trust in Katlo and Vandra, and asks you to meet her and Servius at Teumo's home.

Teumo's house is just east of the bank; enter it, where you will meet Galna. Attala will claim that Teumo allowed them to help with a project, while Galna allows the three of you to stay but avoid going downstairs, as she claims Teumo doesn't like anyone going down there. Go upstairs, grab the beer on the table, then speak to Galna again. Offer the beer to her, which she will chug and get drunk, allowing you to go wherever you want.

Go downstairs and search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one of each of the following beverages: steamforge brew, dwarven stout, beer, and wizard's mind bomb. You will need to place these on the barrels around the area.
Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (indicated with "steam")
Place the stout directly east of this barrel (indicated with "black liquid")
Place the beer on the northern barrel (indicated with "smells like a Gielinorian pub")
Place the mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (indicated with "bubbling")
Drink any beer from the cabinet, then place the remaining beer glass on the original regular beer barrel ("This barrel seems to be empty").

Once the last correct drink is placed, you will hear a click and the fireplace will extinguish, revealing a lever. Pull the lever, then head to the south-east room and go through the hole. A cutscene will play where you eavesdrop the Tullus twins talking with Teumo, who agrees to help them open the doors in the Crypt of Tonali, provided that they retrieve an Old One keystone from Neypotzli, which he needs to succeed in getting the doors opened.

Report the news back to Servius and Attala, revealing that Teumo was bribed by the cult for his assistance, and you will tell Servius to head to Tal Teklan to see if the defences are ready, while Attala gets the guards to deal with Teumo. Attala will tell you to go to Neypotzli.
Combat equipment (preferably melee or ranged), one empty slot

Retrieve combat equipment and optionally supplies at the Cam Torum bank. The arena the upcoming fight takes place in is considered a part of Neypotzli, meaning that moonlight potions and cooked bream/cooked moss lizard can be made and used as free supplies for the fight. Melee or ranged is preferred for the fight due to Lucius' high magic level giving him strong magic defences. Make your way north to Neypotzli. As you enter, Eyatlalli will appear before you, telling you of interlopers tampering with the icosahedron behind her. She will tell you that it is a form of keystone, and that an earlier form of it remains from when the prison was built. As she must keep the Moons of Peril in check, she cannot stop them from obtaining it, though you offer to do so in her stead. She will give you a keystone fragment to locate the other keystone. Before you leave, you will ask about Mokhaiotl. Eyatlalli states that while she was created near the end of the Old Ones' time, she did hear the word at least once, and believes that it was related to hope.

Head through each chamber, using the keystone to pinpoint the exact tile to resonate with the key. You will need to do this once in both the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns. If no supplies were brought, also make some potions and food in these caverns to prepare for the upcoming fight. Then head to the Ancient Prison and use the key in the room to the south-east in the section, revealing a glowing symbol. Go through it, and a cutscene ensues where you confront the Tullus twins, who have already retrieved the keystone. Ennius will call in Metzli, who teleports the twins out and orders Lucius and Chimalli to kill you.

For the fight, auto-retaliate should be turned off to avoid being dragged into danger. The two cultists have 180 health. Lucius uses magic, while Chimalli uses ranged. They will attack off-sync, allowing the player to flick against their attacks, and it is recommended to do so as they can hit fairly hard. Every three attacks, Lucius will unleash a triple projectile while a 2x2 mini-sun in the arena appears as a safespot. Failing to be in this zone before the projectile hits will deal heavy damage and disable protection prayers. Meanwhile, Chimalli will unleash a barrage of fire arrows that can be avoided by running away from where they would land, indicated with glowing shadows. When one of the pair dies, the other will enter an enraged state; their attacks will pierce through prayer (dealing chip damage), and they will use their special attack more often. It is recommended to kill Lucius first, since Chimalli's special attack is much easier to avoid, especially if you are using melee for the fight.

When the last of the cultists dies, Attala and a few guards will arrive. You will tell her that the twins managed to escape with the keystone, and she will tell you in turn that they failed to find Teumo. You ask if Cam Torum will aid the Queen, but Attala states that this is a human matter and of no threat to Cam Torum, and as such, will not intervene; however, she does hope you survive before leaving to inform Highlord Katlo of the situation.

Head to Tal Teklan and find Servius, who is by the eastern gate. He will tell you that the cultists are attacking the Crypt of Tonali. Run south-east; you will find the cultists fighting the Tonali archers and warriors outside the crypt as Queen Zyanyi leads the defence to prevent them from charging through.

You will face six waves of cultists (Emissary brawlers, archers, and conjurers), alongside Queen Zyanyi (level 144), Captain Vibia (level 128), and two Tonali warriors and archers (level 85). While a few more Tonali and some of the Kualti are fighting them a bit further down, they are simply there as scenery.
Wave 1: 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 2x Emissary Brawler (level 86)
Wave 2: 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86)
Wave 3: 1x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71)
Wave 4: 1x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71), 1x Emissary Conjurer (level 71)
Wave 5: 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71), 1x Emissary Conjurer (level 71)
Wave 6: 2x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 2x Emissary Conjurer (level 71)

The next wave starts when one enemy from the previous wave remains. While the cultists initially target the Tonali, the player can draw their aggression by attacking them, or may restore hitpoints to the Tonali using food. If too many Tonali fall, the battle is lost, and players must restart from the beginning.

The cultists can run, but they don't use routefinding, so the Emissary Brawlers can be trapped behind fires in the room allowing them to be safespotted. The archers and conjurers cannot be safespotted due to their higher attack range.

After the last wave of cultists is slain, another group will barge in. Additionally, Metzli, the Tullus twins (Furia and Ennius), Teumo, and Prince Itzla are all teleported into the crypt by a conjurer. Teumo activates the door and walks off, while the others, barring Itzla, rush inside. Zyanyi will get her son and order him away to recover, telling you to come with her to chase after the leaders.

Pursuing the leaders to a small platform, you, Zyanyi, and Vibia confront the Tullus twins, with Furia realising that Metzli had deceived them, though Ennius fails to do so. Furia also reveals that she only accepted Metzli's offer as she promised to return the throne to the Tullus family, which had been seized from them after Emperor Imafore's death. Zyanyi offers them a chance to surrender, but Ennius will refuse and instead draws out his sword and casts several fire spells around the area, separating Vibia and Furia, leaving you and Zyanyi to fight Ennius.

Ennius will have both Protect from Magic and Protect from Missiles active simultaneously, so players must use melee to harm him. He has 380 hitpoints and attacks with melee, along with a few special attacks:
Sunfire Blast: Circles will begin glowing around the area, indicating safespots for his upcoming attack. Getting caught in this attack will deal moderate damage and inflict a weak burn.

Sunfire Strike: A row or column of sunfire through him. Getting caught in this attack will deal moderate damage and inflict a weak burn. If the player is diagonally across, he will likewise launch one across himself.
Sunfire Smite: Ennius will disable the player's overhead prayers.

It is recommended to have auto-retaliate off to prevent your character from walking back into a special attack danger zone. Queen Zyanyi will usually react to the special attacks, showing you how to deal with them. Upon reaching 0 health, Ennius will empower himself, yelling The sun burns within me!, entering the enrage phase. He will heal for 120 health, attacks significantly faster, pierces prayer slightly more, and the Sunfire Strike is enhanced to cover three rows/columns at a time. A halberd weapon can be useful in attacking diagonally across to minimise time loss.

Upon reaching 0 health a second time, Ennius will die for good, while Vibia informs the two of you that Furia was injured but managed to run away. Prince Itzla will then appear in his combat gear and insist that he accompany you in pursuing Furia and Metzli. Queen Zyanyi will initially refuse, but is persuaded to remain at the Crypt entrance to defend against the cultists.

You will need to navigate through the underground cavern beneath the Crypt. A Earthen Nagua will appear, prompting Prince Itzla to stay behind and fight it while telling you to go further ahead. Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the other end of the chamber, where you will find a rope leading to a bridge. Climb the rope and head north to meet Prince Itzla, who has caught up to you. Make sure to activate the strange platform, as this unlocks a permanent shortcut to the surface.

Upon entering the next room, you will find both a moon and sun puzzle to the sides, both of which need to be solved to proceed further in. Avoid logging out or hopping worlds during the puzzles, as this may reset your progress.

The right side of the room contains a sun-related puzzle. Inspect the statue, which is written in the Old Ones' language. Speak to Prince Itzla and ask him to translate the words for you by inputting them into the message box when prompted.
In order to activate the statue, both you and Prince Itzla must be at a specific altar and imbue it with Kuhu essence, found by searching the urns near the altars.
The altars are not labeled or numbered in any way in game, but their numbering starts with 1 being the north-east altar and travels clockwise, with 8 ending at the north altar.

The statue's wording will determine where you and Prince Itzla need to be positioned, and is random for every player. You will need to be on one altar corresponding to either the first or second numbered altar of the statue's given code, while Prince Itzla would be moved to the altar of the second altar number, respectively. The third number/word is not used (but is good for translation purposes).
Oma = 2
Naui = 4
Kuli = 5
Chaki = 6
Koma = 7
Ueai = 8
Makti = 10

For example, if the statue states "Naui Koma-Makti", you or Itzla need to be placed by the fourth altar, while the other needs to go to the seventh altar. The altars are numbered 1 to 8, with the first being the north-east altar and the next number in sequence going clockwise.

When placed on the correct altar, attempt to imbue the Kuhu essence. If successful, the statue will generate a new phrase. If failed, you will take 5 damage. After three successful tries, the room is finished.

The left side of the room contains a moon-related puzzle. You will be teleported to the north end of the room, while Prince Itzla is teleported into the centre. Flames block your path forward. Itzla can disable them by standing on the corresponding platform - Northern for dark blue, Southern for light blue. You will need to move him between the two platforms to disable the flames in turn as you traverse the room.

At multiple places on the floor leading to the statue, there are old tools and tree roots. Search the old tools to get a knife blade (you only need one). Pull the tree roots to get ancient roots. Use the knife blade to on the ancient roots to fletch them into root kindling. Each ancient root yields 4 root kindling. Before inspecting the statue, have Prince Itzla move back and forth between the two platforms, and count the total number of braziers that light up. This is how much kindling you will need.

Inspect the statue and place the required amount of kindling on it. Putting the wrong amount onto it will cause the player to take 4-5 damage. Repeat this process two more times, counting the braziers and depositing the kindling. After three successful deposits, the room is finished.
Combat equipment (preferably ranged), food, potions

Head into the next chamber to find Metzli, who reveals that she manipulated the cult to acquire the means to access Mokhaiotl, which she knows is an archive built by the Old Ones. She will then initiate combat, entering a ranged form. Immediately activate Protect from Missiles and fight her. Metzli has 600 hitpoints, and Prince Itzla will assist you in the fight. It is recommended to fight her using ranged since her magic defence is fairly high and many of her mechanics must be dodged.
Every three attacks, Metzli will perform a special attack based on her current active style:
Sunfire Blast: Same as the one used by Ennius, except used twice in a row.
Sunfire Waves: Metzli will unleash two waves of sunfire that sweep across the room. To avoid damage from the attack, simply stand on the row/column that doesn't have sunfire on it.

Sunfire Sweeper: Metzli will unleash two waves of sunfire simultaneously while also summoning two white portals to her sides. To avoid damage from this attack, wait for the sunfire wave to close in, then stand on the white portal to teleport behind it.
Triple Projectile: Same as the one used by Lucius, except used twice in a row.
Moonfire Waves: Same as Sunfire Waves.
Moonfire Sweeper: Same as Sunfire Sweeper.
After every sweeper attack, Metzli will change combat styles, this time using magic. Upon using Moonfire Sweeper, she will revert to ranged. Pray accordingly to minimise damage.

Upon reaching 10% of her health, Metzli will enter an enrage phase, conjuring a wall of fire in all cardinal directions. She will not use any auto-attacks. Instead, she will target the quadrant that the player and Itzla are on. A white portal will additionally spawn to move to the next quadrant, avoiding damage from the attack. Itzla will react to the mechanic but will be unable to attack her.

Upon reaching 0 health, Metzli will run further into the cavern. Head down the stairs to the west then search the skeleton on the lower level for a stone tablet, revealing that human refugees assisted the Old Ones (seemingly referred to as the Kuhu) in constructing the archive's defences. Continue around this path to the north to the next entrance to reach the final chamber. Dying after defeating Metzli will not require the player to repeat the fight.

Note: With 75 Agility, you can cross the pillar shortcut on the north side of the chamber where you fought Metzli, to more quickly reach the final chamber. However, you will still need to return and take the stone tablet to complete the quest.

In the final chamber, Metzli will be shocked to discover that there were no archives at all. Prince Itzla tells her that the gift might never have existed or was never meant for them to access. As he finishes, Furia appears from behind, calls Metzli a traitor, and throws a rune knife at her, finishing her off. You and Prince Itzla will then take Furia back to Queen Zyanyi. As you exit the chamber, you will be prompted to explore the area fully before returning.

Inspect the statues at the entrance to the final chamber, and then search the skeleton for a second stone tablet, which reveals that the chamber was indeed named Mokhaiotl and was in fact an archive, but during its construction, something ancient awakened deep in the archive and destroyed it entirely. Lastly, attempt to return to the chamber, resulting in a message appearing that a horrifying screech can be heard within, and the player will automatically return to the crypt. Do not forget to inspect the statues in the area to complete the investigation sequence and automatically return to the crypt.

Queen Zyanyi orders to take Furia to prison in Fortis for her betrayal, presumably with death, but Prince Itzla stops her from doing so, believing that while the cult is mostly leaderless, there are still supporters from the shadows. As Metzli and Ennius had been martyred, Prince Itzla suggests sparing Furia for the time being, which she accepts, seeing it as a sign of his growth throughout the entire ordeal.

Queen Zyanyi and Captain Vibia will then return to Fortis with Furia in tow. You and Prince Itzla will exchange some banter, and he'll thank you for sticking by him, showing his gratitude by handing down the Arkan blade, which was passed down to him from his grandfather.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Speak to either dwarves on either side of the White Wolf Mountain. (I was wondering what was down those stairs? → Why not? → If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it. → Well, let's be friends! → And how am I meant to do that?) Note: Starting on the west side makes travelling by foot easier.
If you need garlic, go to Seers' Village and take it from the house south-west of the bank (it spawns on the table).

Bring a spade and make your way to McGrubor's Wood (either enter through the back or teleport to fairy ring ALS if you completed at least half of Fairytale II - Cure a Queen) to gather 3 red vine worm. You can collect them by checking the vine just west of the fairy ring ALS.
Either walk south to Hemenster or teleport to the Ranging Guild via your combat bracelet and go north-west.
If you don't have a Fishing Rod, purchase one from Grandpa Jack for c in the house outside Hemenster entrance.
Enter Hemenster with the Fishing pass in your inventory.
Put a Garlic in the pipes to the north. Make sure to finish the dialogue.
Pay Bonzo 5 coins. Wait for the Sinister Stranger to move away from the pipes. Start fishing and wait for the contest to end.
After winning the contest, make your way back to the dwarf and show him the trophy.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Recipe for Disaster
Forgettable Tale...
Between a Rock...
Land of the Goblins
x:2876,y:3483,desc:Austri
To start this quest, head to either the dwarf Austri east of White Wolf Mountain or the dwarf Vestri west of the mountain, at the points shown on the map.
Tip: The western quest start point is closer to the next part of the quest, so it is recommended if not planning to use fast travel.

Talk with either dwarf, and use the following dialogue options. (I was wondering what was down those stairs? → Why not? → If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it. → Well, let's be friends! → And how am I meant to do that?) Ask what is down the stairs, and he will say you can't use them. Ask why not, and he will ask you how you would like it if he took a shortcut through your home. Tell him if he was your friend you wouldn't mind, and he will say he doesn't know you. Ask to be friends; he wants you to earn his trust first. Ask how you are meant to do that, and he will mention that the dwarves are after a gold artefact, the first prize at the Hemenster fishing contest. He will give you a fishing pass to enter in the competition. You must win the competition before the dwarves will allow you to use the shortcut.
A spade
If you were to head to the contest, Grandpa Jack the previous champion would give you advice on how to win; you can skip this however, and gather the required items without needing to speak to him.
If you don't already have garlic, pick up a piece off the table in the house south-west of the bank in Seers' Village.

With your spade, head to McGrubor's Wood west of Seers' Village, also accessible by the Fairy ring als inside (using the ring will also complete a medium Kandarin Diary task). If entering from outside, the southern gate is locked and you must squeeze through the railing on the northern side. Beware of aggressive level 44 guard dogs.
Just west of the fairy ring, you will find a red vine. Check the red vine and collect at least 2 red vine worms.
Head to Hemenster, located by the Ranging Guild. If you didn't bring a fishing rod, buy one for 5 coins from Grandpa Jack in the house slightly north-east of the town.
Find Morris at the gate to Hemenster and show him your fishing pass and he will let you in.
Put the garlic into the third pipe from the gate on the south wall of the north Hemenster building.
Pay Bonzo the contest fee to start the contest (5 coins). The Sinister Stranger will complain about a horrible smell and you will change places with him.
Fish at the spot by the pipes using the red vine worms. You will catch a giant carp, a unique type of fish that you can't catch normally, and that will be the prize winning fish.
Speak to Bonzo again and hand over the giant carp. You will be announced the winner of the Fishing Competition.
After winning the contest and obtaining your trophy, head back to the quest starting point on either side of the mountain and give the dwarf your trophy.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Talk to Commander Veldaban in Keldagrim, just west of the bank. This will begin a cutscene (note: If you click the east side of the bridge directly as the cutscene begins your avatar will migrate east during the cutscene). (Very interested! → Yes. → Sounds like just the job for me!)
Buy 3 beers from the pub south of the drunken dwarf's house if you don't have them already. (I'd like a beer please. → Pay.)
Speak to the drunken dwarf in the middle of East Keldagrim (north-east of the kebab shop, there's a bar south). (I need to know about the Red Axe...)
Talk to him again and give him a beer. (I need to know about the Red Axe...)

Speak to the rowdy dwarf outside the East Keldagrim pub, he will request a random item. Get it and bring it to him. (If you buy it at the Grand Exchange, use the free minecart transport north-west in the GE.)

Travel to the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain (Optional: Buy White Wolf Mountain ticket (100 coins) from Keldagrim Cart Conductor to travel to the White Wolf Mountain tunnel. Use the south minecart track.)
Talk to Khorvak in the pub under White Wolf Mountain (What if I offer you a drink?).
Give a dwarven stout to Khorvak. (If you didn't bring a dwarven stout, pick up the dwarven stout spawn from table in pub.)
(Optional) Buy a Keldagrim ticket from the Cart Conductor under White Wolf Mountain for 100 coins (50 if Ring of Charos(a) is used) to get back to Keldagrim, or teleport to Blast Furnace minigame.
Talk to Gauss in the bar south of the bank (western side of Keldagrim). Give him cheers with another beer.
Go to the "Kelda Hops Patch" just south-east of the bank. Speak with Rind The Gardener, or you will receive a message that you should ask for permission before using the patch.
Plant the kelda seeds (there is a rake south of the patch).
They will grow in 15–20 minutes and cannot die. You will get a chat notification when ready (you can be logged out while waiting).
Harvest the kelda hops.
Go upstairs in the East Keldagrim pub.

If you did not bring ale yeast, buy ale yeast from Blandebir for 25 coins (empty pot spawn can be found near the vat). (Do you have any spare ale yeast? → That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.)
Add to the vat in this order:
2 buckets of water.
2 barley malts.
Kelda hops.
Ale yeast.
Wait 15–20 minutes for the notification again.
Turn the valve and use an empty beer glass on the barrel.
Return to the drunken dwarf's house, north-east of the Kebab shop, and talk about the Red Axe. (I need to know about the Red Axe...)
Talk to the southernmost cart conductor in south-eastern Keldagrim. (Ask about closed off tunnel.)
Only one of them will let you ask about the closed-off tunnel.

Talk to the director of the mining company you joined in The Giant Dwarf, which is located upstairs in either the west or the east marketplace (Palace). If you don't remember which company you joined just go from director to director. The only one with time to speak with you is yours. (Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?)
Return to the minecarts and ride the southernmost cart (no ticket necessary, but need both hands free).
Search the [[box (Forgettable Tale...)
Use the dwarven machinery.
Set up the path shown in the "Part 1" image and click OK.
Ride the cart, collect more stones from the box.
Return on the cart to the start point, then input the next path.
Collect the stones and return again.
Input the third path to move on to the next room.
Listen to the conversation, crawl to the other side, and leave.
Complete the puzzle in the same manner as the first one.
Search the crates and bookshelves until you've read 3 documents relating to the Red Axe, then continue into the next room.
Complete the puzzle in the same manner as the previous ones.
Watch the cutscene.
Buy a kebab from the kebab shop and a beer in the pub (both in East Keldagrim) if you don't already have them.
Talk to Commander Veldaban (west of the bank).
Return back to the eastern pub (on the east side of Keldagrim) and drink your beer and eat your kebab.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Note: This quest involves waiting for 15-20 minutes twice. If you don't want to do this quest intermittently, you can bring something to fill this time with, such as runes and items for High Level Alchemy. For the first waiting period, there is a bank nearby.
Beer (or 2 coins to buy one)

Head to Keldagrim. A great way to get there is by using the Minigame Teleport to Blast Furnace. Another great way is to use the cart trapdoor in the north-western part of Grand Exchange. The fairy ring code dks will bring you right next to the entrance to Keldagrim. There are also cart rides from the Dwarven Mine, the underground White Wolf Mountain passageway, and Dorgesh-Kaan (if you completed the quest Another Slice of H.A.M.).

To start this quest, talk to Veldaban, Commander of the Black Guard in the Black Guard H.Q., west of the Keldagrim bank. He is rather shocked to tell you that, after the incident at the end of The Giant Dwarf, the Red Axe company has completely left Keldagrim, causing disorder within the Consortium.

However, he finds this to be rather suspicious, and wants you to investigate the mining group. The only lead the Black Guard currently has is that there is a dwarf living in east Keldagrim who acts strangely whenever the company is mentioned.

Agree to help Veldaban, and you will automatically be transported to the dwarf's house in east Keldagrim after a short cutscene. Speak to the dwarf, who is rather drunk and will ask you for a drink. Talk to him to give him the beer. Beer can be bought in the Laughing Miner Pub or the King's Axe Inn for two coins. He, however, wants "some of the REALLY good stuff", which is an incredibly alcoholic drink called Kelda stout.
minecart]] train to White Wolf Mountain and back
To make the drink, you need to grow some kelda hops from 4 kelda seeds, possessed by some of his drunken friends - namely Khorvak, Gauss and the rowdy dwarf.
The drunken dwarf gives the first seed to set you off.

For the next seed, go to the Laughing Miner pub (directly south of the drunken dwarf's house) and you should see the Rowdy dwarf, circling around the pub. He asks you for a random item in exchange for another seed. See the list of items and how to obtain them below. Before teleporting outside of Keldagrim to obtain whatever item you're asked for (if needed), proceed to obtaining the next seed.

For the third seed, go to the White Wolf Mountain by using the minecarts. In the pub, talk to Khorvak, a dwarven engineer. Convince him that you will bring the seed back when you are done, and he will let you "borrow" it. Alternatively, you may give him a dwarven stout from a nearby table in exchange for the seed.

For the last seed, go to the west side of Keldagrim and talk to Gauss. He is in the King's Axe Inn, south of the bank in west Keldagrim. He will ask you to do a toast with him. The toast will not consume the beer, and it may be used later in the quest.

Once you have all four seeds, go to the hops farming plot in front of the palace in West Keldagrim and east of the bank. Ask Rind the gardener for advice on planting the seeds, and he will explain that sunlight is harmful for kelda seeds and hence you can only grow it underground. He then gives you permission to use the Kelda hops patch. Pick up the rake to the south if needed.

Weed the garden using a rake, plant the hops, and wait 15-20 minutes. You don't have to be online, but logging in and out will reset the timer. You'll get a notification when the hops are ready saying: Perhaps I should take a look and see if my Kelda hops have grown... The hops don't require attention or water and cannot get diseased.

If you need something to pass the time, you can talk to Rind the gardener and deliver a letter for him; you must take it to Elstan, the gardener at the allotment south of Falador (you can quickly reach him using the cabbage port from the Explorer's ring 2, 3, or 4), then go back to Keldagrim to Rind to get two marrentill seeds. Note: You can only do this delivery during this stage of this quest; this little side quest is no longer available after picking the hops. If you tell Rind that you do not want to deliver the letter after receiving it, you will also not be able to complete the side quest anymore.
When your seeds have grown, pick the Kelda hops.

You now need to head to the bar in East Keldagrim and up the stairs to the fermenting vat. The vat at Port Phasmatys cannot be used; the vat will give the message, "These special hops need to be brewed in the Keldagrim brewery. Oh well..." If you already have contents in the fermenting vat bring 8 beer glasses or 2 calquat kegs to empty them. If the contents are still fermenting you can drain the vat by using the valve (whatever contents were fermenting in this vat will be lost).

If ready to brew the ale, use two buckets of water on the vat, then add two barley malt, then the kelda hops. If you didn't bring ale yeast, take the pot from the nearby table and ask Blandebir to fill it up with ale yeast for 25gp. Use the ale yeast on the vat and the fermenting process will begin. This will take another 15–20 minutes and you will get a notification when it's ready.

When it's done fermenting, turn the valve (behind the barrel) and use a beer glass on the barrel. Head to the Drunken Dwarf's house just north and talk about the Red Axe. He will ask for the Kelda stout and then tell you about the boarded up tunnel along with a small cutscene.

Talk to the cart conductor to the south at the train cart tracks (only one of the conductors will give you the option to ask about the closed off tunnel, which would be the one furthest south, nearest to the closed off tunnel). Now, talk to the director of the mining company that you joined during The Giant Dwarf quest, which is located upstairs in either the west or the east marketplace. Ask them for help with the boarded up tunnel, and they will have the boards removed at once. Go back to the conductor and ride the cart that goes into the new tunnel (the most southern cart, no ticket required). Make sure to remove any held items in your hands before riding the cart.
You will find yourself before a gigantic abyss at the end of the cart ride. A short cutscene shows the vastness of the area, along with tracks floating out in all directions.
If you log out at anytime while in the cave, you will be transported out in the city, and your progress will be saved.

To proceed, you will need to head through one of the many exits on the other side of the chasm. First, you need to solve a puzzle to set the tracks to the exit. Collect the square stones from the box next to the controls, and set them in the dwarven machinery. A green stone will make the cart take the top path at a junction, and a yellow stone will make it take the bottom path.

Your goal is to set up a connection between the red square all the way to the left and the boxes that are to the right. To place/rotate a stone in a junction, click once for green, twice for yellow, and three times to remove the stone. The green line shows the path the cart will take. The chest at the top of Room 1 cannot be reached.

To get past this room, operate the controls and place the yellow stone on the farthest spot to the left and the green stone one spot below that, as shown below. Hop onto the cart, and search the box on the platform that you reach to obtain another green square stone. Take the cart back to the control box.
There are two ways to go forward with the next one: either green, yellow, green or green, green, yellow. Ride the cart again, search the box for a second yellow stone, and return to the control box.
Finally, connect the stones to the red cross, with the two yellow blocks on the left hand side and two green blocks on the right hand side. Ride the cart to reach the second room.

Crawl through the hole at the opposite end of the room from where you entered.
You'll now be in another minecart abyss. Search the box to receive two yellow and one green stone. The chest at the top of Room 3 is empty when searched.

Put a yellow stone at the far left, another yellow one spot below that, a green one below that, and another green to the right. Ride the cart, search the box, and ride back.
Put a green stone on the far left, another green one spot above that, a yellow one spot above that, a green to the right and below, and a yellow to the right. Ride the cart into the fourth room.

You appear in a small archive room, with a number of bookcases and crates, the ones with visible contents being searchable. Search the three crates. One contains papers concerning statistical data, salary structures, and shopping lists. The other two, however, are much more interesting. YOU MUST ALSO SEARCH A BOOKCASE BEFORE MOVING ON.

There is a copy of a letter addressed to the dwarven boatman, signed by Colonel Grimsson. It speaks of the bribe, which was part of the plans you overheard earlier, so that the boatman takes along some gullible human on his boat to blame and destroy the statue of King Alvis:
Regards, Colonel Grimsson of the Red Axe
The other letter is a report on an exploring dwarf who entered the mines - your new buddy, the drunken dwarf - whose memory was wiped to avoid any risk:
One of the books in the bookcases contains information on Red Axe employees, in particular Colonel Grimsson and Grunsh, the Red Axe Henchman and ogre shaman encountered earlier:
Moving forward from the reports room, you arrive at the final chasm. Search the box for two yellow and two green stones.
Put a green stone on the far left, a green stone one above that, a yellow stone one above that, and a yellow one to the right. Ride, search, and ride back.

Put a green stone on the far left, another green one above that, a yellow one above that, a green to the right of that, a yellow above, a green below, a yellow above, then a yellow below. Ride to the sixth and final room.

A cutscene starts, where the Red Axe Director will show off his army of Chaos Dwarves. But, before you can report to Commander Veldaban of what you've seen so far, Grunsh the Ogre shaman catches you prying into their plans and casts a spell that eliminates all your memories of the caves.

Go back and talk to Commander Veldaban, where you began the quest. (Note: Drinking the beer/eating the kebab before talking to Commander Veldaban will not initiate the cut scene.) You won't remember any of what had happened, but your instincts will tell you to go to the Laughing Miner pub in east Keldagrim and have a beer and kebab. Buy a kebab from the store on the east side (directly south-west of the drunken dwarf's house) and a beer from the pub. Now, drink the beer/eat the kebab in the east pub to begin the final cutscene. You will get drunk and tell a nonsensical story to a bunch of drunken dwarves.

Head to the Lovakengj Assembly, west of the southern bank in Lovakengj of Great Kourend, and talk to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj, fairy ring code djr will teleport you just south of her. If she's not ready to talk, the player must first talk to Ignisia to learn about Wintertodt. A member of the Kourend Council, Councillor Unkar, explains that the blacksmith Undor has found the cause of why the Doors of Dinh are failing, and requests assistance. Agree to help Unkar.

Head to the Wintertodt Camp. A games necklace can be used to get there very quickly. Alternatively, players can use the cart system to get to the Northern Tundras or fairy ring cis will drop you off just north of the Arceuus Library. Speak to Undor on the west side of the camp. If he says he needs to finish a job first then finish the dialogue and talk with Ignisia found a little to the east. Then go back to Undor and tell him: I've been sent to help you.

He will explain that the Doors have been purposely damaged by someone or something, creating a small hole in the doors. Although not much, it is enough for the Wintertodt imprisoned within to draw a small amount of power into the prison.

Undor can easily fix the damage done, but he needs Dinh's hammer in order to repair the doors, which he believes is located in the Forsaken Tower, located on the peninsula due west of Lovakengj and due east of Mount Karuulm.

Fairy ring cir takes you to the base of Mount Karuulm. Alternatively, players can use the cart system to get back to Lovakengj or use their Battlefront teleport to get to the graveyard directly south of the Forsaken Tower.

The riddle is a math problem known as a Water pouring puzzle, in which you must determine a multiple of 8s and 5s between which the difference is 4. Therefore, the solution is either to fill up the 5-gallon jug 4 times (+20) and emptying the 8-gallon twice (-16), or filling up the 8-gallon jug 3 times (+24) and emptying the 5-gallon jug 4 times (-20).

You should now have 4 gallons in the 5 gallon jug. Use the 5-gallon jug (with 4 gallons in it) on the furnace coolant mechanism on the left side of the furnace. Once it's full, light the furnace using your tinderbox.
Note: Once the furnace has been lit, players can smelt an adamantite bar for a Kourend & Kebos Diary hard task.

Go upstairs to the . You will see a table of potions and a refinery. The refinery needs to be activated, but before it can be, it needs to be cleansed, by use of cleansing fluid. With an antipoison and plenty of food, the puzzle can be brute-forced by trial and error.

To solve which potion is the correct one, you can search the cupboard in the south-east corner of the room to find old notes with a riddle, which includes some potions' locations on the table relative to each other. The potion you need to get is the cleansing fluid. The riddle layout is the same for everyone, but the fluids differ.
Fluid A is directly left of Fluid B.
Fluid B is next to Fluid C.
Fluid D is directly right of Fluid E.
Fluid A is opposite Fluid D.
For the solution:
A has to be 1 (far left).
B has to be 2 (middle left).
C has to be 3 (middle).
D has to be 5 (far right).
E has to be 4 (middle right).
Once you've chosen the correct fluid, click on the refinery, cleanse it, and then activate it.
