Note: Grip's Keyring is unique to the player you are doing the quest with. If you complete the quest and are retrieving candlesticks for a different player and still have Grip's Keyring, drop it and ask him for a new one.
A [[Ranged weapons

Go to Varrock and speak to Straven at the hideout. Enquire about becoming a master thief. He will explain that some eager gang members are trying to steal the valuable candlesticks of Scarface Pete, the pirate leader of Brimhaven. He gives you the password gherkin to tell Alfonse, a gang member posing as a waiter in The Shrimp and Parrot inn.
Get a bow and arrows, or magic gear if using magic, before heading to Brimhaven.

Go to the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven. Once you are there, talk to Alfonse the waiter and ask about gherkins. He will wink and redirect you to Charlie the cook in the back room. Give him the password as well and tell him you are after Pete's candlesticks. Charlie the cook will tell you that the restaurant was set up as part of the heist. There is a secret wall-door that opens into Mr. Olbors's garden that you are able to push to open. Across the garden is an old side entrance into the mansion that has since been blocked. However, the Phoenixes are unable to get hold of the key to that door. The pushable wall is in the kitchen, in the same room as where Charlie is. Beware of Mr. Olbors's guard dogs.

Get a miscellaneous key from your Black Arm Gang partner. Head into Olbors's garden and enter the mansion's eastern door. Once inside, use the miscellaneous key on the northern door. This brings you in a cramped room with an arrowslit into a room with a cupboard. Shoot through the hole in the wall at Grip and kill him with Ranged or Magic. Your partner will have to lure him inside the room by rummaging through his drinks cabinet. It's common for Grip to not come in the room all the way or retreat out of the room after being hit. Have your Black Arm Gang partner close the door once he enters. Grip will drop the key for your Black Arm Gang partner.
Your Black Arm Gang partner will get two candlesticks and should trade you one of them.
Note: You must actually kill Grip! If you don't, Straven will NOT accept your candlestick. Don't buy it or the key off other players as shortcut; you can't kill Grip alone.
Go back to Varrock and give the candlestick to Straven to get the Thieves' armband.
Energy]]/stamina potions if obtaining ice gloves

If you want, speak to a monk in the Entranan church about the firebird. He does not think they exist but redirects you to the head monk, who is more knowledgeable. The High Priest tells you that the bird lives somewhere on Entrana, and that you will need some cold gloves to pick up its feather.

The firebird lives on the northern half of Entrana. It is very weak and easy to kill. However, its fire feather is too hot to pick up; you require something cold in order to do so. In order to pick up the fire feather, you'll need ice gloves. They are dropped by the level 111 Ice Queen located underneath White Wolf Mountain. If you do not own ice gloves, see the section below.

Once you have a pair of ice gloves, bank your weapons and armour, but keep the gloves. Head to Entrana and kill the firebird near the Law Altar. Make sure to have the ice gloves equipped before picking up the feather.
You can also grab a fishing rod from the house beside the fishing platform on the south east corner of the island if you need a spare to use for making the oily fishing rod.

full.h: Ice Spy with my Little Eye

steps.t: If you do not already own Ice gloves, go to White Wolf Mountain (east of Catherby, west of Taverley), to the rock slide on the north side. It can be found just north-west of the gnome glider. Otherwise, enter the mountain at the southern entrance and walk or run north until you come to the rock slide.
Use a pickaxe on the rock slide (50 Mining) and go through it . Once you are through, you will be near level 57 ice warriors and three ladders.

At the end of the room resides the Ice Queen, kill her and she will drop the ice gloves. If you stand behind the throne, you can avoid the ice warriors and can still attack the Ice Queen if positioned right. Once you have the gloves, exit using the same route back or teleport out.

Go to Port Sarim and talk to Gerrant at the fishing shop. He will tell you that catching a lava eel requires a lava-proof fishing line, which can be created by coating an ordinary fishing rod with blamish oil. Gerrant will give you a free bottle of blamish snail slime, which is added to a harralander potion (unf) to make the blamish oil. Buy a fishing rod and some bait from him if you haven't got any yet.
After making the blamish oil, right-click on it to use it on a normal fishing rod to get an oily fishing rod.
There are four possible locations where you can catch lava eels:
Taverley Dungeon is a safe option, but requires the player to to take a long and winding path if they do not have at least level 70 Agility to use the shortcut.

The Lava Maze (level 40-45 Wilderness) may alternatively be chosen as catching a lava eel there is a hard Wilderness Diary task. As with all Wilderness activities, there is a risk of being killed by other players.
The Charred Dungeon requires level 60 Sailing to access. The route is shorter and more straightforward than Taverley Dungeon, but players will need to spend time sailing there.

The Wyrmscraig Cavern requires level 62 Sailing and the completion of Fallen From Grace to access. A slayer ring will take the player directly to the caverns, and may be the fastest option for players that have already completed the quest.
Dusty key (can be obtained in the dungeon) or 70 Agility

Make your way to Taverley and enter the dungeon to the south of the town. Some options include the balloon transport system, Falador Teleport and going west over the 5 Agility shortcut, or using Teleport to House if it is in Taverley.

If you have 70 Agility (which can be boosted), enter the pipe after putting on your dragonfire protection and run south. The fishing spot is near some baby blue dragons, which generally do not attack you from the position.

If you don't have 70 Agility, follow the magenta path on the image to the right. Walk through the dungeon and use the dusty key on the door between the lesser demons and blue dragons. If you have 63 Agility, you can save a bit of time by squeezing through loose railings to go straight to the lesser demon area.

If you don't have the dusty key, go past the bridge, continue south-west past the hill giants, and you will enter the Black Knights' Base. Go to the east into a jail, kill the jailer and then pick up his key. Use it on the jail cell holding Velrak the explorer. Ask him if there are any good places to explore to get the dusty key. Head back north past the hill giants and follow the magenta path to the fishing spot. Use the key on the door between the lesser demons and blue dragons. The fishing spot is near some baby blue dragons; from here, catch a lava eel.
A boat

There are two Sailing islands that have lava eel fishing spots. Going to these locations may be ideal for those who don't have 70 Agility and don't want to spend time getting the dusty key, or don't want to risk entering the Wilderness.

Charred Island, which requires a Sailing level of 60, has a fishing spot in the Charred Dungeon. There is no teleport to this island, so you must sail there. To reach the fishing spot, you must run past dragons, nechryael, and lava strykewyrms, so bringing dragonfire protection and some food is recommended.

Wyrmscraig, which requires a Sailing level of 62, has a fishing spot in the Wyrmscraig Cavern. After completing the quest Fallen From Grace, you can quickly teleport to the cavern by using a slayer ring, or to the island itself with a necklace of passage. Reaching the fishing spot only requires briefly running past some unaggressive wyrms, making it safer than navigating the Charred Dungeon.
Warning: The Lava Maze is located in level 40-45 Wilderness, meaning that many player killers will be within the level range to attack you. Do not bring any items you are not willing to lose.
There are several methods to get to the Lava Maze:
Teleporting there directly using the burning amulet. This is the quickest way.
Casting the Ghorrock Teleport spell (or tablet) in the Ancient Magicks spellbook. This requires completing the quest Desert Treasure I.

Take the Wilderness Obelisks to the destination at level 35 or level 44 Wilderness. This may take several attempts. The obelisks can be quickly accessed by taking the Minigame Teleport to Ferox Enclave.
Beware of the Chaos Fanatic if arriving from the Ghorrock Teleport of level 44 Wilderness Obelisk.
Take a waka canoe from Edgeville or any other River Lum Canoe Station to the Wilderness Pond. This requires 57 Woodcutting. Then walk west to arrive near the entrance.

Upon arriving at the entrance, use your knife or slash weapon to cut the web and proceed through the maze until you see the fishing icon on your minimap. The fishing spot is relatively near the entrance.

If you die with your oily fishing rod, you will probably lose it and have to make a new one. If Gerrant does not give you another bottle of blamish snail slime, you can also get it by killing a Myre blamish snail and grinding its meat with a pestle and mortar with an empty sample bottle in your inventory. The sample bottle can be obtained from Fidelio in the Canifis General Store.
Once you catch a raw lava eel (53 Fishing), cook it over a fire or a range (53 Cooking).
Note: Lava eels do not burn when cooked (or, indeed, when swimming in lava). Do not worry about obtaining multiple eels if you are worried about burning one.
Go back to the Heroes' Guild, talk to Achietties outside and give her the three collected items.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Note: If you start the quest with the required/recommended weapons and armour, you will have to bank everything before travelling to Entrana.
Talk to King Arthur. (Tell me of this quest. → I'd enjoy trying that.)
Talk to Merlin. (Thank you for the advice.)
He will now be found on the , in the room with the cauldron. Go up the main staircase and head to the eastern room. He won't show up as a yellow dot on the minimap until you have entered the room.
Bank all weapons and armour. Travel to Entrana.
Talk to the [[High Priest (Entrana)
Travel to Galahad's house west of McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring code ALS) or combat bracelet to Ranging Guild.
Talk to Galahad and receive the holy table napkin. (I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King.)
(Talk to Galahad again to complete a task in the Kandarin easy diary (Do you get lonely here on your own?))
Travel to Draynor Manor's southern-most room with the holy table napkin in your inventory and pick up 2 magic whistles from the table. The whistles will not be visible until you enter the room.
Prepare for the fight against the Black Knight Titan.
Travel north-west of Brimhaven to the north-western peninsula (see the minimap image).
optional* mine gold ore south west of pillars for Easy Karamja Diary Task
Stand under the tower and blow a magic whistle to be teleported to the Fisher Realm.
Fight the Black Knight Titan nearby on the bridge and kill the titan with Excalibur. See the in-depth quest guide for details.
Head south along the river and talk to the [[fisherman (Holy_Grail)

Head to the castle, south-west of the fisherman, pick up the Grail bell from the ground and ring it. (You must stand in front of the bricks to gain access to the castle. Make sure NOT to use the Magic Whistle or you will be teleported outside and you will have to fight the Black Knight Titan again.)

Take the stairs to the south, and talk to the Fisher King. (I seek the Holy Grail. → You don't look too well.) (Make sure to talk to him about both options or you will have to kill the Black Knight Titan again if you leave.)
Travel to Camelot and talk to King Arthur. Make sure to have 1 empty slot in your inventory for Magic gold feather he gives you.
Travel to Goblin Village.
Use the Open option on the sacks in the house in the east side of Goblin Village.
Talk to Sir Percival, he will take your magic whistle. Make sure you have another to get to the Fisher Realm yourself. (Come with me, I shall make you a king.)
Travel back to the Fisher Realm (via Brimhaven or using the fairy ring code BJR. You do not need to fight the Titan again either way)
Head to the top floor of the castle's eastern tower and take the [[Holy grail (item)
Return to King Arthur.
Congratulations, quest complete!

full.h: King Arthur and the Holy Grail

steps.t: Speak to King Arthur in Camelot, who mentions he is sending out knights on an important quest. Ask him about it, and he will say they have recently learned the holy grail has passed into Gielinor. He wants you to speak to Merlin who may know more about where to find it.

Merlin can be found on the of Camelot Castle, north-west of King Arthur up the staircase in the south-east room (not the south-east tower where you went up the ladder to rescue Merlin in the 'Merlin's Crystal' quest). Merlin will appear once you enter the south-east room. Merlin will suggest that the grail is likely to reside in a holy place like Entrana, and that Sir Galahad previously quested for the grail and may know more.
left

Before speaking to Galahad, you must first visit Entrana. Head to Port Sarim and travel with the Monks of Entrana, depositing any weapons or armour via the nearby bank deposit box, as the monks will not allow them on the island.

Speak to the high priest of the church, who says that the grail passed through the island but is no longer here. A strange old crone will appear and say that a Fisher King is in trouble. To help him you must find where the six stone heads around the world point to and blow a magic whistle there, in order to enter his realm.
left

Head to Galahad, found in a house west of McGrubor's Wood. Tell him you're looking for an item from the Fisher Realm, and he will reluctantly give you a holy table napkin, a souvenir he took from the Fisher Realm.
Note: To complete a task in the easy Kandarin Diary, ask him if he ever gets lonely, and he will give you a cup of tea.

With your napkin, head to the top floor of Draynor Manor and into the room south of Professor Oddenstein. You will see a pair of magic whistles on the table. Pick up both, one will be taken from you later. Fairy ring BJR will become accessible later in the quest - if you plan to use it, you will only need one, though taking multiple is still useful in case of mistakes. More than two can be obtained by dropping the whistles outside the room, entering it again, grabbing the two new whistles that spawn, and picking the dropped ones back up.
Note: The whistles have a despawn timer, but will respawn upon re-entering the room.
left
Excalibur, magic whistle, and combat equipment

Head to Brimhaven, ensuring you have your combat equipment with you. Go west of the town and then up the northern peninsula to the goldmine, avoiding the poisonous scorpions if below Combat level 41. Look for a guard tower north of where the gold rocks are.
Note: To complete an easy Karamja Diary task, take the rope swing to the western island (with the Giants) and back.
Note: If you brought a pickaxe, you can complete an easy Karamja Diary task by mining a piece of gold here with 40 Mining.
Go under the tower and blow one of the magic whistles, and you will be teleported to the Fisher King's Realm.

The Black Knight Titan guards the bridge ahead, and you must defeat him before you may continue. You may deal damage to him with other weapons but the killing blow must be dealt with Excalibur, otherwise he will heal to full health. Using melee to defeat him is highly recommended, as he has +1000 defence against Magic and Ranged.

As the Black Knight Titan will not move, it is extremely easy to defeat him through flinching, by hitting him and moving back one square immediately. Unlike most monsters, the player does not have to wait for the Black Knight Titan's health bar to disappear before attacking him again; they can immediately walk back to attack him after moving back one square. If you do take damage, his max hit is up to 15, so beware. Using a halberd will allow you to defeat him with melee from range with no chance of taking damage. Remember to switch back to Excalibur at around 10% hitpoints remaining to avoid accidentally healing him to full. At low levels the knight may take 15 minutes or more to kill due to its 142 hitpoints and high melee defence.
After killing the titan, cross the bridge and then head south along the river until you find a fisherman. Ask him how to get inside the castle, and he will tell you to ring the bell.
Head to the castle located south-west from the fisherman where you will find a grail bell on the ground in front of the entrance. Ring it and a Grail Maiden will invite you inside.

Go up the western staircase and speak to the Fisher King. Tell him you seek the grail, and he will reply that legend has it a questing knight will restore the Fisher Realm to its former glory and then claim the grail as their prize. Tell the Fisher King he doesn't look well, and he will tell you he fears his life is running short; he wants you to find his son Percival, who is actually a Knight of the Round Table, and bring him to the castle.
Warning: Complete both dialogues before leaving, or you may have to return and kill the titan again!
Blow your whistle again to be teleported out, or teleport out through other means and return to Camelot.
Both magic whistles, magic gold feather

Speak to King Arthur, who will recall Percival riding off on a quest to recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses a few months back. He will give you a magic gold feather which is said to point towards the location of the boots.

Blow on the feather, and it will guide you towards Goblin Village, located north of Falador. Once at the Goblin Village, Open the sacks in the east house (do not just prod), and you will find Sir Percival (you must have the feather in your inventory). Tell him that his father wishes to see him. Percival doesn't know how to get to the castle; if you have a magic whistle in your inventory, you will automatically give it to him when the conversation ends.

Head back to the Fisher King's Realm like before (you don't need to fight the Black Knight Titan this time). You may now also teleport there using fairy ring BJR. Return to where the Fisher King previously was to find that Percival has become the new king.
Head back downstairs, go up the staircase on the east end of the castle, and continue up the ladder. Take the holy grail.
Return to King Arthur in Camelot and the player will inform him that the grail has been retrieved.
Congratulations, quest complete!

To begin the quest use the fairy ring code ALP to teleport to the lighthouse. Alternatively, one could teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Grouping teleport then hop over the rocks to the north to reach the lighthouse.
Talk to Larrissa. (With what? → But how can I help? → Okay, I'll help! → I'll see what I can do)
Run east to the second bridge, use a plank on it.
Jump the bridge and use a second plank on it.
Head over to Barbarian Outpost, enter the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course
While at the outpost, prepare for the battle against the Dagannoth and Dagannoth Mother.
(Optional) Complete a lap of the Agility course to complete a medium Kandarin task.
Talk to Larrissa again.
Go to the roof of the lighthouse and use the swamp tar, tinderbox, and molten glass on the lighting mechanism.
Climb down to the basement, use 1 of each elemental rune, any sword, and any arrow on the [[strange wall (Lighthouse)
Open the eastern strange wall of the doorway, climb down the ladder and talk to Jossik.
Kill the level 100 [[Dagannoth (Horror from the Deep)
{|class="wikitable"
Congratulations, quest complete!
Take the rusty casket you received from killing the Dagannoth mother to Jossik upstairs to receive a [[God book
60 steel nails, a hammer, and 2 planks

Head to the Lighthouse, located north of Barbarian Outpost, reachable via the basalt platforms. If travelling from the outpost, you can obtain the required planks from the north-east end along the fence. Bring food as the platforms have a high failure rate even with decent agility, and a max hit of 10. Alternatively, fairy ring alp will take you right by the lighthouse.

Speak to Larrissa, who will tell the player that her boyfriend lives in the lighthouse. She is worried about him, as the light has gone out and the door is now mysteriously locked. Ask how you can help; she is stranded here, as a storm destroyed the bridge to the east, and she wants you to repair it. She also requests you retrieve a spare key to the lighthouse from her cousin at the Barbarian Outpost.

Some distance east of Larrissa is a broken bridge that connects to the mainland. With a hammer and 60 steel nails in your inventory, use a plank on the side of the bridge you are on, then click to jump to the other side to use a plank there as well. Depending on your agility level, you may take slight damage from the leap. Once the bridge is fixed, you will be able to cross without failure, despite the bridge not looking any different.

Check your quest log to make sure it says that you've fixed the bridge, then head to the Barbarian Outpost. Speak to Gunnjorn, found inside the Agility course, through the pipe (35 Agility). Tell him Larrissa is in trouble and needs her spare key back, and he will give you the lighthouse key.
A tinderbox, molten glass, and swamp tar

Return to Larrissa. She asks you to go inside the lighthouse and find out what happened to Jossik. Enter the building; you will appear in an instance with Larrissa inside. The furniture is smashed and there are blood splatters and claw marks on the floor and walls. She asks you to repair the light mechanism to prevent any shipwrecks. She does not know how to, but says Jossik probably had some manuals lying around.

By searching the bookcase on the , you may find the lighthouse manual, Jossik's journal, and his uncle's diary. Reading these is not required to progress the quest. If you choose to read them, the manual will describe how to maintain the Lightomatic Deluxe 500, with a troubleshooting FAQ section at the end of the book. The journal describes how Jossik became the lighthouse keeper after his uncle disappeared, and soon began to hear voices. It ends with Jossik's decision to investigate the strange noises coming from the basement. In his diary Silas discusses the monstrous dagannoth in-between incoherent ramblings, as well as his construction of a metal door in the basement. He mentions that to unlock the door, 'the key' is fire, air, water, and earth runes, as well as weapons.

Head to the and use some molten glass and swamp tar on the lighting mechanism in order to fix it, then light the tar with a tinderbox. Return to Larrissa, who requests that you do everything to find Jossik.
One of each elemental [[runes

Go down the iron ladder into the basement to find the door mentioned in Jossik's journal. You appear in a kind of sea cavern, with further passage blocked by the metal door. It has a monstrous face in its centre surrounded by six icons: the four runes, a sword and an arrow.

Use all of your basic elemental runes on the door (fire, water, earth, and air). You may bring a full stack of each, as the door will only use one rune. Use your sword on the door (any type), and then an arrow (any type except ogre and training). Bolts will not work. You do not get these back!
Combat equipment

Once you have used all of the items on the door, it will unlock. Ensure you have your combat equipment with you, and go through the eastern part of the door and down the ladder. Be prepared to fight both a dagannoth and the dagannoth mother, then talk to Jossik sitting injured by the ladder, who says he was trapped down here by creatures that attacked him. When the player suggests they should return upstairs to find help, a level 100 dagannoth emerges from the sea and attacks!
The dagannoth only attacks with melee and can be killed with any combat style. You can utilise a safespot by standing in the southern corner of the pond to the west.

After defeating it, Jossik says that was not the creature that had attacked him but one of its babies. A cutscene follows in which a larger dagannoth appears from the waters, revealing itself to be the much stronger dagannoth mother. She attacks with both ranged and melee, and changes colour every 18 seconds through a fixed cycle, indicated through a chat message The Dagannoth changes to blue... as well as visually. Her six colours correspond to the four elemental spell types, ranged, and melee. For as long as she remains that colour, she can only be damaged through use of that particular attack style.
{|class="wikitable"

The same safespot used for the regular dagannoth is not as effective here, as she may eventually attack you. You can use the stalagmites in the south-east corner of the room to flinch with a melee weapon, using Protect from Missiles to avoid her ranged attack when using the other combat styles. By default, the mother will use ranged at a distance and melee up close, but may detect Prayer changes and automatically use the opposite attack type.

You can defeat the Dagannoth mother without using all of the combat styles, and may choose to simply wait in a safespot (or up the ladder) while she is the wrong colour. You could also use these pauses to heal. As she has a weakness to earth spells and only level 1 Magic, this is the most effective source of damage. Ranged is the second most effective, and she has a higher resistance to melee.
Note: The Twinflame staff is not recommended, as it will remain on Earth spells as the mother's weakness, even if she has changed colour.
Warning: Any dropped items will be unobtainable after defeating the boss. You may still loot your items if you die before killing her.
Defeating the Dagannoth mother will automatically complete the quest, and you will receive a rusty casket. The casket can be obtained from Jossik upstairs if you had a full inventory.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to the Wanderer north-east of Sophanem (see picture) and ask why she has a problem with your cat. (Why? What's your problem with it? → Ok I'll get your supplies.)
Talk to the Wanderer again to give her a tinderbox and waterskin(4). (Yes. I have them all here.)
Touch the door of the pyramid where you wake up.
Navigate by clicking the minimap to automatically avoid the traps.
Jump the pit (20% minimum energy required, higher Agility increases your chances).
Go west and open the door.
Click on the large golden bird to reset the puzzle until it lands on the solution shown in the image on this page. Then click the tiles indicated on the picture.
Drop your cat and talk to the Sphinx, ask for help. (I need help. → Okay, that sounds fair.)
Riddle answer: 9. (. → Totally positive.)(if you give the wrong answer your cat will disappear)
Talk to the [[High Priest (Sophanem)
Return to the pyramid (right-click door and open) and jump the pit again to trigger the next flashback.
Open the western door (directly south of you) and take the canopic jar back (you can only pick up the correct one).
A level 75 or 81 enemy (see the guardians in the info box above) will appear, kill it and take the jar.
Leave the room and jump across the pit.
Jump back across the pit.
Solve the western door puzzle and drop the jar where you found it.
Leave the room again and jump across the pit once more.
Exit the pyramid via the entrance ladder.
Talk to the High Priest. (Sure, no problem.)
Go to the house south of the church and talk to the Embalmer to give him the linen, salt, and sap.
If you don't have a linen, go north-east to the Spinning Wheel and talk to Raetul to buy linen for 30 coins. (Must need to ask the embalmer where to find linen befor Reatul let you buy linen)
If you need a pile of salt, it can be found by using an empty bucket on the pond north of Sophanem and then using the full bucket on the suntrap east of the Embalmer.
Go east and talk to the Carpenter. He will take your willow logs and give you a holy symbol.
Enter the pyramid (right click, open door).
Jump the gap again to trigger the 3rd flashback.
Enter the east door and use the holy/unholy symbol on any sarcophagus. Exit the room.
Jump back across the pit and enter the eastern room again.
Kill the level 91 Possessed Priest.
Talk to the High Priest.
Exit the pyramid.
Talk to the High Priest in the temple.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Warning: Throughout this quest, you will encounter several flashbacks where you remember what you did while you were hypnotised. You must play through these in order to progress through the quest. Prior to triggering each flashback, make sure you are prepared as once you begin a flashback, you will be unable to teleport away until you either finish the flashback, or die. Dying will cause your cat to be lost. During a flashback, to leave the pyramid you are expected to walk back to the entrance. You may also log out and back in, which will place your character outside of the pyramid entrance.

Collect all the supplies needed for the quest, including your cat. You will not have access to your bank after you start this quest, and will face multiple relatively high-level enemies before you can access it again. The closest bank to the Wanderer is in Nardah.

Use the Nardah teleport if you have one or use a magic carpet ride to Pollnivneach, then south to Nardah (or fairy ring code DLQ) and head to the Wanderer (north of Sophanem) in the desert. If you brought an empty bucket to get a pile of salt, go to the pond west of the Wanderer, prior to talking to her. Use the collect water option to get a bucket of salt water.

Note that when you first speak to the wanderer and begin the quest, the game will check your Attack, Strength, Ranged, and Magic levels, as well as the Strength, Ranged strength, Magic strength, and defence bonuses of any items you have equipped or in your inventory. The highest of these influences which canopic jar you are most likely to obtain, which affects which apparition you fight and which potion drop you will receive from the quest's final boss. While your stats and items make getting a certain jar more likely, note that there is still a chance to get a different one regardless.

The Wanderer will have a strange reaction to your cat. Ask her why she has a problem with the cat. She will tell you that if you get your cat away from her, she would tell you about the secret entrance to Sophanem. Wait, and you will automatically pick up your cat. She will then ask for a tinderbox and full waterskin. Talk to her again and say Yes, I have them all here (4th dialogue option). Once you give them to her, she will hypnotise you and you'll enter a small cave just north-east of her tent. You can now use this passage to enter the city at any time, including if you die, which will give you the quest items back.

You will end up just outside a pyramid in Sophanem, and a canopic jar will appear in your inventory. The door to the pyramid is immediately to your south, with a picture of a cat on the door. Proceed to the first Flashback. Note: If you take too long, a spectre will attack you and steal some of your gold or deal damage.
Warning: Prior to proceeding, ensure you are prepared and familiar with the Flashback mechanics outlined at the start of this walkthrough.
Important note: Using the mini-map to navigate the pyramid will automatically avoid the traps (both the wall-crushers and pit traps) and is much more time efficient than manually navigating it.

Touch the door of the pyramid to begin the first flashback. During the flashback, you will need to go through the pyramid. You'll see some wall crushers. Stand on the opposite wall and don't go next to them, as they will damage you if you do. Once you're past the crusher blocks, you'll find pit traps in the next hallway. If you step on the wrong spot, you'll fall into a pit and end up at the beginning of the pyramid. You can move forward by clicking on the map, and your character will avoid the traps automatically. To avoid traps, stay along the left wall until you pass the whitish rectangle on the wall, and then go to the right side. Continue walking until you are opposite a square. Go back to the left side until you pass a candle. Switch to the right wall once more.

You'll see mummies (level 84). They will attack you; simply go past them. You'll also see Scarab swarms (level 96) crack out of the ground. They can rapidly hit you for 2 damage and can also inflict a poison condition which hits you for another 2 points of damage, and they very obnoxiously stop you in your tracks, regardless of whether or not you have auto-retaliate enabled. Continue to some more wall crushers. Past these—you'll eventually find a large pit. Jump over it. (You'll need 20% run energy. If you fail, you'll reappear near the second set of wall crushers.)

Go to the west door (double-check your compass) and try to open it. Now, you need to solve a puzzle. The objective is to flip all of the tiles onto their gold sides. There is no required number of flips that you must make, nor is there any limit of tries. Each time you flip a tile, the nine tiles in a 3x3 grid will also flip. To solve this puzzle click on the squares in the order shown on the image below (make sure the puzzle is in the default position as shown below. To get to the default position, right click on the gold solution to reset. Keep hitting the "reset puzzle" button until the puzzle looks as shown in the picture below).
Once you've solved it, you'll wake up fully healed outside the pyramid.
left

After you finish the flashback, talk to the Sphinx with your cat out. Ask for help and the Sphinx will ask you this question: "A husband and a wife have six sons and each son has one sister. How many people are in the family?" The answer is 9 (6 brothers + 1 sister + 2 parents = 9; while a naive reading might assume that each brother has a separate sister, since every member of the family is related, if that was true each brother would have six sisters, not one sister). If you guess wrong, you will lose your cat and have to obtain another one from Gertrude. Before making your guess, the Sphinx will ask you to confirm your answer; if you are about to choose the wrong answer, your cat will shake its head and scratch your leg as a warning. Once answered correctly, you will receive the Sphinx's token, so you can speak to the High Priest.
Go to the High Priest, located in the south-west corner of the city, and ask him about the remains. He will tell you to put them back in the burial chamber.

Return to the pyramid, and select open door. Your cat will help you get back inside. Go through the pyramid using the same steps as in the first flashback. Before you jump the pit examine the canopic jar in your inventory! so that you can know in advance which attack style the apparition you must fight will use, and thus be able to bring the appropriate equipment to fight it. When you jump across the pit, you'll enter the second flashback.

The second flashback begins where the first one left off—on the other side of the pit. Open the unlocked door of the west room. Examine the four jars to find which one you used to have in your inventory. If you don't remember, you can open your quest journal to figure out which jar you need to pick up, which will be stated by the major organ inside of it, or just try them all. The player will only take the correct one. As soon as you try to pick up your jar, one of four apparitions will attack you, which can range in Level between 75 and 81 and which uses a specific attack style. Two of the apparition types attack with Magic and the other two with Melee, and which one will appear depends on which specific jar you have, as follows. Protection prayers offer full protection against their attacks.
If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like an ape. Eeew! I think it contains someone's intestines", then the guardian will be Apmeken, who attacks with Magic.
If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like a crocodile. Yuck! I think there are lungs inside.", then the guardian will be Crondis, who attacks with Magic.
If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like a bug. Disgusting! I think there's a stomach inside", then the guardian will be Scabaras, who attacks with Melee.
If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like a man. I think it contains someone's liver. Eeew!", then the guardian will be Het, who attacks with Melee.

Dying during this fight will send you to your respawn location with the canopic jar in your inventory. Any other items are subject to normal death rules, while Ultimate Ironmen will have a death pile next to the pyramid entrance in Sophanem. Your cat will be gone. Re-entering the pyramid will return you outside of the west room in the flashback state.

Once you've defeated the guardian, pick up the jar. Leave the room and jump across the pit again. The flashback ends. (If you forgot to pick up the jar before jumping the pit, leave the pyramid and enter it again to return to just outside the jar room.)

After the flashback is over, you will feel regret, and you will say to yourself that you think you should put the jar back. Jump the pit and go to the west door (remember you need to have 20% run energy to successfully jump the pit). You will need to solve the same door puzzle to enter the room. Click on the large golden bird to reset the puzzle until it lands on the solution shown in the image to the right. Then click the tiles indicated on the picture. Once you turn all of the tiles to their gold side; you will automatically enter the room. Drop the canopic jar where you found it and go back through the pyramid, across the pit, past the monsters, and past the traps to the High Priest. Alternatively, you can log out and back in, which will return you to the entrance with the objective still completed.

Talk with the High Priest. He will ask you to prepare a ceremony. You will need to help the Embalmer and the Carpenter. If you used a Protection prayer during the fight, recharge your prayer points at the altar here.

Then, head to the city's eastern side to find the Carpenter, who can be found directly East of the Southern pyramid. He needs a willow log to make a holy symbol. Talk to him again to give him your willow log. After a short wait, the carpenter will give you the symbol.
Note: You can skip the "short wait" by turning in the bucket of sap, linen, and bag of salt to the Embalmer and then going back to the Carpenter to collect the holy symbol immediately.

Talk to the Embalmer in the building south of the High Priest, near the water symbol. He will ask for a bucket of sap, linen, and a bag of salt. Tell him you will get the items later. To get a pile of salt, use the bucket of saltwater on the suntrap east of the embalmer. A bucket of sap can be obtained by using a knife with an evergreen tree or a pointy regular wood tree with the description "A commonly found tree" while you have a bucket. If you didn't bring sap, you can get some from the latter kind around Lumbridge or the Grand Exchange. The linen can be bought from Raetul for 30 coins. He is located in the north-east part of Sophanem, near the silk stall. Note: You will not be able to buy the Linen from him before you have spoken to the embalmer, as your player character will decline his offer.

The Carpenter or the Embalmer (whoever you helped last) will tell you that the High Priest began the ceremony without you. To find him, go back into the pyramid past the traps and the pit. As you cross the pit, the third flashback will begin.

You will now have an unholy symbol in your inventory. Your character tells you that your mistress wants it inside the pyramid so she can teleport there. Enter the east room and use the symbol on any sarcophagus around the walls. The flashback will end once you're done; if not, leave the room.

You will speak to yourself again showing your regret for causing harm to the town. Jump across the pit again and re-enter the eastern burial chamber. After a cutscene, you'll learn that the Wanderer was behind it. She is really the Devourer, an evil goddess, and she'll possess one of the priests.

You will fight a level 91 Possessed Priest. You can use Protect from Magic and kill him. Once you have dealt with him he drops a four-dose attack, magic, agility, or defence potion (Ironmen may wish to keep the agility potion if they plan on doing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, should they receive it). Talk to the High Priest again, and he will tell you to meet them back above.

Note: If you take too long to defeat him, the message "The priest seems to have recovered from the Devourers spell" will appear, and you will have to exit the door and re-enter to face him again with full Hitpoints.
After talking to the High Priest, leave the room, and you will see the final flashback as a cut-scene. You will be escaping from the pyramid, and Icthlarin, god of the dead, will dehypnotise you.
You will find yourself outside the pyramid. Talk to the High Priest to complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Speak to Cassius by the Lumbridge pond, south of the windmill. (Yes.)
Speak to Gillie Groats in the Lumbridge cow field, just north of the entrance. (Can you share what makes your cows so productive?)
Speak to Seth Groats in the farmhouse by the chicken coop, north-west of the cow field.
Search the [[Shelves (The Ides of Milk)
Return the book to Cassius to receive a milk sample.
Drink the milk sample in front of Cassius, then speak to him again to receive another sample for Duke Horacio.
Speak to Duke Horacio upstairs in Lumbridge Castle about the permit.
Return to Gillie Groats and drink the milk sample when prompted.
Open the gate directly north-east of Gillie and defeat the [[Brutus
Its normal attacks cannot kill you during the quest, but its special attacks can hit up to 19 and cannot be prayed against.
When it snorts, move two tiles to either side or one tile backwards.
When it growls, move two tiles to either side.
Speak to Gillie Groats about the bull.
Return to Cassius and confront him.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Speak with Cassius by the Lumbridge pond, just south of the windmill. He will offer you a partnership in his future milk empire, and ask you to question Seth and Gillie Groats about how they've made their animals so productive.

Gillie Groats can be found inside the Lumbridge cow field, just north of the gate. Talk to her and she'll say that happiness is the secret to better milk production, and suggest you talk to her father.

Seth Groats can be found inside the house by the chicken coop, slightly north-west of the cow field. He will recommend his book, The Groats Principles, which discusses his approach to husbandry. Search the shelves on the southern wall to obtain it, and return to Cassius.

Cassius will snatch the book away, and offer a milk sample. Drink the sample to discover that his milk tastes awful. Although the player takes 1 poison damage, they will not be poisoned and cannot die. Speak to him again, and he will give you another milk sample for Duke Horacio to try, in order to convince the Duke to give you a permit for selling the milk.left

Duke Horacio can be found in Lumbridge Castle on the . Ask about the permit, and he'll refuse to issue it without the Groats' approval, seemingly worried about their potential response. He will ask you to speak with Gillie directly.

Return to Gillie and offer her the sample. She'll be apprehensive about drinking a strange liquid, and ask you to drink the sample instead. Drink it (no damage will be dealt this time) to find that it tastes even worse than the first one. Gillie will comment that she might be helping people out by refusing to give a permit, given how bad the milk seems to be. You will then ask if there's anything you can do to convince her to give you one, and she'll mention that an aggressive bull has been disrupting her herd, saying that if you deal with it, she'll authorize the permit. Head to the gate north east of her and prepare for a fight.
left

full.h: Grabbing the bull by its horns

steps.t: Bull/Strategies
Upon entering the north-eastern gate you will need to fight the bull. If you wish to leave during the fight, run south-west to the gate to escape.

The bull attacks using melee with a max hit of 3. However, this cannot kill the player during the quest, as they will always hit for 0 if the player is at 1 Hitpoint. After three melee attacks, he will also start using his special attacks after 1-6 hits. The damage of both special attacks scale with the player's Hitpoints level, with a max hit of upwards of 19. This damage is NOT mitigated like his auto-attacks, and will kill the player if they hit. Low level players can expect to be hit for around 30-40% of their health by the special attacks. This damage ignores protection prayers, but may be avoided entirely by moving out of the way before Brutus moves.

When the bull *snorts*, he will then slam the ground and hit a number of tiles around the player, either a 3x1 row (if the player is adjacent to him) or an L shape (if the player is diagonal to him). This attack can be fully avoided by stepping two tiles to either side or one tile backwards.
When the bull *growls*, he is about to charge towards the player. This attack can be fully avoided by stepping two tiles to either side.
Note: For combat pures, Rings of recoil may be used to avoid gaining Hitpoints experience.

After defeating the bull, your player will pick up the tag he drops and it reveals the bull was Brutus, Cassius' supposed business associate. Return to Gillie and let her know that the bull belonged to Cassius. She'll tell you to confront him; return to Cassius, and it is revealed that he was stealing milk from Seth's cow herd, and Brutus' aggression disrupting the herd was causing them to produce bad milk. He then chastises you for killing Brutus, and refuses to speak to you further.
Congratulations, quest complete!
After completing the quest, return to Gillie to receive the additional quest rewards.
Obtain the [[Black bead
Buy them from the Grand Exchange for Red bead + Black bead + Yellow bead + White bead coins

Kill imps, recommended for free players either near the southern entrance to Falador or the top of the Karamja volcano; or for members east of the Ardougne Monastery, at the entrance of Chasm of Fire, or around the Charcoal furnace
Talk to Wizard Mizgog on the top floor of the Wizards' Tower with all four beads in your inventory.(Give me a quest please. → Yes.)
Congratulations, quest complete!

Make your way to the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village and over a long stone bridge. Climb the stairs, and go up to the . Talk to Wizard Mizgog and ask him questions to find out that he needs your help. He will tell you that Wizard Grayzag's imps have stolen his beads and he wants you to get them back for him. He needs you to collect:
A black bead - Black bead coins
A yellow bead - Yellow bead coins
A red bead - Red bead coins
A white bead - White bead coins
Note: You can collect the beads in advance without starting the quest to save additional trips to the Wizards' Tower.

Beads are only obtained as a 5/128 drop from imps, buying them through the Grand Exchange, or trading with other players. Because of the relatively low drop rate, many players may choose to buy beads on the Grand Exchange to avoid the hassle of killing imps (for a total cost of Red bead + Black bead + Yellow bead + White bead coins).

If looking to collect the beads as a drop, imps commonly spawn throughout Gielinor, and you might consider collecting them passively over time when encountering them. Alternatively, you can use some of the following hotspots where many spawn at a time:
East of the Ardougne Monastery
On top of the Karamja Volcano (be aware of level 14 scorpions in this area)
Southern entrance to Falador
In a basement in Kastori (4 spawns in a 6x8 room, negates the inconvenience of teleporting imps)
Every 30–120 seconds there is a 25% chance for an imp to disappear into a puff of smoke and teleport a short distance away. Using Magic or Ranged is recommended to reduce downtime when killing them.

Once you have all four beads, return to Wizard Mizgog and give them to him to finish the quest. He won't accept them one at a time, so Ultimate Ironmen should plan to get the whole thing done at once.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Climb down the [[trapdoor (Canifis)
Search the [[wall (The Hollows)
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz. (I want to join your organisation.)
Talk to Florin through the gate to Burgh de Rott.
Put a piece of food into the [[open chest (In Aid of the Myreque)
Talk to Razvan near the pub. (Are there any 'out of the way' places in here?)
Enter the pub, climb over the [[broken wall (Burgh de Rott)
Climb down and mine the rest of the [[Rubble (In Aid of the Myreque)
Use your spade on the remnants to fill the buckets. There is enough here to fill five buckets.
Upon mining the rubble, you will find a plaster fragment and a [[Dusty scroll (In Aid of the Myreque)
The items dug up can be safely dropped, unless you need the nails.
When finished, use the buckets of rubble on the [[Rubble Pile
Talk to Razvan again. (I'd like to help fix up the town.)
Talk to Aurel in the general store to the north-east. (I'd like to help fix up the town.)
Climb up the ladder right outside.
Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the broken roof of the store.
Climb back down and Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall of the general store.
Talk to Aurel again to get a [[Crate (In Aid of the Myreque)
Tip: If you are asked for items you aren't satisfied with before receiving the crate, you can disrupt the dialogue by walking away to re-roll the requested items.
If you weren't able to bring all of the items, head to a bank now to get the remaining items for this section.
Add 10 bronze axes, 10 raw mackerels or 10 snails (depending on what is asked), and 3 tinderboxes to the crate.
Talk to Aurel.
Talk to Cornelius in the bank. (What should I do now?)
Use a hammer with 2 planks, 1 swamp paste, and 8 nails on the broken bank booth
Use a hammer with 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall outside.
Talk to Cornelius to recruit him. ()
Talk to Razvan. (What should I do now?)
Repair the [[furnace (Burgh de Rott)
Talk to Gadderanks in the general store.
Talk to the Vampyre Juvinate in the store.
Talk to Wiskit.
Kill the two juvinates and then Gadderanks (you'll need a silver weapon or Wolfbane dagger or Efaritay's aid to damage them).
Talk to Gadderanks.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the hideout where the quest started. (The room under the Canifis pub)
Talk to Polmafi Ferdygris.
Highly Recommended: Give Ivan Strom some food (he only takes snail, salmon, slimy eel, or stew) and steel armour (he only takes a steel med helm, steel chainbody, and steel platelegs) before leaving.
Talk to Ivan Strom to go on a simplified version of Temple Trekking and take either the short or long route. (you can't bring a pet - it must be banked!)
Route 1 features two level 75 Vampyre Juvinates, whereas route 2 features 4 level 50 Juvinates.
Kill the Vampyre Juvinates before they can kill Ivan Strom.
Tip: Alternate your attacks between them so they stay focused on you. Also, it may be possible to talk to Ivan to prevent the vampyre from attacking him

After you're done escorting Ivan, talk to Drezel in the underground temple for a key. (Veliaf told me about Ivandis. → Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis? → The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!)
Use the key on the [[keyhole (Paterdomus)
Search the [[bookcase (Paterdomus Library)
Return to the room under the Canifis pub, then go to the blockaded cave entrance just south-east of the wall.
Use a hammer on the wooden boards and enter the cave.
Use your soft clay on the [[Coffin (Ivandis)
Go to any furnace with your mould, a silver bar, a mithril bar and a sapphire, and craft a silvthrill rod. (Fairy ring dkr for Edgeville Furnace.)
Cast Lvl-1 Enchant on the rod.
Use the rod on the well underneath the Paterdomus Temple (where Drezel was) with a rope in your inventory. (Nearest fairy ring cks)

Return to the Burgh de Rott pub basement with the Rod of Ivandis (it must be in your inventory, not equipped), then speak to Veliaf. (I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis! → Yes, I've come to give the Rod of Ivandis to you!)
Congratulations, quest complete!
Darkness of Hallowvale
Medium tier of the Morytania Diary
Note: You must be on the normal spellbook to complete this quest as it is required to cast Lvl-1 Enchant, and the Enchant sapphire or opal tablet does not work here.

Start the quest by speaking to Veliaf Hurtz in the Myreque hideout. To reach the caves where the hideout is located, you may either use fairy ring dls or descend through the trapdoor south of the Hair of the Dog tavern. If you used the trapdoor, search the wall south of the ladder and walk through the secret passage. If you used the fairy ring, head through two cave entrances to reach the secret passage.
In the tunnel there is an eastern alcove, in the south eastern corner there is a hidden cave entrance - click on the wall to enter (you can rotate your camera to see the entrance).

Talk to Veliaf. He will ask the player to travel to Burgh de Rott to establish a new base of operations for the Myreque now that their hideout has been compromised. (I want to join your organisation. → Ok, tell me this information you have to impart. → Can you tell me about the job? → Ok, I'll do the job.)

Note: You must bring the items required for this section with you to Burgh de Rott, as there is no functioning bank nearby until you repair it later in the quest. It is also highly recommended to have the rest of the items ready in your bank for the second stage of the quest.

Head to Burgh de Rott, located south of Mor'ton to find angry residents at the gate. Talk to Florin from the outside of the gate and he will refuse to let you in, accusing the player of coming to steal their blood and food for the vampyres. Use your food item on the open chest directly in front of the gate, and Florin will then let you into the town. Shades will no longer attack you.
Once inside, ask Florin whether there are any 'out of the way' places in Burgh de Rott, and he will suggest the cellar of the inn. First, you need to clear the rubble covering it.

full.h: Clearing out the rubble from the bar basement

steps.t: Go to the inn just south-east of the gate, climb over the broken wall, and mine the rubble covering the trapdoor by using your pickaxe on it. Open the trapdoor and climb down to enter the cellar.

Inside are numerous piles of rubble. Mine the rubble, then remove it to place it in your bucket using the spade. If you forgot to bring a bucket, there is a bucket spawn near the well south of the front gate. Each bucket you have can contain 3 loads worth of rubble. Mine all of the rubble within the cellar. When the buckets are filled, climb the ladder and use them on the rubble pile just south-west outside the bar to empty them (the rubble cannot otherwise be disposed of).
Warning: Any items you drop will disappear if you exit the basement. The rubble will reappear upon leaving the cellar and returning if you only mine it and do not remove it.

Note: Every few rubble piles you mine, you will get 8 items: nails (10 bronze, 5 iron, 3 steel, 2 black, 1 mithril), 1 rock, 1 broken glass, dusty scroll, and plaster fragment. If you do not have space, they will drop to the floor, while the dusty scroll and plaster fragment will be discarded into the buckets of rubble, and can be reobtained by searching the rubble pile. You can read the scroll and fragment, but they are not needed to complete this quest. The rest of the items are not required for the quest, unless you do not have the required nails.

When you have removed the final piece of rubble, a cutscene will play of you noticing a plaque on the wall. The plaque holds no significance for this quest. If the cutscene doesn't play, you need to return to the cellar and clear more rubble that magically appears.
Go and talk to any citizen, and inform them that you'd like to help fix up the town. They will ask you to start by fixing up the general store.
left

Talk to Aurel in the general store in the north-eastern part of the city and also tell him that you want to help fix up the town. He will ask you to repair the roof and the walls of the shop. Head up the ladder on the outside of the southern wall of the General Store and use 3 planks and 12 nails in the hole in the roof to repair it. After that, head down and use 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall just east of the ladder.
Note: You can reroll the mackerel/snail meat requirement below by exiting Aurel's dialogue during the dialogue where Aurel tells you what he needs, but before he hands you the crate.

Once done, talk to Aurel again and ask him what you should do now. He will want the store stocked before he can open it. He will always need 10 bronze axes and 3 tinderboxes, and will ask for either 10 mackerel or 10 snail meats. You can provide him with either raw or cooked versions. You will be given a crate to fill up with these items.
Visit a bank to retrieve the items and fill the crate with them. The items cannot be noted.
While you are at the bank pick up these items for the next part of the quest:
5 planks,
a hammer
swamp paste
20 nails
Talk to Aurel again in the Burgh de Rott general store to give him the crate, and he will ask that you repair the bank to the south of the city.
A hammer, 5 planks, swamp paste, 20 nails.
Repair the bank booth by inspecting the bank booth, and then the wall on the west side of the bank as you did before.
Then, ask Cornelius what to do next, and in the course of the conversation he will agree to become the banker. You will now be able to use the bank.

Ask Razvan what you should do next, and he will suggest that you fix the furnace. It can be found in the south-east corner of Burgh de Rott. Take two steel bars, a tinderbox, a hammer and one coal and repair the furnace to the south-east side of the city. Inspect the broken furnace to repair it. Put the coal inside of the newly fixed furnace, and light it with the tinderbox.
After lighting the furnace, you will see a cutscene. Vanstrom has noticed that Burgh De Rott is now inhabited and has ordered his blood tithe collector Gadderanks to collect blood from the residents.

Prepare for a fight with your silver weapon or any weapon wearing Efaritay's aid. Go to the general store, and talk to Gadderanks and then Wiskit. Talk to one of the Vampyre Juvinates and Gadderanks will order the two juvinates to attack you. They may be flinched by dragging them to the south of the room, then standing to the north of the table. You may also safespot them entirely from behind the table if using Ranged or Magic with Efaritay's aid. After one of the vampyres turns into mist, Veliaf will enter and assist you in killing the other vampyre, and then finally Gadderanks himself.
Note: You may leave the room at any time, which will cause the fight to reset.

Once all three have been dispatched, talk to Gadderanks who will be lying on the floor. He will beg you to try and save his family, and in return offers you information of the vampre's weaknesses, before finally succumbing to his injuries. Aurel will pick up his Gadderhammer and give it to you (if you have no free inventory space, it can be claimed from him later).
Talk to Veliaf, and he will tell you to meet him back at his hideout in the Hollows so the Myreque can discuss the move to Burgh de Rott.
Note: You will be prevented from bringing pets in the following section, so bank them now.

Return to Veliaf in the Myreque Hideout and talk to him. He will ask you talk to Radigad and Polmafi to have them head to the Burgh de Rott hideout, but wants you to escort Ivan Strom to the Paterdomus Temple because the mission is becoming too dangerous for the young, aspiring priest. After escorting Ivan, he also wants you to ask Drezel about the rumours of a powerful weapon owned by a man named Ivandis Seergaze.

Talk to either Radigad Ponfit or Polmafi Ferdygris, and they will inform the other that it is time to leave. If you brought items for Ivan, right-click and "use" the items on him. Speak to Ivan when you're ready to escort him through the swamp.

You will be asked to select between Route 1 (short route) and Route 2 (long route). The short route involves a fight against two level 75 Vampyre Juvinates, and the long route involves a fight against four level 50 Vampyre Juvinates. Although the short route is a harder fight, it is easier to defend Ivan from just two enemies, so choosing this route is recommended.

If Ivan's health becomes too low, or he runs out of food, he will teleport out. He will let you know in the chat how much food he has remaining. If he teleports out, killing the juvinates will not progress the quest. You will need to leave the area to the south which will take you somewhere around Canifis so you can return to the hideout and try again. He will keep any gear that was given to him, but you will need to give him food again as he will have run out. If you leave the area while Ivan is still around, he will return to the hideout with the same amount of food that he had left.

The easiest way to protect Ivan is to ensure that he stays behind you. If using melee, just attack the juvinate directly in front of you to occupy him. If using Ranged or Magic with Efaritay's Aid, don't move from the starting square to ensure that Ivan does not move at all, and also attack the juvinate directly in front of you. If using this method, the other juvinate/s will wander around for a while, and then eventually engage Ivan.

Once you have killed the first vampyre, you can prevent the second vampyre from attacking Ivan by standing behind him, initiating a conversation with him, and then moving into the square where Ivan was. He will then move one square behind you, blocking the vampyre from attacking him.

It is possible to finish either route without giving Ivan anything, but it is difficult, and it will often require several attempts just to keep Ivan alive. Therefore, it is highly recommended to give Ivan armour and food.

After successfully escorting Ivan, climb down the trapdoor to the west and talk to Drezel. He will thank you for bringing Ivan; ask him where you might get more information on Ivandis's weapon, and he will give guarded answers. Tell him that the lives of those few left in Morytania rest on this, and he will relent and give you a key to the library. (Veliaf told me about Ivandis. → Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis? → The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!)

Use your key on the empty wall to the east containing a keyhole, and a trapdoor will appear. Go down the trapdoor into the library, and search the middle bookcase facing the western wall; you will pick up a book titled inside The sleeping seven. Read the book.

Return to the tunnel just outside the Myreque hideout, and just to the east of the northern brick wall you should see two wooden boards forming an 'X' which are covering an entrance - use a hammer on the boards and then enter the cave entrance that appears. Inside the cave is a coffin. Use some soft clay on the coffin to get a rod mould.
Note: If 'nothing interesting happens', you forgot to read "The sleeping seven".
Head to any furnace with your rod mould, and use a silver bar, mithril bar, and cut sapphire to craft a Silvthrill rod, and then enchant it using Lvl-1 Enchant.
Note: If using fairy rings for travel, pick a location like the Edgeville furnace where you can quickly return to Canifis using CKS afterwards.

Take the enchanted Silvthrill rod and a rope back to the basement of Paterdomus Temple, and use the rod on the well in the room next to Drezel with the rope in your inventory to create the rod of Ivandis.
Take the rod of Ivandis to Burgh de Rott, go into the cellar of the pub, and give it to Veliaf to complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Vanstrom Klause in the Canifis pub (near the staircase). CKS (Why do they need help? Are they in trouble? → Perhaps I could help you out here.)
Grab the 6 wooden planks, 10 coins, a hammer, all the steel weapons and nails, and fill your Druid Pouch if you haven't done so already before teleporting!
Travel to Mort'ton (Mort'ton teleport, Minigame teleport to [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)

Talk to Cyreg Paddlehorn (east, by the boat). (Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons. → Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons? → If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head! → What kind of man are you to say that you don't care? → Give wooden planks to Cyreg)
Board the boat. (Be sure to have filled your Druid Pouch before attempting to board the boat!)
Go north and climb the tree rope bridge.
Repair the bridge.
Continue north and talk to Curpile Fyod. (I've come to help the Myreque, I've brought weapons.)
Check the spelling of your answers before choosing them.
Go north and enter the wooden doors set into the hill.
Head north-west following the eastern wall to the north west until you find an alcove. Enter the cave entrance in the southern wall of this alcove.
Talk to Veliaf (no chat options needed).
Talk to everyone else (no chat options needed).
Talk to Veliaf (talk to him and give him your steel weapons).

Kill the level 97 Skeleton Hellhound (you can safespot the hellhound by luring it to the north-east side of the room, to the right of the north barrel or below the north-east bed shown in the picture on the right).
Talk to Veliaf, ask how to get out. (How do I get out of here? → Ok, thanks.)
Go back by entering the cave entrance and search the wall to the north.
Climb up the ladder in the north side of the room.
Talk to the Stranger in the Canifis pub (the one sitting in the chair where Vanstrom Klause was).
Congratulations, quest complete!
In Aid of the Myreque

Speak to Vanstrom Klause, the man sat down in the north-east corner of the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis. He wants you to deliver some weapons to the Myreque, a group of rebels fighting against the vampyres that rule over Morytania. If you agree to help Vanstrom, he will also tell you about a boatman in Mort'ton who is rumoured to be able to show you the Myreque hideout.
Druid pouch (must have 5 charges), [[Silver sickle (b)

Go to Mort'ton. You can walk on foot, but beware that the ghasts on the way will drain charges from your Druid pouch - you may consider taking six Mort myre fungus in your inventory so you can refill the pouch when you arrive. If you've unlocked fairy rings and have at least 50 Agility, you may skip the Mort Myre Swamp using the fairy ring west of Canifis and entering bip, then using the agility shortcut to arrive south of the swamp.

Find Cyreg Paddlehorn. He is located on the eastern edge of Mort'ton, near his boat at the bridge leading to the Barrows. Attempt to persuade him to bring you to the Myreque. Cyreg will be very secretive about how to find them though, so you will have to choose the correct sequence of responses to make him feel guilty in order for him to allow you to use his boat. The steel weapons must all be in the inventory to continue dialogue. Choose the following responses in this order:
Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons... (2)
Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons? (2)
If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head! (3)
What kind of man are you to say that you don't care? (3)

He will decline to take you himself, but will allow you to rent his boat provided you prove that you have some defence against the ghasts. He will also request 3 planks to fix his boat and 3 to fix a bridge. The player will show him the druid pouch with at least five charges. Give him the planks and he will give you directions to the hideout. Finally board the boat to travel to The Hollows; A Ring of Charos(a) may be used to avoid paying the 10 gold to rent the boat.
Note: Do not repair the bridge in the next section before you've followed the prior steps, or you will need to do so again.

Once you land at The Hollows, go north, avoiding the ghasts, until you see a strange tree. Climb up to see a damaged rope bridge. Mend the bridge as you walk along, which requires 75 steel nails per plank (225 steel nails total) and three planks, and then climb down the other side of the bridge.

Go north to the strange-looking hollow tree and talk to Curpile Fyod out front. Tell him you've brought the weapons for the Myreque and then answer some questions for him to prove that you are indeed telling the truth.
Here are the answers to the possible questions:

Note: If you fail to answer the questions correctly, you will be knocked unconscious and wake up at the boat again, but luckily the bridge will still be intact and your druid pouch will not need the full five charges to re-board the boat.

When you have correctly answered the guard's questions, circle around his tree to the north, and the set of doors in the earth there will be unlocked. Enter and proceed to follow the path to the north west. Halfway up there is an eastern alcove. In the south eastern corner there is a hidden cave entrance - click on the wall to enter (you can rotate your camera to see the entrance).

First speak to Veliaf, and he will ask you to introduce yourself to the other five members. Initiate a conversation with each member - it isn't necessary to actually ask any questions of them to continue the quest, just say, "I'll be back later", and then talk to another one.
Note: Combat with the Skeleton Hellhound will begin immediately after you talk to Veliaf, read the next section to read tips on the fight.
Go back and talk to Veliaf again about the weapons, and he will accept them. However...

As you give the weapons, a cutscene ensues where a strange mist envelopes the room, and Veliaf realises that it is a vampyre. The mist shifts, revealing Vanstrom Klause, the stranger you were trying to help. He transforms into his vampyre form and kills Sani Piliu and Harold Evans with Blood Burst. After performing the murders, Vanstrom disappears, before summoning a level 97 Skeleton Hellhound, his "little gift" to finish off the remaining members. In order to regain the Myreque's trust after having lured Vanstrom to them, you must kill the hellhound.

After the cutscene ends, the hellhound will immediately attack you. There is a safespot in the upper eastern corner of the room on the south side of the chair. Using Magic is recommended as the hellhound has no Magic defence and is weak to Earth spells. The hellhound only has 55 Hitpoints, but hits fairly hard; lower levels should bring food. If you have access to Protect from Melee, the fight will be much easier.

Note: You may leave the chamber during the fight, which will cause the hellhound to respawn close to the entrance once you re-enter. Dying in the chamber will cause your gravestone to appear outside of the room. Returning to the area via the boat will not require you to have a druid pouch, and the bridge will not need repairing. Note that if you die, you cannot return via fairy ring dls until the quest is completed.

After defeating the hellhound, talk to Veliaf Hurtz who'll say he needs to speak to his superior in order to instate you into the Myreque; you can also ask him more questions about the Myreque and Vanstrom. Finally, ask him how to leave the hideout; he tells you about a secret passage to Canifis.
Leave the chamber, and search the wall at the end of the tunnel; it will open. Now, climb up the ladder.
Note: Exiting through the trap door is a requirement of the quest. Exiting through any other method will require travelling here again to complete the quest.
You will surface south of the tavern. The nearby trapdoor leads back to the cave, which you can use as an alternate route back to Mort'ton in the future.
Proceed back into the tavern and seek out Vanstrom Klause, only to find that Vanstrom isn't there but only a Stranger. Speak to him to complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Talk to Trufitus in his house located north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. (It's a nice village, where is everyone? → Me? How can I help? → It sounds like just the challenge for me.) Everytime you gather a new herb you need to go show it to Trufitus before being able to get a new kind of a herb.
Go south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai until green and yellow vines labelled 'marshy jungle vine' are seen.
Search the vines and clean the herb. Your character may spend several minutes finding a herb.
Note: Take three if you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters.
Talk to Trufitus. Make sure you cleaned the herb. (Of course!)
Head north-east from Trufitus. There will be [[Harpie Bug Swarm
Search the [[palm tree (Ardrigal)
Note: Take two if you intend to do Legends' Quest.
Talk to Trufitus. (Of course!)
To the direct south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village is a patch of scorched earth.
Search the scorched earth (the squares immediately next to the fire) for the herb and clean it.
Talk to Trufitus. (Of course!)
Go south-east from Trufitus until you reach the Karamja Jungle mine, marked with a pickaxe on minimap.
Search the [[rock (volencia moss)
Note: Take two if you intend to do Fairytale I - Growing Pains (possible required item).
Talk to Trufitus. (Of course!)
Go back by the Harpie Bug Swarms and head north-west until a cave is seen over the cavern. Search the [[rocks (Pothole Dungeon)

In the cave, head south, look for green spots on the wall labelled 'Fungus covered Cavern wall', then search them and clean the herb. This process may take up to a minute. Do not try to use a Rogue's purse dropped by a Jogre. It must be obtained via searching the wall.
Note: Take two if you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters.
Killing a Jogre inside this cave completes an easy Karamja Diary task, and is worth doing along the way.
Talk to Trufitus. (Of course!)
Congratulations, quest complete!

Head to the small village of Tai Bwo Wannai, located south of Brimhaven on Karamja. Talk to Trufitus, found in a small house north-east of the main village area, and ask him where everyone is. He will explain they are afraid to stay in the village. Ask him how you can help, and he will ask for several herbs to mix a potion to commune with the gods, in order to see what fate befalls them.
Note: You cannot collect all of the herbs at once. You will need to go back to talk with Trufitus each time.

Head south-west of the village near the ocean to find marshy jungle vine. Search it to get a grimy snake weed; this may take 1-5 minutes depending on your Herblore level. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus.
Note: If you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters, take two extra to save yourself time later.
Head north-east of Trufitus' hut until you reach a peninsula with several palm trees on it, just south of the agility shortcut.
Avoiding the nearby level 46 Harpie Bug Swarms, search a palm tree to find a grimy ardrigal. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus.
Note: If you intend to do Legends' Quest, take an extra to save yourself time later.
Warning: The tribesmen in this section are aggressive, and can poison you with damage starting at 11.
Immediately south of the village you will find scorched earth. Search it to find the grimy sito foil. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus.
Head south-east of the hut until you reach a group of rocks you can search that are in the mining area, search an empty one to find the grimy volencia moss. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus.
Note: If you intend to do Fairytale I - Growing Pains take an extra to save yourself time later.

Head north-east of the village towards where you found the Ardrigal. Once you find the end of the cliffs, follow the coastline west until you find a pile of searchable rocks. Search them and enter the cave.

Note: You may kill a Jogre inside the dungeon for an easy Karamja Diary task. Take the jogre bones for Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. Although they may drop the grimy rogue's purse, they do not count for the quest.
Run south past the aggressive level 53 Jogres until you find a fungus covered cavern wall. Search it until you find the grimy rogue's purse (may take some minutes).
Note: If you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters, take an extra to save yourself time later.
Return to Trufitus with the final cleaned herb.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Speak with the guard in the courtyard to the north.
Break into the Smashed Window on the East side of the mansion.

Go up the stairs to the and then to the library in the centre.
Take the Address Form off the table and read it.
Search the bookcase on the Western wall for a Black knight helm.
Return to the guard via the smashed window.
Speak to him, using all three options so that he takes each of your three items
Speak with the Gossip using all three options.

Walk down the stairs to begin the trial.
Call the Dog Handler as a witness. Ask him about the poison.
Call the Butler as a witness by speaking to the judge. Ask him about the dagger.
