Congratulations, quest complete!
Speak with Caroline in Witchaven. (I suppose so, how do I get there?)
Talk to Holgart (right next to Caroline) and give him the Swamp paste.
Right-click Holgart and select the Travel option to travel to the fishing platform.
Pick up the Broken glass on the floor (hut to the west).
Go to the north-east corner of the platform and pick up some Damp sticks.
Climb the ladder right next to the sticks.
Go inside the cabin on the west side of the platform and talk to Kennith.
Go back down the ladder to the sea level.
Travel or speak with Holgart for a trip to a remote island.
Talk to Kent.
Talk to Holgart again to go back to the Fishing Platform.
Speak with Bailey in the south-west cabin for an Unlit torch.
Use the Broken glass on the Damp sticks to dry them.
Rub the Dry sticks together to light the torch.
Go back up the ladder.
Go talk to Kennith again.
From outside of the cabin, kick the badly repaired wall to make an opening.
Talk to Kennith again.
Just outside of Kennith's cabin, activate the [[crane (Sea Slug)
Go back down the ladder to the sea level.
Tip: Before leaving, you can catch a fish with a small fishing net on the downstairs platform to complete a task for the Ardougne Medium Diary .
Speak with Holgart again to return to the shore.
Report to Caroline.
Congratulations, quest complete!
The Slug Menace
swamp paste

Talk to Caroline on the coast north of the town of Witchaven, east of Ardougne. She will tell you her husband Kent took her son Kennith to the Fishing Platform a week ago, and she hasn't heard from them since; other families have not heard from the fishermen there either. She wants you to talk to Holgart, who has a boat that can take you to the platform to investigate.

Talk to Holgart, and he will tell you his ship is in need of repairs. He will ask for swamp paste (not swamp tar) to fix it up. Once you give him it, Holgart will appear in a cut scene fixing the boat. Talk to him again to go to the Fishing Platform.
When you arrive, you will notice the odd behaviour of everyone as they all seem to be in a zombie-like trance. Avoid interacting with the sea slugs; they will deal 3 damage if picked up.
Note: If you brought a small fishing net, you can catch a fish here to complete a task for the medium Ardougne Diary.

Look around and find Bailey inside a small room in the south-west corner of the platform. Talk to him, he will tell you about the odd happenings and the hauling up of the sea slugs. Pick up the broken glass on the floor for later in the quest.

Pick up some damp sticks close to the ladder in the north-east corner of the platform, then climb up the ladder. Upstairs, in a room on the west side, past the crane, you will find Kennith. He will tell you that his father tried to leave days ago, but the fishermen stopped him from doing so. He will ask you to find his father, Kent and help him.

Go back to Holgart and talk to him. He will take you to a deserted island, where you will find Kennith's father stranded. Talk to Kent and he will tell you his story. Then ask Holgart to take you back to the platform. Talk to Bailey to find out the slugs' weakness - they are afraid of heat. He will give you an unlit torch, which he cannot light himself as it is too damp. Use the broken glass on the damp sticks, which are found near the ladder to dry them, then rub them together to light the torch (30 Firemaking). If you do not light it now, you will be damaged by a fisherman when going upstairs.

Climb up the ladder again (on the north-east of the platform), go into the room, and talk to Kennith. From outside the room, kick the badly repaired wall to make an opening, then use your lit torch on any fisherman or sea slugs nearby and then talk to Kennith again. Rotate the crane to save him, shown in a cut scene. Talk to Holgart to return to shore. Finish the quest by talking to Caroline.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Make your way to the Carnillean Mansion and speak to the [[Guard (Carnillean)
Climb up the stairs and speak to the guard again.
Inspect Ceril's corpse and the broken window.
Knock on the false wall, then climb up the ladder and inspect the chest in the hidden room up the ladder.
Speak to the guard again. (The window was broken from the outside. → Ceril was stabbed from behind. → A hidden room above us was broken into. → I think that's everything.)
Head to the Fight Arena Bar, and speak to the Khazard Barman. (Do you know anyone called Evelot?)
Track down Evelot by inspecting the following during each track revealed:
Barrels just outside the bar entrance
North-west boulder
North bush
Tree stump
Another boulder
East bush
Approach Evelot to begin the fight. Every few attacks, she will use a special attack that disables protection prayers and drains your prayer.
Finish the conversation with Evelot after defeating her.
Head to the Hazeel Cult's hideout by way of the entrance to the Ardougne Sewers slightly east of the Clock Tower. Board the raft.
If the raft will not move, make sure all sewer valves outside the cave are in the correct position. See the [[Hazeel Cult/Quick guide
Talk to Alomone (if you sided with Hazeel) or Clivet if you didn't .
Talk to Hazeel.
Return to Carnillean Mansion and talk to the [[Guard (Carnillean)
Climb down the ladder inside the house and talk to Claus the Chef.
Search the south-western cooking shelves and press the button. (Yes.)
Inspect the wall next to the noticeboard and enter the passage. (Yes.)

Pick the lock on the chest by moving the pins along to specific positions. They will appear blue if the number is correct but in the wrong position, and green if that pin is at the correct position. The ordering does not change attempt to attempt.
Inspect the [[Dusty scroll (Secrets of the North)
Bring the [[Dusty scroll (Secrets of the North)
Head to the northern entrance of Weiss and speak to [[Big Fish (Secrets of the North)
Head to the main building and speak to Snowflake. (Have you seen anything odd around here recently?) (Chat option 2 if you don't have the Weiss fire notes)
Head to the northern entrance of Weiss and speak to Big Fish. (Why would the killer come here? → What is this ritual you keep talking about? → Okay, I'm done asking questions. What now?)
Head down the stairs in the main building, and go through the southern cave entrance. (Yes.)
After the cutscene, fight the assassin. He will attack with melee or ranged, whichever style the player is not praying protection against.
The assassin will continually throw 1x1 tile smoke bombs around the room, which you then need to lure him inside to be able to deal damage.
The assassin will also occasionally throw vials of poison, which can deal up to 30 poison damage and inflict poison starting at 6 damage.
Talk to Hazeel located just south-west at the cave's entrance.(I'll get going.)
Search the barrel south of the centre room to find a lever handle.
Enter the centre room, using the code BLOOD to unlock the gate.
Open the northern chest using code 7402 to obtain an icy chest.
Light the braziers in the following order: NW, SE, NE, SW (a tinderbox can be found by searching the crate in the room)
Open the western chest to find a jewel shard and a settlements note.
Head to the northern room, pressing the LEFT - UP - LEFT - DOWN arrows in that order to unlock the gate.
Use the handle on the lever mechanism, and pull it.
Inspect the south-western pillar in the room where you fought the assassin for the other jewel shard.
Use the jewel shards on one another, and use the ancient jewel on the icy chest.
Open the gate south of the centre room with the icy key.
Resupply with ranged and magic gear for a fairly difficult boss fight.
Enter the crevice to battle the Strange Creature. [[Secrets of the North#A Strange "Something"
After the cutscene, accept Hazeel's teleport. (Yes.)
Return to the [[Guard (Carnillean)
Congratulations, quest complete!
Enter the ruined house in the south-west of Mort'ton. Search the shelf on the wall. Read the diary. After reading the diary, the quest is started and you are able to create Serum 207.
If you didn't bring Tarromin potion (unf): Pick up the empty vials (can be filled in the house north-east) and search the [[smashed table (Mort'ton)
Make two Serum 207 by adding clean tarromin to a vial of water and then adding ashes.

Use one dose on Razmire (afflicted) in the general store. (What are all these shadowy creatures? → Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.) (Recommended to not use official Mort'ton temple World 377 yet to not get interrupted talking to the NPCs, until the step with repairing.)
Kill five loar shades and pick up their remains. Note: any shades that you killed before talking to Razmire will not count.
Return to Razmire and give him the remains. He may require more Serum 207.
Right click and open his General store, buy an Olive oil.
Open his builders' store, buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, 25 swamp paste and optionally a Flamtaer hammer.
Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy, located in the house east of the general store. Talk to him with Loar Remains.
Talk to him again and ask about the remains and the temple. (What did you find out about the remains? → What can you tell me about that temple?)
Head north-east of Mort'ton and repair the temple until you reach 100% repair and at least 20 sanctity. (Recommended to use official world 377.)
Light the sacred altar in the centre of the temple (or wait until someone else lights it if you don't have level 5 Firemaking)
Use your olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil.
(Recommended) Use Serum 207 on the flame to make Serum 208, which permanently cures NPCs.
Use the sacred oil on a log to create a [[Pyre logs
Head west of Mort'ton general store, to any grouping of 4 stone funeral pyres. Use the pyre log, then Loar remains on a [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)#Cremating the Shades
Light the funeral pyre. Note: This will grant 25 Prayer XP.
Collect the reward.
(Recommended) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire.
Use the Serum 208 on Ulsquire and finish the dialogue.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Note: The only nearby bank is unlocked during In Aid of the Myreque. It is recommended to bring all required items with you on your first visit to Mort'ton.

Head to the most south-western house in Mort'ton and search the shelf on the wall to find a book. You should also search the smashed table, as it contains two Tarromin and Rogue's purse. The Tarromin will allow you to create additional potions later on, and you may save the Rogue's purse if you plan to do Zogre Flesh Eaters. This building also contains a vial spawn in case you didn't bring vials of water with you. You can fill the vials in the sink in the easternmost building.

Reading the book will now allow you to create Serum 207, a potion which may be used on the afflicted in town to temporarily interact with them. If you don't already have a tarromin potion (unf), use tarromin on a vial of water (12 Herblore). Use ashes on the unfinished potion to create the Serum (also complete your second potion) (15 Herblore).
Note: Serum 207 can be bought on the Grand Exchange, but you must make at least one yourself for the purpose of this quest.

Use the Serum on Razmire Keelgan in the general store. Ask him what all these shadowy creatures are, and he will tell you they are restless spirits of the dead. He asks you to kill 5 Loar Shades (the level 40 green shadows) and collect their remains so that he may do some experiments on them.
Note: The kills will only count after Razmire has asked you to kill them, and you must collect the remains via killing them.

That's all five Shades! will appear in the chat when you are done. Return to Razmire and use the Serum 207 on Razmire again, and he will take two of the shade remains from you. He then mentions that Ulsquire Shauncy might also be interested in seeing some shade remains.

Before heading to Ulsquire, open the general store through Razmire and buy some olive oil. Then ask him to open the builders store, and buy 1-2 timber beam, 1-2 limestone brick, and 10-20 swamp paste.
Note: The supplies may be much more expensive on World 377 (the official Shades of Mor'ton minigame world) due to players buying them up, so consider switching worlds temporarily before buying them.

Ulsquire can be found in the house right next to Razmire to the south-east. Give him a dose of Serum 207, and then one of your shade remains. Talk to him again, and ask what he found out from the remains. Ulsquire believes that the tormented spirits should be put to rest, and jokes about rebuilding the nearby temple and experimenting with the sacred flame. Next, ask him what he can tell you about the temple. He will suggest that to rebuild it, you will need the items you have just bought from Razmire. (What did you find out about the remains? → What can you tell me about that temple?)
Note: Make sure you complete the dialogue options with Ulsquire, or interacting with the temple will result in the message You're not quite sure how to fix this.
Hammer or Flamtaer hammer, food, armour, [[Weapons
Now, you must help rebuild the temple located on a small island north-east of the general store, in order to create the sacred oil needed for a pyre funeral.

This section of the quest serves as a short introduction to the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. It is possible to complete this solo if using several Flamtaer bracelet's along with the Flamtaer hammer, but you may consider using the official World 377 dedicated to this minigame to find other players also rebuilding the temple, as this will make the process significantly faster.

In this minigame, players work together to rebuild the temple while under attack from Loar Shades. To complete this quest, rebuild the walls around the temple using your hammer and build materials (20 Crafting). The Flamtaer hammer and Flamtaer bracelet make this process approximately 75% faster (the bracelet degrades after 80 uses). Once fully rebuilt, ignite the flame and then use the olive oil on it to create sacred oil, provided you have at least 10% Sanctity. Sanctity is earned by your contribution towards repairing or reinforcing the walls, or by killing Loar Shades (only recommended for high combat levels).

Note: Once you have your sacred oil, it is optional but highly recommended to use your remaining Serum 207 on the flame with at least 20% Sanctity, to create Serum 208 (15 Herblore). This will permanently cure Razmire and Ulsquire, making them permanently available for dialogue and trade. It may also be used on other afflicted citizens for a small reward.
Sacred oil, logs or axe, loar remains, tinderbox

If you do not yet have logs, cut down a nearby dead tree. Use your sacred oil on the logs to receive a pyre log. Then, head over to one of the funeral pyres, which are the brown patches on the map west of the General Store. Use the pyre logs on the funeral pyre, followed by the Loar remains. Light this and you will see a spirit rise from the pyre. (5 Firemaking)
Collect your reward from the stone pillar next to the pyre and head back to Ulsquire. Speak with him to prompt the end of the quest (use a serum if he has reverted to being afflicted).
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Father Reen outside Al Kharid bank. (That's me!)

Travel to the Ruins of Uzer via the magic carpet south of Al Kharid (or use the necklace of passage teleport to Eagle's Eyrie and run south-east). You can also use a fairy ring (DLQ) and go north-east.
Talk to Father Badden near the ruin entrance. (Reen sent me. → So what do you want me to do? → How can I do that?) Be sure to have Silverlight in your inventory.
Pick and use a black mushroom (or black dye) on Silverlight to dye it black (you can find some beside the staircase).
Go down the stairs and grab a copy of the Strange implement in the north-west corner of the ruin.
Talk to Evil Dave in the dungeon wearing your 3 black items and your dyed Silverlight. (I want to join your group. → I'm evil!)
Talk to Denath on the other side of the portal. (What do I have to do?)
Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. (Do you have the demonic sigil mould?)
Talk to Matthew. (Do you know what happened to Josef?)
Go to any furnace and smelt a demonic sigil (use silver bar on furnace and select 'demonic sigil').
Your black outfit can now be discarded and replaced with combat gear (keep Silverlight with you).
Head back to Uzer and talk to the clay golem outside about last night. (Did you see anything happen last night?)
Search the nearby kilns for a book (there are four kilns – the last two are on the east side of the ruin, and by the magic carpet).
Read the book, and take it to Matthew on the other side of the portal
Go north and talk to Denath. (I forgot the incantation.) (or (I forgot the incantation.) during the ritual). Write down the incantation he tells you as it is used twice during the quest.
Complete the circle and click the sigil in your inventory to chant the incantation (unequip the Silverlight if nothing happens).
TAKE THE DEMONIC SIGIL DENATH DROPPED ON THE FLOOR. (If you do not, you will have to create another Demonic sigil)
Enter the portal to exit the room and take Tanya's sigil.
Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair (You've got to get back to the throne room!) – you should have 4 sigils now.
Talk to Father Badden outside.
Convince Father Reen to join the ritual. (Oh, don't be so simple-minded!)
Talk to the golem, he will refuse to help. (I could just reprogram you again.)
Use the Strange implement on the golem to reprogram him.
Talk to the golem again to make him enter the dungeon.
Talk to Matthew to start the incantation, say it backwards. (Yes)
Kill Agrith Naar with any weapon, but the final blow must be with Silverlight. The demon will heal if you run away as the final blow is being dealt.
Unequip Silverlight.
Choose your reward to finish the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Shantay pass]] and 200 coins)

Talk to Father Reen, south of Al Kharid bank. If you do not have a regular Silverlight, he will give you an uncoloured Silverlight free of charge. If you already have a dyed Silverlight, bank the extra Silverlight. If this dialogue is missed, Silverlight can still be obtained at other points in the quest by speaking to him.

After you start, travel to the Ruins of Uzer (you can enter the desert via the Shantay Pass and use the magic carpet, rub a necklace of passage to Eagles' Eyrie and run south-east or travel with fairy rings to DLQ and run north-east). Be sure to bring your Silverlight with you since you won't be able to continue without it. After arriving in Uzer, talk to Father Badden - be sure to talk to him about all your options. If you haven't already, pick a black mushroom. Afterwards, enter the dungeon.
When you try to enter the demon's lair, Evil Dave won't let you by because you aren't evil enough.
You need to wear at least three items of black clothing. There are several ways to achieve this, including:

Dyeing a desert shirt and a desert robe black by picking a black mushroom outside of the dungeon and crafting it into black dye with a vial and pestle and mortar, for two of the three items (does not work on the desert boots).

Wearing any three black armour items. The black gloves available from the Culinaromancer's Chest also function as a black armour item (although this quest must be completed in order to finish the Evil Dave part of Recipe for Disaster) Note: Wearing heraldic or trimmed black armour items will not be accepted by Evil Dave.
Wearing a black priest gown purchased from the clothing vendor in Varrock.
Wearing dark mystic robes.
Wearing ghostly robes from the Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest.
Wearing shade robes.
Wearing black dragonhide armour, including the shield, but not the spiky vambraces.
Wearing the Antisanta outfit.
Wearing a black cape, black partyhat, black santa hat, black h'ween mask, black dragon mask, and/or a black unicorn mask
Wearing black wizard robes, including either trimmed varieties (blue varieties can be dyed with Black dye).
Wearing a graceful outfit which has been recoloured using dark dye.
You also need to dye your Silverlight black using black dye from the same black mushrooms inside the dungeon (this doesn't count as an "evil" item).
Note: You cannot proceed with the quest if you have a normal Silverlight alongside a dyed Silverlight.

Equip your three black items, then tell Evil Dave you want to join the group, and he will let you through the portal. Evil Dave will take you to the leader of the group, Denath. He will tell you that he needs your help to summon Agrith-Naar, since Josef left. He will tell you the incantation to use, which is different for everyone, so you need to write it down. In case you forget the incantation, you can read the tome you'll find later on and cite the phrase in it backwards.

Optional: Using a chisel and hammer on the demon's throne will give the player six cut gems: two sapphires, two rubies and two emeralds. While this can be done during The Golem quest, it can alternatively be completed during this quest.

Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. Then, talk to Matthew about Josef. He will tell you to find the book that Josef dropped in order to defeat the demon. Talk to the clay golem and ask if it knows what happened last night; it will explain that Denath killed Josef, but not before Josef hid the book in the kiln outside. You must talk to the golem before you can search the kiln!

In Uzer, search the kilns that are outside until you find a Demonic Tome. There are two close by, and two further away. One is north of the magic carpet, and the other is east of the temple. There are 4 kilns in total.

Go to any furnace (such as the furnace in Lumbridge or in Al Kharid. Fairy Ring dkr to Edgeville furnace is fastest), and make a demonic sigil with your silver bar. With the sigil, you will be able to chant the incantation with the group.
You no longer need your black equipment to enter the portal. If you need to gear up for the fight, save a trip and bring what you need. You will need 3 free inventory slots.

Read the book and return through the portal, then hand Matthew the book. Strangely enough, the incantation for summoning the demon that's written in the book is backwards to the one that Denath told you to say. This is due to the fact that the incantation in the book is one to summon the demon (forward) while the one Denath told you was to return him back to the demon plane (backwards).

When you have finished, Denath will call you over to stand next to him and lead the incantation. Using your sigil, chant it in the order that he told you (if you have forgotten, it's written in the book, but backwards). After the portal is opened, instead of the demon coming out of it, Denath will walk into it and disappear. It turns out Denath was Agrith-Naar all along, and you actually desummoned him by saying the incantation backwards, as he intended.

This demon becomes much more powerful in his own dimension, so you need to resummon him and defeat him. Pick up the sigil that Denath dropped (if you don't, you will have to make another one). Alternatively, it is possible to have Tanya drop two sigils by returning to demonic realm immediately after chasing her through the portal (see below). If done correctly, she will drop two sets of sigils and bones.

Evil Dave, Eric, and Tanya will have run away, so chase after them through the portal. Tanya is killed by ghosts, so take her sigil as well. Eric is killed by a falling stone. Convince Evil Dave to return to the lair, and he will give you Eric's sigil. Leave the dungeon and talk to Father Badden and Father Reen. Convince them to help with the ritual and give them both a sigil. You need one more individual to complete the incanctation, so talk to the Clay Golem. However, he was programmed to never help summon demons. Use the strange implement (can be found in the lair) on him to take out the scroll about demon rituals. Speak to the golem again and he will agree to help you.
Silverlight, demonic sigil, equipment to defeat [[Agrith Naar

Return to the demon's lair, enter the portal and talk to Matthew to get everyone to stand in the circle. Chant the incantation with your sigil, this time in the order that you read in the book (the opposite order that you chanted it in last time). Agrith-Naar will immediately appear and turn to Matthew, killing him in the belief that he started the ritual. Your character will then say that you commenced it, prompting the demon to attack you.
Note: You cannot use a Dwarf multicannon during the bossfight, as you'll get a message saying "Some kind of demonic magic prevents the cannon from functioning".

Agrith-Naar is a level 100 demon who remains in the same position throughout the fight. He uses both Melee and Fire Blast depending on where you are and what Protection prayers you have activated. He uses melee by default, but switches to Fire Blast if you activate Protect from Melee or walk out of range. If you walk out of melee range and activate Protect from Magic, he will cast Telekinetic Grab to teleport you next to him.

Any weapon may be used to damage Agrith-Naar, but Silverlight must be equipped when the final blow is dealt, or his health will be restored to 12. The weapon only needs to be equipped; manually casting any combat spell will work for pure accounts.

All damage can be avoided by flinching Agrith-Naar from behind the north-western torch with melee, which will also avoid his Telekinetic Grab. Protection prayers are not required if using this method.
Warning: Avoid moving behind a pillar or torch before the final blow is registered (between the XP drop and the damage being dealt), as it may not count.
Once the demon is dead, your Silverlight will have been merged with the demon's blood into a stronger weapon, the Darklight.
Note: If your prayer runs out during the message or you cancel the chat, un-equipping Darklight will trigger the final dialogue to complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Read the Noticeboard in the Auburn Pub (Yes.)
Talk to Marcus in the bar
Talk to the Bartender (About the missing people...)
Talk to Ictus north of the Quetzal and west of the nearby hill
Talk to Captain Ariadna in south-west Auburnvale, between the two guard towers
Talk to [[Francis (Auburnvale)
Inspect the western wall outside of their house then follow path of red marks to the river west of town.
Inspect the plank to use fishing rod (Fishing Rod Spawn just south west of floating plank) to fish up cloth
Return to Francis or Aemilia with the cloth
Follow the path indicated by the puddles west of town, then north around the mountain, until reaching a cave. Enter the cave
Talk to injured boy
Talk to Francis or Aemilia
Speak to Captain Ariadna at the West Entrance to town with 4 willow longbows (Renu to [[Arcuani's Archery Supplies
Reinforce the west Wall of the house with the boys with 4x Maple Logs and a hammer. (Hammer be found in the house to the north. Maple Trees can be chopped nearby.)
Return to Francis or Aemilia, go upstairs and speak to Etz & Shas (the former injured boy(s))
Go back to the cave west of town
Talk to Antos (east side of the cave) and be prepared to kill 3 [[Strange creature (Shadows of Custodia)
Talk to Antos again to return to Auburnvale.
Talk to Captain Ariadna
Quest Complete
The quest begins in the Auburn Pub. Players have several options for reaching Auburnvale:
Taking Renu to Auburnvale, then running south-west
Using fairy ring AIS, then running north over the bridge
Teleporting to Nemus Retreat with the Pendant of Ates (if the nearby statue has been unlocked), then running north into the town
Once inside the pub, read the notice board hanging on the wall. You notice that the board is covered entirely in missing person posters, and decide to try and look for the missing people.
A fishing rod (or oily fishing rod) and one empty inventory space

After starting the quest, talk to Marcus nearby in the bar, who will tell you about a strange man by the sea claiming the missing people were abducted. The man that Marcus is referring to is Ictus, who is found north-east of the sawmill. Talk to Ictus, and he'll tell you that creatures walking on two legs have been scraping against the walls at night. Besides Marcus and Ictus, you can talk to Captain Ariadna, the bartender, and the shopkeeper for more information about what's happening. Speaking to at least one of them is required to continue. If you don't have a hammer and fishing rod yet, it is recommended to talk to the shopkeeper in the general store as you can buy both while you're there.

Next, go to the house west of the Auburn Pub and speak to Francis or Aemilia. If you haven't talked to Marcus and Ictus yet, the two will refuse to believe you want to help them. Once you've convinced them you genuinely want to help, they will mention that their boys vanished whilst playing upstairs one night. They also mention strange behaviour from the ents that night, who usually pass by their house on a regular path; on the night of the disappearance, however, the ents did not approach their house, as if the ents were avoiding something.

You will ask if you can search their house for clues, and they will allow you to look around. Go outside and investigate the scratched wall. You will notice strange claw marks and a puddle of mysterious liquid; follow the trail south-west outside the town (you don't need to inspect the puddles), until you reach a river with an item hanging on a plank. With a fishing rod (one spawns south-west of the log, and the general store nearby sells them as well), retrieve the wet fabric scrap and bring it to Francis or Amelia, who will confirm that it matches what one of their sons was likely wearing at the time.

After showing the scrap, head back out of town, and follow the path, which will loop around to the northern end of the Custodia Pass. South-east of the rowboat will be a cave; this is the Stalker Den, in which you will find the two boys. Speak to the injured boy deeper inside, and you will automatically bring them back to town, with Francis and Aemilia thanking you for saving them.
Four maple logs, a hammer, and four willow longbows

When you ask to speak to the boys about what happened to them, Aemilia and Francis will say that they're still recovering and refuse to let you. They'll ask you to inform Captain Ariadna of what happened, and when you ask if there's any other way you can help, they'll mention that the scratched wall needs to be reinforced so that the boys aren't abducted again. Use four maple logs and a hammer to reinforce the scratched wall on the . Maple trees can be found around town, with a hammer spawn located just to the north, in the building with a furnace.

Next, talk to Captain Ariadna by the town gate, and she'll ask if you saw anyone else in the caves. You will then offer to help prepare the guards. Captain Ariadna will tell you that their fletcher, Antos, has gone missing and they are in need of bows; she will request four willow longbows for her team. You can grab them from the nearby bank, fletch them using the trees and flax in the area, or use the nearby quetzal to travel to Tal Teklan and buy them from Arcuani's Archery Supplies.

After giving Captain Ariadna the bows and reinforcing the scratched wall, Shas and Etz will be well enough to talk to you. Talk to them on the of Aemilia and Francis's house and they will tell you that Antos was also in the cave with them. After telling you that he was dragged deeper into the cave, they will ask you to rescue him.
Combat gear

Grab some combat gear and head back to the cave entrance from earlier. Inside, run east to a small chamber offshoot to find Antos; you will try to get him out, but three level 93 strange creatures will attack. Activate Protect from Melee to reduce almost all damage (note that this section of the cave is a multicombat area). The creatures will also occasionally inflict a bleed, but standing still will reduce the rate at which it deals damage.

After killing the last of the strange creatures, Antos will ask about the others, but you will sadly tell him that they were all dead. You will automatically bring him back to town; after the dialogue, inform Captain Ariadna of the monsters and that you found Antos, and she will thank you for your help.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Councillor Halgrive outside the East Ardougne church. Ensure that you have at least 1 empty inventory slot. (What's wrong? → I can do that for you.)
Talk to Doctor Orbon in the church. (Okay, I'll take it.)
Put on the plague jacket and [[plague trousers
Pick up & wield the cattleprod next to the incinerator.
There are sheep to the north-west (blue), north (yellow), east (green), and south (red) of the incinerator.
Prod one sheep of each colour through the gate.
Blue sheep
Yellow sheep
Green sheep
Red sheep
Feed your sheep sheep feed until they're all dead.
Pick up the bones and use them on the incinerator.
Return to Councillor Halgrive to complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Mourning's End Part I

full.h: A threat to public health and safety

steps.t: 100 coins
Speak to Councillor Halgrive located in East Ardougne in the graveyard directly south of the church.

He is concerned about plagued sheep located near East Ardougne that escaped from a local farm, causing a threat to the health and safety for the public. He is looking for someone to herd the sheep, kill them quickly and cleanly, and dispose the remains in a special incinerator set up by Farmer Brumty.

Agree to help do the job. He will happily thank you and mention you need a plague suit while herding the sheep. He will tell you to pick up the plague suit from Doctor Orbon and hand you some poisoned sheep feed.

Head inside the church and talk to Doctor Orbon. After explaining you need protective clothing to dispose the escaped infected sheep, he will sell his last suit for 100 coins so he can afford a replacement for himself. Agree to pay for the suit, and you should receive a plague jacket and plague trousers. Pray with missing Prayer points at the altar to complete an easy task in the Ardougne diary.
Plague jacket, plague trousers
2609,3389,title:Location of the yellow sheep,icon:yellowPin,desc:

Head to the fenced in enclosure located north-west of the north bank in East Ardougne. With your plague suit equipped, enter the gate on the west side of the enclosure. Head towards the incinerator where you will find a cattleprod lying on the ground a few steps south of the incinerator. Pick it up.

Leave the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. You can begin to dispose of the sheep by equipping the cattleprod and using it to direct the sheep into the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. The sheep will be prodded in the direction of which you are facing. The sheep can return back to their initial locations if you wait too long to prod. You only need one of each colour (in any order), and you can finish one sheep at a time.
Note: You can have a friend join you and body block the sheep, preventing them from going farther than desired and also prevent them from going back to their original location.
Red sheep are located north of the north bank in East Ardougne.
Green sheep are north-east of the red sheep, directly north of a fenced in area with chopped and fallen trees.
Blue sheep are located north-west of the fenced in enclosure with the incinerator, nearby a small camp with warriors. Do not go too far, as there are also aggressive level 42 moss giants nearby.
Yellow sheep are located south of the Fishing Guild.

Note: If a sheep goes BAAAAA! (uppercase letters), it will be prodded in the direction you direct them towards. If a sheep goes Baa, it will return to its initial location. When directing them to the fenced in pen with the incinerator located, it is better to spam click the sheep so that it does not walk back. If the sheep gets stuck against a corner or wall, prod them again, this will cause them to move towards an open tile. Make sure you prod the sheep one last time to get it IN the pen when you are close.
Plague jacket, plague trousers, [[Sheep feed

Once you have directed them to the gate of the incinerator, the sheep will automatically go inside the gate. Use the poisoned sheep food to kill each sheep. Collect their bones and use them on the incinerator to burn the remains.

Return to Councillor Halgrive and tell him you disposed of the four sheep. He will reimburse you the 100 coins you spent for the protective clothing in addition to 3,000 coins as recognition of your service.
Congratulations! Quest completed!

quick.h: If you already have the 20 unnoted balls of wool

steps.t: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge. (I'm looking for a quest.)
Fred takes the 20 balls of wool.
Congratulations, quest complete!

quick.h: If you don't have the balls of wool

steps.t: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge. (I'm looking for a quest. → Yes.)
He will give you shears if you do not have them.
Enter the sheep pen to the east, connected to his house and shear sheep for 20 wool.
Ultimate Ironmen: You can deliver the balls of wool in several trips. You do not have to deliver all 20 at once.
Note: You cannot shear Rams or "The Thing". If you attack a ram and cannot kill it, run out of the pen until it stops targeting you.
Go to the of Lumbridge Castle.
Click on the spinning wheel in the southern room to spin the wool.
With 20 un-noted balls of wool, return to Fred the Farmer.
Talk to Fred the Farmer and hand them in. (I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!)
Congratulations, quest complete!
Speak to Fred the Farmer at his sheep farm, found slightly north of the Lumbridge Castle. Ask about a quest, and he will task you with bringing him 20 balls of wool.
If you did not bring shears, Fred will give you some. Enter the fenced area connected to the east side of the house where the sheep are.
Note: Players planning to do the free-to-play quest Prince Ali Rescue are advised to shear and spin at least three more balls of wool.

Shear the sheep, either by selecting the "shear" option on the sheep, or right-clicking the shears and selecting "use," then clicking the sheep. After shearing them, the skinny looking sheep will grow back their wool after one minute. If they run away while shearing, just keep trying.

Avoid the rams, which look like regular sheep with horns. They cannot be sheared, and it is easy to accidentally attack them. The pen also contains "The Thing", which Fred warned the player about. This is actually two penguins in disguise as a sheep, and attempting to shear it will cause the penguins to squeak and run away from you. It can be identified as the only sheep with the "Talk to" option, and poses no danger during the quest. "The Thing" is later encountered during the Cold War quest.
Low-level players may consider setting their attack options to "Hidden" for the duration of this quest to avoid entering combat with them by accident.

Once you have 20 pieces of wool, they must be spun into balls of wool. Go to the of the Lumbridge Castle, and find the bedroom on the south end of the castle. Inside is a spinning wheel; click on the wheel with the wool in your inventory to spin your wool into balls. When they are all spun, go back to Fred the Farmer to finish the quest. If you do not have the space to carry all 20 pieces of wool, you can make smaller deliveries until you reach the required total. Note that Fred will not accept noted balls of wool.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Reldo, located in the library in Varrock Palace. (I'm in search of a quest.)
Check the [[bookcase (Shield of Arrav)
Talk to Reldo again.
Take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen, located in the Varrock Museum.
Trade your half of the certificate with your partner. (Ironmen: Use the certificate halves on your partner)
Use both halves of the certificate on each other to make a completed [[Certificate (Shield of Arrav)
Take the certificate to King Roald in the castle to receive your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

During this quest, you must choose one of two gangs to join. In order to fully complete it, you must have a partner, and they must pick the opposing gang. If your partner has already fully completed the quest, they may only assist if they both picked the opposing gang and chose to obtain additional certificate halves before completing the quest.

To find a partner, you may choose to ask in the official chat-channel OSRS SOA. Beware of in-game money. It is possible to avoid the trade interface by using the key and certificate halves obtained during the quest on your partner, allowing the quest to be completed by ironmen and players with new account trade restrictions.

Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library, the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him for a quest, and he will suggest you look around for a book called the Shield of Arrav, which may have a quest for you. To find it, search the bookcase with a blue and white book in the top shelf, located on the east side of the short bookcases in the middle of the room. Read the book, then speak with Reldo again to tell him you have read it. The player will ask him about the whereabouts of the Phoenix Gang and the Black Arm Gang. At this stage, you can choose to join either gang. If you wish to join the Phoenix Gang, speak to Baraek, the fur trader in the market. Otherwise, talk to Charlie the Tramp next to the southern gate of Varrock.
When picking your gang, there are a number of considerations:
It is much easier to find Phoenix Gang members via the official chat-channel.
Phoenix Gang is recommended for lower combat levels.
Black Arm Gang is recommended if you do not want to gain combat experience.
Broken shield

Take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen, located in the Varrock Museum. He will take your half of the shield and give you two copies of half the certificate. Your partner, who has the other half of the Shield, will receive the other half of the certificate.

Note: At this stage, players looking to help others in the future may talk to the Curator again to receive additional certificate halves. This is only possible before completing the following step. Using the drop trick is not required. There is no practical limit to how many certificate halves you can have.

Trade one half of the certificate with your partner for the other half. When you have both certificate halves, use them on the other to obtain a completed certificate. If completing the quest as an Ironman you must 'use' the key/certificate on each other.
Take the certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to receive your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

With one free inventory space, talk to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village. A gnome glider is nearby, as well as fairy ring CKR. (Why do I need to run? → Rashiliyia? Who is she? → What can we do? → I'll go to see the Shaman → Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.)
Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, found in the most north-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai (quest icon on minimap). Fairy ring CKR is nearby.

Follow the chat options once you've used the belt on him. (Mosol Rei said something about a legend? → Do you know anything more about the temple? → Tell me more. → I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon! → Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.)
Head to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon south-west of the [[Shipyard (Karamja)
Use your spade on the mound of earth.
Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure, then use your rope on the fissure. You will lose the item.
Search the fissure (32 Agility) to climb down and follow the cave south until you reach the stream.
Search the cave-in at 2 to enter a new cave. (Yes, I'll wriggle through.)
Search the loose rocks at 6 to find a tattered scroll. (Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.) Read the scroll.
Search the sacks at 7 to find a crumpled scroll. Read the scroll.
Search the ancient gallows at 8 to get the Zadimus corpse. (Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.)
Teleport out, or head back to the first area via the Cave in at 2.
If you went back to first area, leave by crafting the broken table at 3 into a raft, or by searching the rocks at 5. You will take heavy damage if you fail the search rocks at 5.
Head to the Tribal Statue near Trufitus' hut and bury the corpse.
With your bronze wire and chisel, head south-west to Cairn Isle, west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring CKR. Climb the rocks (15 Agility) and then cross the bridge.
Search the well stacked rocks on the northern side of the island, and then enter the crevice, requiring (32 Agility). If you can't get in the cave you didn't read the Tattered Scroll.
Head south and with at least 3 empty inventory spaces search the [[tomb dolmen (Tomb of Bervirius)
Use a chisel on the sword pommel to craft the bone beads.
Use bronze wire on the bone beads to create the Beads of the Dead necklace. You must read the Crumpled Scroll before you can create them.
Teleport out or climb up the rockslide nearby to escape the cave (may take up to 10 damage if you fail).
Prepare for the fight against Nazastarool. Crumble Undead is useful alongside Protect from Melee.
With your three regular bones, bone shard and chisel, head south-east from fairy ring DKP to the north-eastern dot on the Karamja map above.
Search the unique bright green [[palm tree (Shilo Village)
Search the doors to find the keyhole.
Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.
Equip the Beads of the Dead then use the key on the doors.
Open the ancient gate (while wearing the Beads of the Dead necklace), then climb down the rocks.
Run west, south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.
Use (don't bury) 3 regular bones on the [[tomb doors
Search the [[tomb dolmen (Rashiliyia's Tomb)
Use Protect from Melee or stand behind the dolmen to safespot him.
Take the Rashiliyia corpse.
Return to Cairn Isle (fairy ring ckr).
Go through the well-stacked rocks.
Use the corpse on the dolmen.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Ensure you have one free inventory space, then speak to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village, who tells you to run. Ask why, and he will say Rashiliyia has returned. Ask who she is, and he will explain she is the Queen of the dead that has brought a plague of undead upon the village. Ask what you can do, and he will ask you to talk to the shaman Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai Village about something called the Legend of Rashiliyia, which may be to blame. Agree to go see the shaman, then agree to take the Wampum belt to Trufitus. (Why do I need to run? → Rashiliyia? Who is she? → What can we do? → I'll go to see the Shaman → Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.)
Ensure you have the belt in your inventory before continuing! The quest will not officially start until you give it to Trufitus.

full.h: The search for the temple of Ah Za Rhoon

steps.t: Head to Trufitus at the most north-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai and use the wampum belt on him. Ask about the legend, and he will say that any information regarding it was lost in the vanished temple of Ah Za Rhoon. Ask if he knows anything more about the temple, and he will mention that the priest Zadimus built the temple, and it is rumoured that Rashiliyia destroyed it after he rejected her affections. Ask him to tell you more, then tell him you will search for Ah Za Rhoon, and he will be skeptical but agree to help you if you are serious. Say you are serious about looking for Ah Za Rhoon and the quest will officially begin. (Mosol Rei said something about a legend? → Do you know anything more about the temple? → Tell me more. → I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon! → Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.)

The temple of Ah Za Rhoon is located on eastern Karamja, south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village across the River Amja (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a gnome glider or fairy ring DKP, or walk there by crossing the wooden log to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks.
Use your spade on the [[Mound of earth
mound of earth]] to find a fissure.
Use your torch, candle or Candle lantern on the fissure to light it up (this consumes the item!).
Add a rope to the fissure.
Search the fissure and climb down into the dungeon below (32 Agility).
Note: The dirt mound may respawn if you take too long, but you may right click and search it twice to still enter (torch and rope not required).
In the cave are undead ones (level 61 - 73) who may attack you. Killing them occasionally causes a cloud of shilo mist to appear and deal damage to you.
In this cave system, you will need to find four items. Consult the following map to aid in finding them.
Start off by heading south until you see the water.
Use a chisel on the strange looking stone (4 on the map; it is a small grey stone in the floor to the east of a Smashed chair and south of a stalagmite) to obtain the stone-plaque.
Go west past the column and search the Cave in (2 on the map) to crawl through and into some ruins.

Head north until you reach the end of the ruined buildings. Search the loose rocks (6 on the map) near the north-west wall to find the tattered scroll. If you fail, you will get hit for 4-7 (possibly more) damage.
Now head south-east until you come to a small dead-end branch. Search the sacks next to a smashed table (7 on the map) to obtain the crumpled scroll.
Finally, head north to the far end of the cavern, where you will find the ancient gallows (8 on the map). Search it and remove the corpse to obtain the Zadimus corpse.

After acquiring all four items, you can teleport out. Otherwise, to exit the dungeon, return to the smashed table (3 on the map). You can craft the smashed table into a raft and use it to leave. This does not always work; it is possible to get the message that there isn't enough wood left. In this case, you will have to leave by other means. If you want, you can continue south, then east to the end of the cave. Search the rocks you find there to leave via the waterfall. You will take around 20 damage if you fall while leaving this way. You will find yourself near the stepping stones to the east of Shilo Village.
bronze wire, A chisel, 3 free inventory spaces
Read both the scrolls and the plaque, then use both scrolls, the plaque, and the corpse on Trufitus. He will tell you about the tomb of Bervirius and instruct you to bury the corpse.

West of the hut is the Tribal Statue, bury the corpse there and the Spirit of Zadimus will appear, giving you a bone shard after some cryptic words. Use the bone shard on Trufitus, and tell him it appeared when you buried the corpse, that the spirit said something, and that it was about keys and kin. He'll tell you to look for Bervirius' tomb. (It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse → He said something after he gave it to me. → The spirit said something about keys and kin?)

If you didn't bring bones with you, you can obtain the three required bones from the chickens that spawn inside the village south of Trufitus (beware of the poisonous tribesmen) or from the snakes in the surrounding area now for a future section.

Head towards Cairn Isle attached to the south-western coast of Karamja by either walking south or teleporting to a fairy ring and using code ckr. Climb the rocks and cross the bridge to reach Cairn Isle. You may fall and take damage, keep trying until you succeed.

Search the well-stacked rocks (i.e. the cairn) on the north side of the island. Enter the crawl-way (32 Agility) to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. You may become stuck many times, but keep trying. Head south to the dolmen, and search it to get a sword pommel, a locating crystal, and Bervirius notes.

Warning: If you drop the sword pommel or the bone beads, they will turn to dust and you will have to go back and get new ones. If you drop the locating crystal, you will take 10 damage. If your inventory is full when you collect them, they will drop on the floor, but will not turn to dust and you can pick them up after you drop some other items.
Note: If you lose the Bervirius notes, you will need charcoal and papyrus to get it again. You can purchase both from the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Read the scrolls. You need to make a new necklace. Use a chisel on the sword pommel to make bone beads. Use the bronze wire on the beads to make the Beads of the Dead necklace.

You now need to head to eastern Karamja. If walking there, climb up the nearby rockslide to exit the tomb (you may fall and take up to 10 damage). Otherwise you may teleport out to use fairy ring dkp or a gnome glider.
Chisel, [[Bone shard (Shilo Village)

Rashiliyia's Tomb is north of the crashed gnome glider, accessible east of Trufitus across the log or south of fairy ring DKP. Look for a searchable palm tree. Avoid the nearby The Shaikahan enemy which cannot be harmed. The entrance is hidden behind a hill and is most visible if you are facing south. Search the palm trees to find two doors. Search these doors to find the shape of the keyhole, and then use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key (20 Crafting). Put on the Beads of the Dead necklace before entering or you will be unable to continue and will take constant damage! Use the key on the door to enter.
Once inside, open the ancient gates, then climb down the rocks once you are ready to run past several aggressive undead ones.

Warning: In the next section you may be attacked by undead ones while trying to open the tomb doors by using your bones. The door will remember the amount of bones you have used, so if you die you can return and use the remaining bones.

Head west until you find a stack of coins (do not pick them up or more undead ones will be summoned), then south, and then south-west at the first fork. At the end of this corridor will be a set of doors. Other sets of dummy doors exist if you take a wrong turn, so make sure you're in the right place. Right-click the bones to use them on the door. While still wearing the necklace, enter the room.

While still wearing the Beads of the Dead, search the dolmen in the room. You will be attacked by Nazastarool, a level 91 zombie that attacks with Melee. After you defeat him, he will turn into a level 68 skeleton and then a level 93 ghost. You can safespot all three forms by running around the dolmen after each form spawns until he gets stuck (see image). Each form has a 5 minute despawn timer. He has a weakness to Fire spells and Crumble Undead, and is not resistant to any combat style. A salve amulet can be worn once the first form has spawned. A dwarf multicannon may be used.

Note: If you try to leave the cave the way you came in, the door will be locked and Rashiliyia will summon three Undead ones to kill you. You can however still leave by using the bone key on the doors. If you leave and return, you won't need to fight the forms that you already defeated, and you won't need bones to open the tomb door.
Note: A friend may attack the boss for you, but you must be the last person to attack it to progress in the quest (0s count but not poison/venom).
Once you have defeated the ghost, you will get the corpse of Rashiliyia. Teleport out towards Cairn Isle or leave from where you entered (using your key on the door).

Go back to the tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle west from Shilo Village, and use Rashiliyia's remains on the dolmen. Rashiliyia will appear before you. She will thank you for letting her rest in peace and give you your reward.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz, outside of the church in Slepe.(Yes.)
Talk to Hameln the Jester inside the church.(Do you know how he fell ill?)
Talk to Carl in the pub south-east of the church.(Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?)
Inspect the barrel south of the pub to follow Carl to his supplier.
Go through the church and hide at the north doors, wait there until he passes the doors.
Proceed to the hollow tree just north of the graves, and hide on the eastern side.
When he reaches the centre square of the town, hide at the northern side of the hollow tree next to the gallows (due east).
Once he approaches the graveyard, hide at the western side of the hollow tree to the west of the graveyard.
After the cutscene, kill Kroy. Kroy does not have to be killed with the Ivandis flail, and can instead be killed with normal weapons.
Use Protect from Magic, and dodge his potion-throw attack.
Stand behind a lab table and attack him with ranged to negate all his damage.
Destroy both lab tables.
Leave the lab by clicking the southern gate.
Talk to Veliaf in the Slepe church graveyard.(Fair enough, so what now?)
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz next to Drezel at Paterdomus.(I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?) (Fairy ring cks, Salve Graveyard Teleport [[Salve graveyard teleport (tablet)
Talk to Ivan Strom south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. (Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport [[Fenkenstrain's castle teleport (tablet)

Cut three vines from the swamp tree to the north-east.
Use the vines on each other to make a long vine.
Use the long vine on the swamp tree branch.
Swing across the water and continue the trek by clicking the last tile.
Kill the Nail beasts, use food on Ivan if his health becomes too low, and continue the trek.
Use your logs on the bridge (chop 3 logs if you didn't bring any. If you forgot your axe, kill the zombie for one.)
Cross the bridge and continue the trek.
Before the dialogue ends, attack the easternmost Vampyre (the one in-front of Ivan) so that it doesn't attack Ivan.
Use your Ivandis Flail to kill these Vampyres.
Continue the trek to end up in Burgh de Rott.
Talk to Ivan and complete the dialogue to send him to the boathouse.
After completing the trek, bank and prepare for the next step.
Head south-east of Burgh de Rott to the boat house and talk to Ivan Strom.
Board the boat and head to the Icyene graveyard.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.

Unlock the mausoleum door north of you.

Mine 15 Daeyalt ore and place them in the cart. (If you forgot a pickaxe, talk to any miner for a bronze one.)
Talk to the Vampyre Juvinate.
Head south-east to the house with the slashed tapestry and the statue.
Walk through the tapestry.
Go down the staircase.
Talk to Safalaan.(Shall we get going then?)
Kill the Mutated Bloodveld.
Talk to Safalaan again.
Search the bookshelf on the western wall inside the room filled with mutated bloodvelds.
Talk to Safalaan.(Sure. Here you go.)
Head back to Burgh de Rott. (Morytania legs 3 , Mort'ton teleport or Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport and run south-east to the boat or Drakan's Medallion and run south-west to the boat.)
Take the boat back to the Icyene Graveyard.

Use your Drakan's medallion to teleport to Ver Sinhaza.
Exit to the west towards Meiyerditch.
If you don't have the Vyrewatch outfit head to Trader Sven's house south of Old Man Ral's house, near the shore. Trade him and buy a Vyrewatch outfit. (Do not equip the outfit)
Go down the trapdoor in the northern room of [[Old Man Ral

Make your way back to Icyene Graveyard by either:
Climbing back up, going south-west to the wall, climb the wall and navigate to the boat
Or go back to Burgh de Rott to get to the boat

Take the boat to Slepe.

Stomp out the magical fires Damien periodically spawns. Prioritise these, as they reduce the damage you deal to him. He can, however, be killed even with one on-screen.
Talk to Veliaf.

Go back to the Icyene Graveyard (Use Morytania legs 3 or Drakan's Medallion and take the boat to the north or Mort'ton teleport and take the boat south-east of Burgh de Rott).
Talk to Vanescula Drakan.
Equip the Vyre noble clothing.
