Head to the Chasm of Tears and speak to Movario whilst wearing the Dark Squall's robes.
Use a lit sapphire lantern on a light creature to be transported into the chasm.
Search the nearby skeletal remains for the following items: a spade, a hammer, and a chisel.
Use the spade on the pile of rocks to uncover a brazier, then use the chisel on it to obtain a fire orb.
Head further west and do the same to the lone pile of rocks for an earth orb.
Head directly south, and use a chisel on the intact brazier there for an air orb.
Head east, and use a chisel on the intact brazier there for a water orb.
Head all the way south to reach three skull cavities.
Examine each recessed block and use the each of the three corresponding orbs on them for the matching elemental block. (The first three recessed blocks are found right next to the cavity entrances)
Climb up the walls next to the centre skull to find the last recessed block, and use the fourth orb on it for the block.
Head back down and unequip items from your weapon and shield slots.
Enter each of the skull nose cavities and crawl to the end, using the correct elemental block on each mechanism by matching the symbols. The specific positions are individual to each player.
Climb back up to the fourth skull. Use the fire block on the recessed block.
Inspect the stone cube and enter the cave opening in the skull. Drop the tools you obtained earlier if more space is needed.
Make your way south to the central chamber where the stone table is found, split into multiple forked paths leading to statues.
Search the skeleton to receive a silver sickle (b) and six druid pouches.
There are 13 possible statues, with 8 being found at the end of these paths, differing between players.

Along the paths, use the druid pouch on the druid spirits to receive herblore ingredients that are used for a statue. These are a one-off reward, so make sure to have plenty of inventory space to pick them all up. If you run out of charges, cast Bloom while standing on the vines to get vine flowers for more charges.

Examine the statues and use the corresponding ingredients on them, using the table below. The druid spirits should give you the exact amount of ingredients needed. NOTE: If you are using a third-party plugin that hides ground items based on value, you might miss an ingredient!
If you mess up or accidentally use the wrong working combination, teleport out to bank, teleport back to Tears of Guthix and finish the remaining statues.
Once you receive all eight dolmens, use them on the stone table to open the huge door. You may use them one at a time to free up inventory space.
Leave the temple and prepare for the last fight battles ahead. Bank the Dark Squall's robes and bring your best gear.
Bring:
Equipment for all 3 combat styles
3-4 super restores
1 Menaphite remedy (one dose before the fight begins and a second dose if you need more time)
10-12 combo food (sharks and karambwan are fine)
A sapphire lantern to attract a light creature to enter the chasm
An emergency teleport (not runes, as the Elemental can lower your magic to 1 if you run out of supplies)
Proceed past the huge door until you reach the [[Stone of Jas

Upon arriving in the room, a small cutscene will happen and the fight with the Balance Elemental will then begin. It can use a magical, stat-lowering attack after every 3-4 attacks, then proceeding to change attack styles based on the player's protection prayer.
Fight overview:
Fiery / Orange -> attacks with Ranged
Airy / White -> attacks with Melee
Watery / Blue -> attacks with Magic
The Elemental will start praying against your attack styles at 50% of its hitpoints.

At 25% the Elemental will attack faster, harder and have double prayers up. Be sure to correctly pray against the style it uses, since it can hit high 30s on a 2-tick speed attack whilst switching attack styles as well.
Make sure you drink your restores if the Elemental reduces your stats or bring a menaphite remedy and drink it before the fight starts so it will restore your stats when weakened.

It is recommended that you use one of the pillars at 25% since you can exchange hits 1:1 and take your time to have the right prayer protection up. Or focus on prayers first, and then your switches, as you only have 1 tick to react. If the attack hits you off prayer it will drain your stats and prayer. (You are able to use the pillar the entire fight if you are a lower level/hardcore who is worried about death)
If you die while fighting the Balance Elemental, your grave will appear at the top of the chasm at Tears of Guthix.
Upon defeating it, search the Stone again to view a cutscene.
Fight the two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl.
They are surrounded by a flame shield that reduces damage done by non-demonbane weapons/[[demonbane spells
They can use protection prayers, switching prayers after taking a certain amount of damage.
They can also switch attack styles based on the player's protection prayers every 16 seconds or so.

Sitting behind the south-western column and waiting for the Guardians of Armadyl to finish off the demons is viable and completely removes any combat from the encounter if you do so wish. (Very slow, but completely safe for HCIM)
Upon defeating the demons, speak to Idria and have her teleport you to White Knights' Castle.
Speak to Idria again to complete the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to the Boy south-east of the long garden in Taverley, next to the members gate. (What's the matter? → Ok, I'll see what I can do.)
Head west, then north to the front door of the [[witch's house (location)
Look-under the potted plant closest to the door for a [[Door key (Witch's House)
Read the Diary on the table
Climb down the ladder to the north, equip gloves, and enter the [[gate (witch's house)
Equip your leather gloves before opening the gate.
Search the [[cupboard (witch's house)
Climb up the ladder and go to the small southern room.
Drop cheese in the room and a [[Mouse (Witch's House)
Use the magnet on the mouse.
Go around the garden to the [[fountain (witch's house)
Note: Use the hedges, getting caught means repeating all previous steps except for getting the door key. You cannot walk over the grass.
Check the fountain.
Go to the shed on the east and use the key on the door.
Warning: Attempting to take the ball now makes the Witch's experiment lower your combat stats.
Kill the Witch's experiment in all four forms.
Low levels can use the north-eastern corner to step under the first and second forms of the Witch's experiment until it goes north where it is safespottable with magic 1 tile south-west.

Recipe for Disaster
Grim Tales

Head to Taverley and talk to the boy near the eastern entrance along the hedges. He will start crying; ask him what's the matter, and he will say that he kicked his ball over the hedge into the garden, and the witch living in the house put it in her shed. The boy wants you to get it back for him.
Cheese, gloves, combat equipment
Head west then north around the hedge to the front door of the house - it is locked. Look-under the pot north of the door to find a door key and enter the house. Read the entire diary on the table.

Go down the ladder in the northern room to enter the basement. If you don't already have leather gloves, search the boxes for a pair, however it may take many attempts to find them. Equip your gloves, go through the gate, and search the cupboard for the magnet. Go back up the ladder and into the southern room with the door that leads to the garden. Drop your cheese or use it on the mouse hole. Suddenly, a mouse will come out; use the magnet on the mouse and it will unlock the door. Be quick or the mouse will leave, and you will lose the cheese. Enter the door into the garden.
left

Once in the garden, you will see the witch walking back and forth in the middle. You cannot walk through the garden, and must walk around it while using the hedges as cover until you reach the fountain. If the witch catches you, she will teleport you out of the garden and you will have to repeat most of the previous steps. Search the fountain to obtain a key.
left

Head to the shed (east of the courtyard) and use the key on the door. Do not attempt to take the ball otherwise the Witch's experiment will lower your stats. Attack the Witch's experiment. Each time you kill the experiment's current form it changes to a stronger form. You have to kill the experiment four times before it is defeated - the first stage is a Skavid (level 19), then a spider (level 30), then a bear (level 42), and finally a wolf (level 53). If you flee during the battle you will have to start over.
Note: Rings of recoil may be used - a maximum of 4 will be required, as the experiments combined have a total of 144 hitpoints.
Note: You cannot use a Dwarf multicannon in the shed.

The first and second forms can be safespotted with Magic or flinched with Melee by going into the north-east corner and waiting for the experiment to move south of you. Once it is in position, run past it, then walk on top of it. After this, walk west 1 tile so you are positioned diagonally from the Witch's experiment, then you're free to attack.
The third and fourth can also be safespotted by walking to the south wall of the shed between the sacks and the crate with the ball on it and using Ranged or Magic attacks from there.
Once you have killed the Witch's experiment, take the ball and return it to the boy.

Do not let the witch see you or she will teleport you outside and you will lose the ball. You can avoid needing to pass her by teleporting out. If she does catch you, the doors to the shed will need to be unlocked again. Although the creature will respawn, it will not attack you.
Congratulations, quest complete!
To start, talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington. (I am in search of a quest. → Yes, help me become one with my darker side.)
Kill a rat in the archery store directly west of Hetty to get a rat's tail.
Buy an eye of newt from Betty for 3gp.

Run to the chapel south of Port Sarim. Kill a giant rat and take the raw rat meat. Run back to Hetty's house. Use the raw rat meat on the fireplace. If you accidentally cook the meat you can re-cook it on the fireplace again to burn it.
Pick an onion from the field north of Rimmington.
Talk to Hetty while carrying all four items.
Drink from the cauldron.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Talk to Hetty in her house in south-east Rimmington, and tell her you want to know more about the black arts. She will tell you she is making a potion and needs four ingredients that she wants you to get: a rat's tail, a piece of burnt meat, an eye of newt, and an onion.

Kill a level 1 rat (they can be found in the archery shop west of Hetty's house) to obtain a rat's tail. Note: You can only obtain a rat's tail if you have started the quest! Giant rats will NOT drop a rat's tail.
- You can skip this point if you have already obtained Burnt meat.

Kill a giant rat just north of the chapel graveyard south-east of Rimmington, or kill a cow in the cow pen just south of Falador, and cook the meat. Meat can be used on the fireplace in Hetty's own house. If you didn't manage to burn the meat, use the cooked meat on the fire or range to purposely burn it. (A player-lit fire will also work.) You can also buy raw meat from Wydin at the food store in Port Sarim.
- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an Eye of newt.
You can buy an eye of newt from the magic shop in Port Sarim for 3 coins. The magic shop is labelled with a fire rune symbol on the map.
- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an onion.
Onions can be found in a field directly north of Rimmington and east of Melzar's Maze, or in the backyard of Fred the Farmer's farmhouse west of the sheep pen in Lumbridge.
When you have all these items, talk to Hetty. She'll put them in her cauldron and tell you to drink from it. Drink from the cauldron to complete the quest and gain your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Veos in The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge. (I'm looking for a quest. → Sounds good, what do I do?) (If you have previously visited Great Kourend: (Can I help? → Sounds good, what do I do?))
Dig right under the north-westernmost window of the small room attached to Bob's Brilliant Axes, one tile west of the plant against the wall. See first image below.
Dig behind Lumbridge Castle, just outside the kitchen door, south-west 1 tile from the large crate. See second image below.
Go to Draynor Village, by walking or teleporting with an Amulet of glory.
Dig north-west of the Draynor Village jail, just by the wheat farm, 4 tiles north of the bush near Leela. See third image below.
Dig in the pig pen next to where Martin the Master Gardener is. See fourth image below.
Use the ancient casket on Veos at the Port Sarim docks, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Speak to Veos in The Sheared Ram pub in Lumbridge. He has travelled to Lumbridge on a treasure hunt after finding a scroll in Great Kourend, a kingdom far west of the mainland. However, due to not being familiar with the area, he is stuck on what to do next. Offer to help him, and he will give you a treasure scroll.
Should players be stuck on any step of the treasure scroll, players can talk to Veos, either on the dock just south of Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim or in The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge for hints.

The first clue on the treasure scroll will state: "Within the town of Lumbridge lives a man named Bob. He walks out of his door and takes 1 step east, 7 steps north, 5 steps west and 1 step south. Once he arrives, he digs a hole and buries his treasure."

From Bob's Brilliant Axes (indicated by the icon), follow the directions in the treasure scroll and then dig with a spade. The correct spot is the tile north of the north-western window of the house connected to Bob's Brilliant Axes, directly west of the plant. You will receive the next treasure scroll step.

The second clue on the treasure scroll is a map. This will lead to the door behind the Lumbridge Castle by the Cook's kitchen. Dig on the tile directly south-west of the large crate and you will receive a mysterious orb.

The mysterious orb is used to locate the next clue. Based on an Hunt the Thimble, feel the mysterious orb and it will tell you how close you are to the treasure. Its temperature is based on the distance of the treasure from the player, measured in the number of steps it would take to reach the treasure, ignoring any obstacles (this is the Chebyshev distance between the player and treasure). Teleport or walk to another location, feel the mysterious orb and see if it has gotten warmer.
The orb works in much the same way as the Hot Cold Treasure Trails or The Enchanted Key miniquest.

The location to dig is just east of Draynor Village, north-west of the jail and south of the wheat field, near Leela. Dig four steps to the north of the bush there. An amulet of glory will teleport the player close to the final location, requiring only a short walk north-east. If you are a lower level, watch out for the aggressive jail guards nearby. You will obtain another treasure scroll.

The fourth clue is a Caesar shift that encrypts a location. In order to decode a Caesar-shifted message, you must first count the number of times a letter appears within the cipher. See here on how to solve a Caesar shift.

The cipher, ESBZOPS QJH QFO, when decoded, is DRAYNOR PIG PEN. Dig in the centre of the pig pen just north of the market in Draynor Village and you will receive an ancient casket. As you dig it up, you hear a faint whispering, though you can't make out what it says.

After obtaining the casket, go to the northernmost dock in Port Sarim, on the docks, outside Rusty Anchor Inn, and give Veos the treasure. When asked what was in it, he will shiftily state it was nothing important, just something that might be useful to him back in Great Kourend.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Either buy one from the Grand Exchange or make it yourself by adding Rogue's purse to a Vial of water and then add Snake weed. It is not needed for the quest but giving it to Uglug Nar will allow you to purchase Relicym's balm from his shop if needed in the future.

Head to the entrance of Jiggig, south of Castle Wars, east of fairy ring BKP. Speak to Grish, who will talk about zogres carrying the "sickies". Ask about the zogres and he will describe how they rose from the dead in Jiggig and became carriers of sickness. Ask if you can help, and he will request that you learn why the zogres have risen from the dead, and find a way of reburying them. Grish will then give you two super restore potions and three cooked chompy birds.
Talk to the ogre guard to the east. After mentioning Grish, he will crush the barricade to allow you to climb over into the zogre-infested area.

In the following area, players under level 89 Combat may be attacked by level 44 zogres or skogres, which inflict disease, a status effect that will reduce a random stat (excluding Hitpoints and Prayer) by up to 10 every 18 seconds. If the skill is already at level 1, Hitpoints will be reduced instead. Players may be inflicted with disease through protection prayers.

Three doses of Relicym's balm will cure disease, or one dose of Sanfew serum, which also provides 15 minutes of immunity to disease. If not cured, disease will expire after 15 minutes. The super restore potions may be used to restore stats.
Tip: Using the restoration pool in the Ferox Enclave will cure disease, and can be reached through a ring of dueling or Minigame Teleport to Clan Wars.
Once ready, run east to a set of stairs going downward and descend these stairs into the Jiggig Dungeon.
Proceed north-west to an area with a blackened floor. There will be a short cutscene.
Search the broken lectern. You will find a torn page that contained a spell.
Search the skeleton that is adjacent to the lectern; a [[zombie (Zogre Flesh Eaters)
zombie]] will appear and attack. Kill it to obtain a ruined backpack.
Open the backpack to obtain a dragon inn tankard, some rotten food and a knife.
Attempt to search the [[Ogre Coffin (Zogre Flesh Eaters)

coffin]] nearest to the skeleton, and then use a knife on it. The lock should unlock. Try opening the coffin (it may take a couple of tries). When the coffin is open, search it to obtain a black prism.
Backtrack and exit the cave by running back to the barricade or simply teleport out.

Head to the Dragon Inn in south-western Yanille. The Minigame Teleport to the Nightmare Zone, Watchtower Teleport (with completion of the Watchtower quest) or fairy ring ciq will take you near Yanille.

Use the dragon inn tankard on the bartender, who will recognise it as belonging to Brentle Vahn, a common customer. Unsurprised to hear of his death, the bartender will mention seeing him recently talking to a shifty looking wizard.

Go to the Wizards' Guild in eastern Yanille, and talk to Zavistic Rarve on the . If you don't have level 66 Magic, instead ring the bell on the eastern side of the building, and Rarve will appear outside. After seeing the prism and torn page, Rarve will mention that a wizard by the name of Sithik Ints has been researching the dark arts and may be able to help; though he doubts that he is involved, as there is a severe penalty for using the 'dark arts'.

Sithik can be found in the guest house to the north of the Guild on the , in the western-most room, lying in the bed. Ask him about the undead ogres at Jiggig, and he will deny any knowledge of them. The player will ask to look around, ignoring Sithik's objections.

Search the drawers, the cupboard, and the wardrobe in Sithik's room. You will find a book of portraiture, a necromancy book, papyrus and charcoal, and a Book of 'H.A.M'. Read all three books. Do not drop the tankard, as you will need it shortly after.

Use the Book of Portraiture on Sithik, and he will recommend the player tries out portraiture for themselves. Use the papyrus on him and the player will draw a portrait of his likeness. He will admire either the 'truth' or the 'honesty' of your completed portrait; you can only progress if he admired the honesty of it. Otherwise, drop it and make a new one before progressing. You can grab another papyrus from the drawers. Having a higher Crafting level helps with making a successful sketch. The two portraits won't appear the same in the inventory, and the correct one, when examined, will read A classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.

Return to the bartender and use the portrait on him. He will recognise Sithik as the wizard seen with Brentle, and will sign the portrait as an affidavit. Go back to the Wizards' Guild and talk to Zavistic Rarve or ring the bell outside the door. Tell him you have some items to show him, and after showing them all it will be enough evidence to convince Rarve that Sithik may be responsible for the murder. Rarve will give you a strange potion, explaining it will bring on a change in Sithik which should solicit some answers from him.
Use the potion on the cup of tea on top of Sithik's dresser. Go down the ladder and back up to Sithik, and you will find that he has turned into an ogre.

Talk to Sithik, and he will admit that he got Brentle Vahn to cast the spell to get rid of the ogres. Obtain answers to all three questions to unlock the ability to make Relicym's balm and brutal arrows. He will tell you that the spell is permanent, and the only option is to move the ceremonial area, as well as explaining the use of brutal arrows and Relicym's balm.
Tip: You may now sell the black prism to Zavistic Rarve for c or to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for c.

In the following section, you will need to fight a level 111 undead ourg. The boss is fully vulnerable to brutal arrows, takes 50% damage from the Crumble Undead spell (max hit of 7), and only 25% damage from all other attacks. Either the use of brutal arrows or Crumble Undead is recommended, and the latter may actually do more damage depending on levels and the tier of brutal arrows the player has access to. Do note however that only a limited range of staves can autocast Crumble Undead (see the Crumble Undead page for info).

His attacks inflict disease through prayer, though Protect from Missiles will prevent his attacks from dealing damage when utilising the safespot in the next section. His attacks will additionally drain Prayer if the player is praying against the corresponding attack. This is independent of his disease effect.
It is possible to complete the fight without either brutal arrows or Crumble Undead, but may take significantly longer at low levels.

Since Sithik Ints has revealed the secret to making Relicym's balm, the player can now create them using a rogue's purse on a vial of water and then adding snake weed. They are also tradeable on the Grand Exchange. They may be useful in the final fight with Slash Bash, though it will take 5 doses to cure disease rather than the usual 3. Sanfew serum will cure disease by Slash Bash in two doses, though the 15 minutes of immunity will prevent disease from being inflicted.

It is highly recommended to take at least one balm to Uglug Nar by the entrance to Jiggig. Doing so will unlock a store selling three doses of Relicym's balm with a stock of 100, and he will additionally give you either c, c, c, or c depending on the dose of potion. This can only be done once. Giving him a three dose potion is enough to buy back three potions. The store additionally sells 100 achey logs, 10 bow strings, 10 cooked chompy, and five knives, which may be useful if choosing to fletch your own brutal arrows.
Brutal arrows and the composite ogre bow are tradeable on the Grand Exchange. The tier of arrow depends on the type of nails used.
If choosing to make the bow, use a knife on achey tree logs with some wolf bones in the inventory. Use a bow string on the unstrung bow to complete the bow (requires 30 Fletching).

If choosing to make the arrows, use a knife on achey tree logs and fletch them into ogre arrow shafts (each log will give 2-6 shafts). Add feathers to the shafts (each shaft needs 4 feathers). Finally, use nails (made of any metal) on the flighted ogre arrow while having a hammer in your inventory.

Return to Grish and tell him you found out who's responsible for the Zogres. After informing him that the spell is unbreakable and the ceremonial dancing area will need to be moved, he will ask the player to retrieve some old things from the burial grounds to make the new Jiggig special, giving them an ogre gate key.

In order to unlock the ability to equip the comp ogre bow, you must tell him that you have some information on how to kill the zogres from a distance. He will then demonstrate how you can construct such a bow.
Return to the cave beyond the barricade and head west. There will be two successive locked doors, proceed through both of these and descend the stairs.
Note: You will need to retrieve another ogre gate key from Grish if you die during the following fight.

Continue to the end of this long, wide room. Searching the stand will spawn the boss. To utilise the safespot, stand to the east of the stand before searching it (see image), and drink a dose of sanfew serum if you have one to prevent his disease effect.

A level 111 undead ourg named Slash Bash will attack you. The boss can be safespotted, however you can still be attacked by his range attacks. Activate Protect from Missiles to negate all damage if safespotting.
He will despawn after five minutes; search the stand again to respawn him.
After Slash Bash is defeated, collect the bones and the ogre artefact that he drops. The three ourg bones that Slash Bash drops are worth about ourg bones each.
Tip: If you have started Rag and Bone Man II, you may consider killing zogres in the area until they drop the zogre bone for that quest.
Warning: After talking to Grish, he will take your key and you will be unable to return to the boss room, losing any items left behind!
Return to Grish with the ogre artefact for your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!
Talk to Marlo in the Estate agent's house in north-east Varrock. (What kind of favour do you want me to do? → Tell me more about the job. → Tell me where he lives, and I'll do the job.)
Pick up the saw in the house if needed.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo in his house south-west of Aubury's Rune Shop.
Remove all 7 old furnishings:
1 broken chair.
1 rotten carpet.
2 broken stools.
2 broken tables.
1 campbed.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again. (Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.)
Search the [[Crates (Daddy's Home)
Go to the Varrock sawmill and talk to the Sawmill operator. (I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.)
Have the Sawmill operator convert the 3 waxwood logs into 3 waxwood planks.
If needed, use an axe to chop 10 nearby trees and have the Sawmill operator convert the 10 logs into 10 planks for 1,000 coins.
If needed, buy enough supplies from his shop to have 5 [[Bolt of cloth
Return to Old Man Yarlo's house and build the new furniture at every white, translucent hotspot.
If you lack a hammer or saw, ask Old Man Yarlo for tools. (I need some tools. → Yes please.)
Talk to Old Man Yarlo after building all the furniture.
Return to Marlo and claim the reward. (Yeah, what have you got for me?)
Congratulations, miniquest complete!
400 Construction experience upon completion.
Building the furniture grants an additional 544 Construction experience, for a total of 944 Construction experience.
A player-owned house in Rimmington or 1,000 coins if you already own one.
Marlo's crate, containing 25 planks, 50 mithril nails, 5 steel bars, 10 oak planks, 8 bolts of cloth, 5 house teleports, and 1 Falador teleport.
Total value: c.
3240,3473,title:Marlo,desc:

Marlo can be found in the house of the Varrock Estate Agent in north-east Varrock. Speak to him and he will ask whether the player would be willing to complete an off-the-books favour for him by helping his father renovate his recently acquired house, explaining that the landlord isn't exactly aware of his presence there. He will direct you to Old Man Yarlo in his house in south-east Varrock, south-west of Aubury's Rune Shop. There is a saw on the ground in the same building as Marlo.
Items required: 10 planks, 5 bolts of cloth, a hammer, and a saw.
Items recommended: At least 60 nails of any type.

Speak to Old Man Yarlo and he'll ask you to remove all of the old furniture in the house: a chair, a carpet, two tables, two stools, and his campbed. You must right click the carpet for the option to remove to appear. If you interrupt the cutscene you will have to rewatch it. Once this is done, speak with him again to be given the option to view a cutscene showing the wonders of the Construction skill, or skip it to watch later. Once this is done, Old Man Yarlo will ask you to build him new furniture. Everything except the bed can be built now, however the bed requires a special type of wood; search the crates in the kitchen to receive three waxwood logs, and bring them to the sawmill.
Items required: 3 waxwood logs.
Go to the Varrock sawmill and talk to the sawmill operator to receive 3 waxwood planks. Since he knows of Old Man Yarlo, he'll provide them free of charge.

Return to Old Man Yarlo's home and build the new furniture (chair, carpet, two tables, two stools, and the bed). Speak to Old Man Yarlo again, he'll thank you and offer the player the basics and benefits of Construction.
Finally, return to Marlo to claim your reward.
Talk to Captain Harlan by the Lumbridge general store, north of the castle. (Select the "Do you need help with anything?" chat option.)
Talk to Mudfoot on the other side of the River Lum, by the building just south of the cow field.
Return to the general store and 'Confront' (left click) the outlaw roaming outside to start a cutscene.
Head north along the road until you reach the chicken field and talk to Mudfoot again, south of the Lumbridge windmill.
You may optionally talk to Captain Harlan first to claim a bronze shortsword and wooden shield.
Kill the ranger outlaw.
You may choose to pick up shortbow and arrows for the next fight.
Confront the mage outlaw to the south by the H.A.M hideout.
You may choose to pick up runes and the staff for the next fight.
Head to the Lumbridge graveyard to the south-east with Magic or Ranged gear and kill the final outlaw, who will pray Protect from Melee during the fight.
If you leave the fight area, you will need to retrieve Mudfoot from outside the H.A.M hideout before returning.
It is possible to run around the graveyard until the outlaw aggros onto Mudfoot, for very low level players looking to avoid damage.

The outlaw will only activate Protect from Melee after your initial hit, which is capped at 6 for melee damage. Through the use of poisoned weapons, you can use this to kill the outlaw without the use of Magic or Ranged.
Return to Captain Harlan and tell him the thieves have been dealt with.
Congratulations, quest complete!
mtype:pin,icon:yellowPin,3249:3249,title:Mudfoot,desc:Location of Mudfoot.

Head to the Lumbridge general store, located just north of the castle. Talk to Captain Harlan and ask if he needs help. Harlan will mention that a bounty of 1,000 coins is available to whoever can bring justice to some thieves that robbed the general store. He will share that a traveller passing through noticed some goblins on the other side of the river playing with the stolen goods.

Head over the River Lum, to the house just south of the Lumbridge cow field, and speak to Mudfoot. Unlike the other goblins, Mudfoot will be wearing blue armour. After attacking you (he will not deal damage), Mudfoot will explain that some humans dumped the stuff from the general store. He'll explain that he too is on a quest to find the thieves, and agrees to let the player join as a sidekick.
left

Return to the general store to find one of the outlaws roaming outside. 'Confront' them (left click) to start a cutscene, in which the outlaw escapes after Mudfoot fails to damage him with a hammer. Captain Harlan will interject, explaining to Mudfoot the theory of the combat triangle, as well as melee attack styles, and how this can be utilised against foes weak to the respective style.

Head north along the path towards the windmill until you reach the chicken field and talk to Mudfoot again, which will initiate combat with the ranger outlaw. Stab will be the most effective style against the ranger, but it may also easily be defeated with any combat style due to its low level. Captain Harlan may provide you with a bronze shortsword and wooden shield if you need them. On death the ranger will drop a shortbow and 80 bronze arrows, which may be useful for the next fight.

Head south to find the mage outlaw by the H.A.M. hideout. Ranged will be the most effective style against the mage, but it may again be easily defeated with any combat style. On death the mage will drop a staff, 80 mind runes and 80 air runes, which may be useful for the final fight.

Head south-east to find the final warrior outlaw in the Lumbridge Graveyard. Unlike the other outlaws, he will pray Protect from Melee, forcing the player to use either Magic or Ranged attacks against him. Magic attacks will be most effective, and the outlaw is slightly stronger than the others. Very low level players looking to avoid damage may consider running around the graveyard until he becomes aggressive towards Mudfoot.
If you leave the fight area, you will need to retrieve Mudfoot from outside the H.A.M. hideout before returning.

Tip: Pures looking to bypass the requirement to use Magic or Ranged may choose to use weapon poison. The outlaw will only activate Protect from Melee after your initial hit, which is capped at 6 for melee damage.

Once the warrior outlaw is defeated, he will drop an iron scimitar and iron kiteshield. Return to Captain Harlan to tell him that all of the outlaws have been dealt with. After returning the stolen items, Mudfoot will agree to split the bounty with the player.
Congratulations, quest complete!
22 Agility
20 Thieving
No combat or items required.
Talk to Betty outside the north-easternmost house in Land's End, then talk to Sergeant Hudson.
Inspect every part of the body on the bed. Inspecting the torso gives a coded letter.
Search the shelves beside the door and inspect the blood on the wall north of the door.
Talk to Lan the Butcher. Search his bed for a bloody knife, then show it to him.
Talk to Hugor and Betty.
Inspect every clue item in your inventory, then talk to Betty again.
Return to Sergeant Hudson after completing the conversations.
Meet Betty at the house north-west of the Tithe Farm, near fairy ring AKR.
Climb through the west window and open the door for her.
Follow her into the basement. Inspect the body, shoes and wine bottle, and search the shelves on the north wall.
Ask Betty whether her uncle was a drinker.
Go upstairs and search the bookshelf on the west wall.
Search the compost bin north of the house and inspect the head to find another letter.
Talk to Joyce in the potato field west of the house and the monk just south of it.
Return to Betty. Ask about the Keystone Lodge, exhaust her dialogue, and share your findings.
Accept her offer of transport to Port Piscarilius.
Remove the plank on the north side of the prison.
Avoid the guards and make your way to the north-westernmost house.
Climb the ladder and inspect the drawers and body.
Climb the next ladder and search the bed and wardrobe.
Return to the jail. You can be caught by a guard to return.
Inspect the blood on the wall and translate the note.
Go to the War Tent in Shayzien and watch the cutscene.
Investigate the next victim's house and question Kyle to the south.
Once the quest journal tells you to revisit all the crime scenes, inspect the plant on the island west of Watson's house.
Inspect the blood in the basement and watch the final cutscene.

Talk to Betty outside of the north-easternmost house in Land's End. She will inform the player that her father has been murdered. Speak with Sergeant Hudson to get permission to help solve the case. He will reluctantly allow the player to search around the house for clues.

Upon inspection of each part of the body laying on the bed, the player will find the victim's eyes looking towards the wall by the door, hands missing, and a single stab wound to the torso. Inspecting the torso also reveals a letter containing a coded message. The decoded text, after acquiring all the letters, will list descriptions of the murder targets in the quest:
Search the shelves next to the door for a newspaper cutting describing a murderer called, "The Cutter."
Search the blood on the wall north of the door for part of the key for letters "H," "I," "D," and "E."

Speak to Lan the Butcher who is in his house to the south west. He informs the player that the victim used Land's End as his "holiday home," and that he was "some big important somebody up in Shayzien once." Search the bed in his house to find a bloody knife. Upon showing the knife to Lan, he will say it's bloody from the meat and he's been looking for it for a while.

Speak to Hugor in the building with the bank chest, who informs the player that the victim's name is Jack Holland, and that he lived in Land's End for a long time with his daughter. He claims he heard shouting around the time of the incident
Go back and speak to Betty, who will tell the player that her mother and sister were also murdered in Land's End, possibly due to Jack's time as a judge.

After speaking with everyone in Land's End, speak to Sergeant Hudson again. Sergeant Hudson will ask Betty if she has somewhere to stay temporarily, to which she responds she can stay in her uncle's house south of Hosidius. Betty expresses distrust for the Shayzien Constabulary and fear for her life, but ultimately agrees to stay in Hosidius for now.

Head to the house northwest of the Tithe Farm to speak more with Betty. After she tells you the door is locked, climb through the open window on the western side of the house and open the door to let her inside.
Betty will head down into the basement and scream, prompting the player to follow her down. Upon entering, the player will find another dead body, this time headless.

Upon further inspection, the player will find a single stab wound to the torso, the victim's shoes covered in dirt, and a half-full wine bottle full of separated liquid next to the body. Searching the shelves on the north wall reveals two empty spaces where bottles should be. Speak to Betty and ask if her uncle was a drinker. She will reveal that he liked to drink alone.
Go back upstairs and search the bookshelf on the west wall to find Bernard Holland's certificate of membership for the Keystone Lodge.

Go outside and search the compost bin just north of the house to find a decapitated head. Inspect the head to find a letter in place of the tongue. The letter contains the key for letters "Y," "O," "U," and "R."
Speak to Joyce in the potato field west of the house, who will tell you the house belongs to Bernard Holland, a farming hobbyist from Shayzien.
Speak to the monk just to the south, who will call the owner of the house a "blaspheming dissident," and claimed that he threatened violence if the monk didn't stop proselytizing.

After speaking to Joyce and the monk, return to Betty in the basement and ask about the Keystone Lodge. She will reveal that her uncle and father were both members of the group, and that it closed down a few months ago due to a lack of new members.
After exhausting all of Betty's dialog options, the player can share everything they've found. After the conversation, Betty will offer the player transport to Port Piscarilius.

Upon arriving in Port Piscarilius, Sergeant Hudson will immediately arrest the player and Betty, treating them like murder suspects. Once in the prison cell, exhaust Betty's dialogue, then, remove the plank from the north wall of the cell and climb through the gap.

Head to the north-westernmost house in Port Piscarilius, and sneak past the two stationary guards on the first floor. Climb the ladder to the second floor and inspect the dead body in the room. The player finds that the victim has a bruise on her forehead, a broken nose, a single stab wound to the torso, and missing feet. Search the drawers in the room to find a black dagger, and inspect the blood on top to uncover the key for letters "S," "I," "N," and "S."

Climb up the ladder to the top floor and inspect the bed to find a carving that matches the tagline one on the certificate of membership. Search the wardrobe to discover an old pair of Shayzien boots.

Return to the jail (getting caught by one of the two guards will immediately transport the player back to the prison cell) and inspect the blood on the east wall to find the message, "Another one down. Will you save her in time?" along with the key for letters "B," "E," "T," "T," and "Y."

Go to the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment, where the player will be stopped by Sergeant Hudson just before entering. After a brief argument, Corporal Breiman will appear with news that the killer struck again, this time with witnesses reporting a hooded figure leaving the scene. Corporal Breiman names the new victim to be the former Commissioner before leaving with Sergeant Hudson to investigate.

Run to the house just to the north of where the cutscene drops the player off. Upon inspecting the body, the player discovers the victim's eyes missing, a cut on one of their hands, and a single stab wound to the torso. Searching the shelves reveals a wine bottle with an inscription matching the one on the certificate of membership and the wooden bedframe. Inspecting the blood on the wall reveals the message, "X marks the spot."

Interrogate Kyle, on the path just south of the house, who says he saw a slender-built person in a hood running away from the house at the time of the murder. He also mentions that the recent victim was someone who put criminals away or killed them.

Speak to Sergeant Hudson. Select the option "What do you know about the keystone lodge" and complete the dialogue. The quest log will suggest revisiting all the previous murder sites but that is unnecessary. Using the clue "X marks the spot" paired with suggestion to revisit the previous murder locations, players can draw a crosshair centered on the island west of Watson's house.
mtype:pin,1615:3582

Cross the bridge to the island west of Watson's House, just south of Kourend Castle. Inspect the plant between the two trees to find a trapdoor underneath. Climb down and inspect the blood on the east wall to find the message, "Welcome home." Reading the message triggers a cutscene in which a hooded figure enters the room to knock the player out. When the player comes to, the murderer reveals themselves and their motives.
Talk to Farmer Bea inside the Digsite, on the ridge just east of the south-east Varrock mine.
Go to the Grand Exchange east entrance and talk to the Bee dealer. ()
You will receive a [[Bee box
If you shake the box without being prompted, the bees will sting the player. This damage can kill you.
Return to Bea.
Grab and equip everything, (bee hunter's hat, insect net, and insect repellent), from the crate next to Bea.

Go downhill to the south, where the beehives are. Around the hives will be swarm of wasps. Start hunting the wasps until you gather 50 wasp stings. Wield the insect net and spray the swarm when they get agitated. The player will mention returning to Bea once you have collected enough.

Return to Bea. After the cutscene go back to the wasps, and this time place bird snares to gather 50 brown feathers from the honey buzzards. The player will mention returning to Bea once you have collected enough.
Return to Bea once again. After the cutscene fletch the wasp stings with the brown feathers to make 50 wasp darts, and then talk to her again.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Head to the ridge just east of the south-east Varrock mine, within the Digsite. Talk to Farmer Bea, who needs the player's help to set up her new bee farm. She ordered some bees from a dealer in Varrock, and they need picking up. She will also offer the player a cider which will fully restore run energy if accepted.

Head to the Grand Exchange and talk to the bee dealer just inside the eastern entrance. After producing a rather insecure looking box, he will explain proper insect handling; if they get annoyed, give the box a shake, if they don't, never shake them. You will need to deliver the box of bees to Farmer Bea, avoiding damage by periodically shaking it. The player will be alerted of when they need to do this by a red message in chat. Note that this damage can kill the player, and will also take effect when shaking the box at the wrong time.

Return to Farmer Bea to hand over the box. A cutscene will play, in which she places the insects in the beehive, only to discover that the bees appear to have changed into wasps on transit. She now needs the player to get rid of them, suggesting they catch 50 to thin them out.

Grab all the required equipment from the nearby crate, equipping it. Head downhill to the south by the beehives, and hunt the swarm of wasps to gather 50 wasp stings. Wield the insect net and spray the swarm when they get agitated. The player will mention returning to Bea once enough has been collected.

After returning to speak to Bea, another cutscene will play in which a swarm flees from a number of honey buzzards. She now needs the player to get rid of the birds, another potential threat to the theoretical bees, suggesting they catch at least 5 and bring 50 brown feathers back to her.

Return to the wasps, and this time place bird snares to gather 50 brown feathers from the honey buzzards, resetting the traps whenever one is caught. The player will mention returning to Bea once enough has been collected.

Return to Bea again, who has retrieved some replacement bees from the dealer in the meantime. A final cutscene plays, in which a swarm of killer wasps appears, chased this time by black honey buzzards. After the player remarks that these wasps must be much worse than the usual ones, Bea will suggest trying to combine the gathered wasp stings and feathers together to see if something can still be achieved.
Use the wasp stings on the brown feathers to make 50 wasp darts, then talk to her for a final time.
Congratulations, quest complete!
SnelmLover500 (level 50)
Talk to the Juvenile Snail on the island just west of the [[Fairy ring#ALQ
Gather 5 fresh leaves which spawn to the north-east of the island. (You will be told when you have collected enough leaves.)
Return to the snail and defeat the [[Leech (A Shell of a Friend)
Talk to the snail to give it 5 fresh leaves.
Gather 5 dew-covered branches from the branch spawns to south-east of island. Strip them to receive 10 restorative dew.
Return to the island and heal the snail by talking to it.
Name the snail from the list of names provided.
Gather 5 strong sticks to the east of the island. Pick up the bronze axe from spawn here if you didn't bring a woodcutting axe.
Build the snail shelter by clicking on the [[Tree (A Shell of a Friend)
Gather more food by collecting 5 more fresh leaves to the north-east of the island.
Return to the island and kill SnelmLover500.
Congratulations, quest complete!
mtype:pin,icon:magentaPin,3564:3492,desc:Juvenile Snail

Head to the small island in the Haunted Woods just west of fairy ring alq, accessed via the stepping stone south-east of the island. Lower-level players should consider bringing food, as there are aggressive feral vampyres present throughout the quest.

Talk to the pink Juvenile Snail on the island. Although the snail is unable to speak, your player can tell that it's afraid and appears to have been separated from its family. After it indicates that it is hungry, your player will decide to gather some food for it. Collect five of the fresh leaves that spawn immediately north-east of the island, then return to the island to find the snail under attack from a leech.

The leech must be defeated before continuing. Note that the snail cannot die and will regenerate health upon falling below half its Hitpoints. After defeating the leech, talk to the juvenile snail again to find it is in pain, noticeably wincing as it nibbles on the fresh leaves. Your player will wonder whether there is anything nearby to make a balm with.

Leave the island again and gather five dew-covered branches from the spawns just south-east of island. Strip the branches (left-click) to receive ten restorative dew, then talk to the snail again to rub the dew on its wounds. Your player will decide the snail needs a name; pick any of the provided options, and the player will then mention needing materials to build the snail a shelter.

Gather five strong sticks to the east of the island, and pick up the bronze axe from the spawn near the fairy ring if needed. Return to the island to construct the snail shelter in the hollow tree. Before leaving, your player will decide to bring the snail more food as a parting gift.

Collect five more fresh leaves to the north-east of the island, then return once more to find SnelmLover500 standing by the shelter, with the snail nowhere in sight. After confronting him for his apparent heinous acts, it is time to avenge the snail. Kill SnelmLover500 to complete the quest, causing him to drop a pink snelm made from the shell of your fallen gastropod friend. Note: The pink snelm can only be obtained once per account.

Congratulations, quest complete!
